la dwags kyi rgyal rabs rnying pa/ de dang 'brel ba'i ched brjod dang / bka' shog kun btus 'phrul gyi byesag klad bzhugs se(//'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan /la dwags yongs kyi shes rig lhan 'dzoms/gle la dwags/

par bdag ladwags yongs skya shes rig lhan 'dzoms/gle/0 7971tshe pa7tshog stuspyo phapa'ilku me 24cha me 3 rdzartsom sgrog pa/ rig mtsho 'arngam dbyangs rgyal mtshanarig gnas slob dpon/dbus gzhung nang pa'i rig gnas mtho blob khang chen po/gle/la dwags/777 77/ 77 7 sku/ 796tshe khris skubyang 600 khu13710116khu6061 ༷ji'i ne dzidzu/25 (6021mtshorimang 226—146mtha'ipar thengs dang po/ 2008 deb grangs 1000kha lotsho77/tsho/0 2008 7000302 5shu yon/ sgor/35༷〉〉ye 25 250glog klad du 'god pa po ye shes bstan 'dzin/ (rkan bzhi/)0177phatsho 77/19597/ tha 77745 ཿ797// sku tshe /519777 stu 3 ཿ 6/'khri91715137722/79997lha ’7 7 nga 19/ la tsho 2 tshe / 7 tshe/par skrun byed po// la dwags yongs kyai shes rig lhan 'dzoms/gle 9pha //56246tshe 7979tshe papha/tshophaḍa991757 / tshe 7971tshe 3 stuthang/sa sa ne baXng 0 13 gu tha505470991 kyi chib0/spyos 010khri zi 5 sa 5ma mchiḥmi pa mi/ba'i 5mi pa /mi baX/khri —110054

nu sa ga ga sa/la dwags kyi sngon gyi rgyal rabs bris gapadma dkar po'i phreng ba zhes pa de yongs 'dzin dka' chen blo bzang bzod pa mchog gi phyag tu yod pa de nyid da lta las lo nyi shu'i gong bdag gi lag tu son zhing / ngas de ma thag par :tshag brgyabs nas nyar pa yin/ yin kyang par du ma bskrun na nam brlag 'ong mi shes shing / der brten da res la dwags skulangs gyi shes rig lhan 'dzoms kyis mkhas dbang por phe sar blo bzang 'jam dpal mchog la snyan zhu phul pa ltar khong gis dngul gyi rogs ram gnang ba ltar rgyal rabs snying pa de nyid dang / gzhanaling ched brjod dang bka' shog mi nyung ba zhig kyang rnyed pas/ de dag kun bsdus nas dpe deb kyai gzugs su spel pa yin/ rgyal rabs rnying pa de'i mtshan ngo ma ni ((bod kyi rgyal po'i gdung rabs padma dkar po'i phreng ba zhes bris 'dug de yang dbu nas snalas rgyal bde legs rnam rgyal ( 164041680)kyi skabs su bod nas sog po dga' ldan tshe dbang dmag dpon du bskos nas la dwags su dmag brgyab phyir btang ba ltar bod dmag la dwags gle'i smad tsam ba mgo bar du 'byor/ der 'edzi gsum ring dmag 'thab kyang la dwags kyai dmag mi rnams pham bcug ma thub/ 'on kyang bod nas dmag gnon dmag mi mang po sle rgyu skuld pa 'di ga'i rgyal ((na rnams kyis mkhyen/ de nas gros byas nas gaji rte /nā bapa kyai drung du mi btang / des kyang la dwags rgyal po'i zhu ba 'bul mi 'byor pa ltar di/ rgyal po skyes rang zeb ( 1661—1707zhes gnang ba blangs rte dmas mi

2stong phrag kha shas btang de kun ba mgo ru 'byor te bya rgyal thang du bod dmag dang tshabs cher 'thabs pas bod dmag pham nas bros 'gro ba'i bar du sngar gyi yig rnying ji ma ji bzhin bkod yod/ deb 'di'i shog grangs 75yimajug par yin/ de nas mar la zhing gshegs dka' chen blo bzang bzod pa rang nyid kyis brtsams sku1da pa ltar bzhag 81da/ 'on kyang rgyal po gtso che ba rnams kyis rgyal srid ji tsam kyang pho tshad phe rengs nas sdi ltar tshod byas nas bkod yod pa ltar blo gsar rnams la go sla ched bris 81da/ gzhan yang dka' chen mchog gis mdzad pa'i lo chen rin chen bzang po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus de yang bcug yod/ de ltar bcug dgos don ni/ de'i nang du lo chen gyis bzhengs pa'i khri rtse'i nyar ma'i lha khang rnams ji ltar yod/ nyams chags ji ltar byung / de dag gi skor dmigs bsal mdzad nas bris te 'dugagazhan yang rgyal rabs dang 'brel ba'i ched brjod dang / bka' shog mi nyung ba zhig kyang lag son byung bas/ de dag kyang bsdus bsgrugs byas 81da/ de yang dbyi gu'i gur mgon lha khang du bzhugs yod pa'i 'dul ba'i phyag dpe bris ma pod bcu gsum gyi ched brjod/ mdo sde bskal bzang gi ched brjod/ sgra tog gser gsumagyi ched brjod/ rdor gcod bris pa'i ched brjod bcas dang / mang spyor bzhugs pa'i rdor gcod rnying pa'i ched brjod/ ba mgo'i gser bris bka' 'gyur rgyal po 'ba' 'gan gyis bzhengs pa'i ched brjod las gal che'i rigs bcas gus 'angam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis bzhus nas 'dir bkod yod/ ba lu mkhar gyi brag la brkos 81da pa'i yi ge dge thub bsnan dpal ldan gyis bzhus pa/

rkib mgo'i paṇa gdang ring mo'i ched brjod dge tshe ring chos 'phel gyis bzhus pa/ba mgo'i bka' 'gyur gser bris ma'i ched brjod/ dbyi gu'i maṇa gdang stod cha dang smad cha'i rdo bar brkos yod pa'i ched brjod/ ta ru brag sna'i rdo sku'i 'gragagyi brag brkos ched brjod/ dngul 'bigs kyai brag dang / ha nu kug ra'i brag dang / ha nu pa tre'i brag la brkos yod pa/ bye thang ma ṇi'i ched brjod/ blob grwa'i mdun thang maṇi'i ched brjod bcas a phyi na thang pa sku zhabs bsod nams phun tshogs kyis ji ltar bzhus 81da pa dang / de bzhin khri rtse'i jo mo lha khang gi ldebs ris su yod pa'i ched brjod dang / dgon 'og gi ma ṇi khar bris yod pa'i ched brjod dge byams pa phun tshogs kyis bzhus pa dang / shel rdo rje chen mo'i lta khang mdun gyi rdo bar brkos yod pa'i ched brjod dge ngag dbang sbyin pas ji ltar bzhus pa ltar bkod mtshod/ sngon gyi yig snying dang ched brjod khag gi yi ge'i dag cha sngar ji ltar bris yod pa de nyid sor bzhag pa ma gtogs dag cha la bsgyur ba gang yang btang med/ tog 'o ma cig pa'i su zhabs 'jigs med rdo rje'i phyag tu yod pa'i rgyal po rnams kyai bka' shog rtsing pa bdun yang bkod yod/ de dag nas de dus kyi rgyal po rnams dang / mi mangs kyi 'brel ji ltar 81da pa shes thub 'dugagazhan yang nub phyogs pa mkhas pa phe rengs ges bes kun ṭi be/ (703 khul11cha ) zhes pa'i deb kyi nang du yod pa'i zangs dkar chags tshul/ bzang la'i rgyal rgyud/ rgya pa sdo/ dpa' bo tshul khrims rdo rje/ chos zletshon shākya rgya mtsho dang /sgo ra par gyi dmag gi sgor ji ltar yod pa de yang tshur blangs te la dwags pa blo gsar tshang ma la thugs rgyus bskyod phyir 'dir bcug pa yin/

4 bdag gis yongs 'dzin dka' chen blo bzang bzod pa mchog gis gtsos pas selang gi rogs ram mdzad mkhan mkhas pa lhan rgyas la snying nas zugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/deb kyai mjug tu mang spro'i rgyal rabs me rtog chun po zhes pa de yang nyer mkhor che bar mthong nas bcug yod/ da dung yang phyag dpe bris ma mang po dang /rgyal po rnams kyi bka' shog mang po dang / paṇa gdang dang / ldebs ris su bris ye da pa'i ched brjod shin du mang bas/ blo ldan rnams kyis 'o brgyal la ma 'dzems pa de dag kyang bzhus te/ 'grem spel mdzad na khe phan chen po 'byung rgyu dang / sngar gyi gter rnying kun brlag stor mi 'gro ba la phan srid /rgyal rabs gsar pa bri ba'i cha rkyen mi nyung ba zhig 'dir spel 81da/ da dung yang zhib 'jug mdzad nas la dwags kyai rgyal rabs/ chos 'byung / legs byang rnams kyi skor la na gzhon blo ldan lhan rgyas kyis rang gi phyag smyug bkol bar mdzad du gaskulal zhes lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa lags/lhag par du por phe sar blo bzang 'jagadapal mchog la snying nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / de bzhin deb chung 'di sku zhabs ye shes bstan 'dzin gyis glo mid du legs par bcug pas khong la'ang thugs rje che zhu'o//rtsom sgrig pa/rig mtsho 'arngam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/

dkar ca5nashogazangs/bod kyi rgyal po'i gdung rabs / 1—101zangs dkar chags tshul/ 102zangs dkar bzang la 'i rgyal rgyud/ 11 rgya pyokhro'i sgor/ 116dpa' po tshul khrims rdo rje'i sgor/ 1daXchos blon shāspyargya mtsho'i sgor/ 1 ༷tho ra lhar gyi sgor/ —mi me tshe bstan/ 1 na(ched brjodabag)rdo rje gcod gabris ma'i ched brjod/ 148grwa tog gser sa/sum gyi ched brjod/ 154dbyi gu'i gur mgon gyi 'bum bris pa'i ched brjod/ 159mdo sde bskal bzang gi ched brjod/ 172'dul ba'i ched brjod/ 181mang spyor bzhugs pa'i rdo rje gcod pa'i ched brjod/ 194ba mgo'i maṇa gdang ring mo'i ched brjod/ daX rtog yul gyi pho rgyus ched brjod/ naX7dbyi gu'i paṇa thang phuḍa 1121yod pa'i ched brjod/ 21༷dbyi gu maṇa thang smad cha'i ched brjod/ 212

218 ta ru brag snar rdo su bzhings skabs rgyal po 'ba' 'gan gyi gsol 'debs brag la brkos 81da pa/ 31419 ba mgo mkhar gyi bka' 'gyur gser yig gi ched brjod/ 216daX khri rtse dgon pa'i 'og gi ma ṇi'i ched brjod/ 21821 khri rtse jo mo lha khang gi ldebs ris kyi ched brjod/ nanaX22 dngul 'bigs brag gi ched brjod/ 2222 ha nu kug ra lung pa'i brag gi ched brjod/ 22224 ha nu pa tra'i brag gi ched brjod/ 2na 25 bye thang maṇi'i ched brjod/ 22825 slob grwa'i mdun thang la yod pa'i maṇi'i ched brjod/ 22927 ba mgo'i bka' 'gyur gser bris ma'i ched brjod/ na na28 ba phu mkhar gyi brag la brkos yod pa'i ched brjod/ na da29 shel rdo rje chen mo'i lha khang gi mdun du rdo'i khar bris pa'i ched brjod/ na 4(ngas shogatag) ༷ chos rgyal tshe dpal don grub rnam rgyal gyis togapa 'o gag cig pa'i mes po bsod nams ba na 'dzin la gnang ba'i bka' shog na 5 1 mi dbang sa skyong tshe dbang rnam rgyal gyis asnyi mkhar gzhung pa bsod nams g.yang 'byor la stsal pa'i bka' yig gos chen khar bris yod pa'i bka' shog gi 'dra bzhus ngo ma/ 24༷

dkudan rgyal mo nyi zla dbang mos a lci pa bkrashis dpal 'byor la stsal pa'i bka' 3tshog 246da rgyal po tshe brtan rnam rgyal gyis 'o gcig bseld nams bstan 'dzin la stsal bapa'i bga' shog/ 247da4 rgyal po tshe dpal don grub rnam rgyal gyis rtog pa 'o ma gcig pa'i don grub tshe ring la gnang ba'i bka' shog ngo ma'i 'dra bzhus/ 24955 rgyal po 'jigs med dgra 'dul gyis tog 'o ma gcig pa'i dka' chen ye shes don grub la stsal pa'i bka' shog 351da6 rgyal po tshe brtan rnam rgyal gyis gnyer pa bsod nam g.yang 'byor la gnang ba'i bka' shog 25237 la dwags dgon tshogs kyi gan rgya 25538 lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i rnam thar/ dka' chen blo bzang bzod pa/ 258da9 mang spro'i rgyal rabs mu stag gi chun po/ rig 'tsho 'angayodabyangs rgyal mtshan/ 27140 5 gsung thugs kyai rten sogs bzhings tho dkar chag ched brjod/ 294
— cho

1pod kyi rgyal po'i gdung rabs padma dkar po'i phreng ba/༄༄/ /rgya gar skad du/ bho ḍa rā dzā ṅgā tu puṇḍa rig mā lā nā ma/ bod skad/ bod rgyal po'i gdung rabs padma dkar po'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba/'di snermen pa ser skya nas bzhugs pa'i tshe shākya rnams gang las skyes/ming gang yin/ sdon gyi rigs rgyud gang yin/ zhes dri na/ ji skad lung bstan tshul ston pa la zhus pas/ ston pas shākya'i rigs rgyud bshad na/ mu stegs pa rnams bdag nyid la bstod kyis shes pa'i gnas su gyur to/ /moṅgal gyis zhus pas/ de ston du gzhug go snyam ste/tshosal gyi bu nga rgyab bsnyung bas re zhig de bsal gyi khyod gyis sngon gyi rigs rgyud las brtsam sa te spobs par gyis shig des cang mi smra bas khas blangs te/ sprelan pa snam sbyar bltabs te 'phangs sngas su bcug ste mnal to/ /tshothol gyi bus shākya'i sdon gyi rigs rgyud mthong ba'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs nas/ de las langs te stan bshams pa la 'dug nas shākya rnams la smras pa bzhin/ thog ma'i rgyal po rnams nas rim par lung bstan pa ltar 'byung ba la/

2gaṅga'i rgyun bzang ma'ichad legs spel ba'i//ston pa'i lung khyab dkar chag 'di na'o//skyon min yon tan rdzogs pa thub pa'i sku//shākya'i rgyal po khye1da la phyag 'tshal 'e1//snying rje'i sprin dkar ljon pa'i skyed tshal na//mgon po'i 'brug sgra gzhan gsos skad snyan sgrogs//lcesgros char sa ha ka ra'i zegs ma bsil//spyan ras gzigs mgon gdengs can rgyal gyur cig/ kun khyab dbyings su bdun gyi bdun (rta bdun 'dus)pas rnam par rngotshol pa'i dpal gyis mdzes//chu gter zla ba ri gling skye 'gro'i rtsi bcud sman rdzongs smin la dga'//sbrang rtsi dog pa ci yang bskrun zhing 'dab stong tshal mang bskyed pa'i gnyen//lhag pa'i lha mchog 'dram dbyangs nang gi nor bus rtag par skyong bar mdzod//

legs byas mchod sbyin brgya phrag bcu yi bskuld nams 'bras//dus gsum mthong ba'i ye shes 'dren byed stong gis brgyan//khri phrag sred med stobs kyis mi bzod sgra brgya'i lan//nam mkha'i ral pas bsten pa'i mthu stobs dbang pos mchod//rgya bod kun tu mkhas rnams gyis//shākya'i rgyal rabs rnam mang spel//sgyubadag kyang legs bshad de rnams kyis//rjes 'brang bdud rtsi batron (sgron)la spro//zhes dang /skyes snermebs sbyangs pa'i 〈sna gros gsal snan pas//gsung rab don gyi dbang 'di kho bos mthong //bstod pas ro 'dzin don ldan sgrub pa na// bzung nas dga' zhing spyi bo bsten par gyis// bka' dang bstan bcos rin chen dbyings las 'ongs//sa skyong 'bum phrag rigs rgyud phun tshogs rnams/ /

4rnam snang gsal byed 'od can bdud rtsi'i phreng / / spel legs skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan bri bar bya//( spyir chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing / brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa lags na'ang gang zag rgyud smin pa dang ma smin pa'i dbang gis kun rdzob sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul nam mkha' tharmas cad khyab pa/ snod bcud kyi 'jig rten dbyibs dang kha dog sna tshogs su snang ba/bsam gyis mi khyagapa lags na'ang /mdzod phas nyi zla bye ba phrag brgyar rnam phye ba'i//theng bzhi pad tshal ther 'bum dkrigs palas//khor yug zlugapos bsgor ba bzod pa sde/ /shāka thub ming gi rnam grangs rnam snang bzhugs//zhes dang /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho rgyal gyi phyag gi lhung bzed kyi nang du/ stong gsum mi marjed 'di ji ltar chags

5pa'i tshul ni/ gzhung ltar mang du grags kyang mdor bsdus na/ yon tan rin po che sdud pa las mkha' la rlung brten de la chu yi phung po brten//de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro ba 'di dag brten//sems can las la spyod pa'i rgyu ni de 'dra ste//(nam mkha' gang la gnas yin don 'di bsamang ra gyis//)gasku1 'gul rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis mas btegs//dga' bde chu'i dkyil 'khor gyis kun bsdus//rtag spyod me yi dkyil 'khor gyis drod phab//snang ba nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyis sgo phye//dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi ni rgya che la khod stoms/ khong yangs la mtha' med pa'i dgung sdon pos g.yab phub/ mdog mi 'gyur ba ni dbus kyi ri rgyal lhun pos mnan/ gling bzhi mtha' nas mi byer ba 'byung ba lnga'i gter btsugs/ nam la dang dus tshod bzhi mi 'gyur ba ni srid pa'i rgyal rmetsho bzhes tshod bzung nas sems can dmyal ba'i bar du chags pa yin no//

6de yang 'dzam bu gling pa'i tshe lo brgyad khri pa'i tshe na dmyal bar sems can gcig skyes pa yin/ de ltar bcud kyi sems can chags pa'i yun la bar bskal bcu dgu 'gor ba yin no/ /de rnams kyi rgyu rkyen gang gang gis byung ba dang / tshad ci tsam yod pa dang / gling bzhi gling phran brgyad la sogs pa'i rnam bshad rgyas pa mngon pa mdzod las shes par bya'o//de ltar phyi sdod kyi 'jig rten mas nas yar chags nang bcud kyi sems can rnams yar nas mar babs pa'i tshul ni/ 'od gsal gyi lha tshe dang bsod nams dman pa/ lha nam rgyar rgyal po ye mkhyen chen po bya ba lags skad/ de'i bu lha srid bor chen po/ de'i bu lha nam bor chen po/ de'i bu lha 'od gsal/ de'i bu lha khar gsal/ de'i bu lha char byed/ de'i bu lha par lha bdun tshigs/ de'i bu rgyal srid bya ba la bu brgyad skyes pa'i nangs kyai phu bo lha skar chen dang / skar gnyis rogs shar lus 'phags por babs/ de'i 'og ma 'od chen dang 'od la rogs gnyis/ byang sgra mi snyan du babs/ de'i 'og ma sman bu dang spun la rogs gnyis nub ba lang spyod du babs/ de'i nangs ri rab kyai lgo

7phyogs/ beeḍūrya sngon mo'i 'od kyis khyab pa stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i lo tsho(gnas)/ thar lam bgrod pa'i gling rdo rje gdan/ byang chub kyi snying po can/ zhing rta'i dbyibs su snang ba/ gling gi snying po/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gzhegs pa 'byung ba'i gnas 'dir zhin tu nyams dga' bar rtogs te/ lha zhed can dang / shed la rogs gnyis babs setho/dus de'i tshe na mi la yon tan bcu dang ldan pa yin te/ rang lus la 'od dang ldan pas/ nyin mtshan gyi ming yang med/ lus la nad med pas/ zerdo shin tu ring / khams kyi zas la mi 37sa pas/ khams gso ba la mi ltos pa dang / nyon mongs pa med pas/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa/ pho mo'i ming yang med pa/dgra gnyen med pa/ nor gsog 'jog med pa/ spyod lam thams cad lha 'i lugs su yod do//de'i dus lha shed bu'i spyi bor lnga ba gcig byung / de brdol pa sa mi dkar po gcig byung / de rgyal rigs su byas lkog ma nas mi dmar po gcig byung / de bram ze'i rigs su byas/ snying ka nas mi

8ser po gcig byung / de rje rigasasu byas/ bol gong nas mi nag po gcig byung / de (ming )dmangasarigs su byas so//de'i tshe rgya gar ba'i mi rigs yin no/ /nu bo shed la rogs las chad pa ni/ gying gi sring dang / gnod sbyin gdong dmar ba gnyis/gying gi sring la yang bu gnyis/ phu po rlung rje pham pa'i rgyud ni/kha che/ bal yul/ za hor/ u rgyan/ stag gzig khrom ge sar/'dan ma/ sna nam/ sgon mi/ gru gu/ rag zhi la setregs pa gi' rigs/ mi'u rigs bzhi'i zhang po yin no//nu bo brog srin la bu gnyis/ phu bo thong rje thon pa dang / nu bo spre'u pu stang ngo / /spre'u pu stang la 'bog chol gyi mi sde bco brgyad de las chad pa thang (mtha')khob dgu bcu rtsaganyis su chad do/ /phu bo thong rje thon pa la bu gnyis / phu bo 'thong mi skyen pa dang nu bo 'brong rje ya ded gnyis/ nu bo las chad pa yang mtha' khob drug cu'i mi lags skad/phu po 'brong mi skyin pa la bu bzhi/ nangs kyai pho bo smra/ zhang zhung gi mes pho skyon pa thang rje/ de'i 'og ma se 'a zha'i mes po gleng sher thang rje/

9de'i 'og ma tong gsum pa'i mes po/ ting rje 'u ra/ tha chung ldong mi nyag gi mes po sku rje khug pa dang bzhi'o//bzhi po de las mi3 rigs phal cher rgyas sel/ /sku rje khug pa la sras bzhi sne/ sku gzugs kyi thog ta dang / dmad ma rje dang / gur bu rtsi dang / khab rje dang bzhi ste/ sku gzugs kyi 'og ta la bu gsum/rtse mi dang / rje dang / rje mi dang gsum/ dmad ma rje la bu lnga / khra mo dang / rtsogs mi dang / drag rje dang / zas rje dang / zhabs rje btsan dang lnga sne/gur bu rtsi la bu lnga ste/ yang rje ring rje/ sgon rje dang / ya sa dang / rtsod dkar rje dang lnga / rgyal rigs yin/ blon rigs la/ldong po che yongs tu dang / ya chen ldong / nam chen ldong dang / thog rgyud ldong dang bzhi'o//rje rigs la/ thog rgyud ldong gis chung ma drug blangs pas bu bco brgyad skyes/ de la ldong rus chen bco brgyad dang / nyos ljong la selags pa mi rigs bsacasagyis mi khyab pa zhig chad do//

10de yang spyir 'dzam gling na yul chen po lnga/ mtha' khogadrugacu rtsaganyis/ yang khob bcu drug 'bog 'chol gyi mi sde chen po ba co brgyad/ rgyal phran phramo nyi shu rtsabazhi/ 'o skol gyi lgo 'dzam bu gling na mchis sel / de yang dbus ri rab kyi lto phyogs/ 'dzam bu gling sogs kha'i yu ba/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan byang chub kyi snying po can der/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsaganyis kyi 'phrin las mdzad pa/ 'khor 'dzi bsgar ba'i rgyal po rnams kyi che ba dben tsam gcig brjod na/ 'khor pho basnrur rgyal rin po che sgo nga las skye zhing / gnas ni ri rab kyi khog gal gnas/ dus ni sangs rgyas re re'i (ba)ston pa la byon tsan/de'i cha rkyen du byon/ lha mi'i grong bdun gyi mi ni/ ri mu khyud 'dzin gyi rtse khog la gnas/ bdud rtsi za zhing bcud la spyod/me tog sbubs gnas kyi mi ni/ dpag bsam gyi me tog las skyes nas shing tog la spyod/bdud rtsi bcud 'thungs kyi mi ni/ shing 'dzam bu (1 )brikasha'i yal ga las skyes te/ 'tham bu brikasha'i khu ba la spyod do// ri

11mi'am ci ma bzhi ste/ ja ljon pa'i me tog gi 'bras bu bza'/rgya mtsho'i kha zhag 'thungs/ sdig btsugs mtshon thogs srin po rnams dang 'thab mo byed/ zas su sha dang khrag za/ skyes drug byis pa g.yar ldan grod la skyes/ dgun na 'chi/ mgo gnyan ni/ mi lus dud 'gro sna tshogs kyi mgo bo zas sa rtsa shun bza' yin gling chung mtsho na gnas rbes sirsha 4skye gnas bzhi la/ lho 'dzam bu gling pa mngal las skyes/ shar lus 'phags po drod gsher las skyes/ nub ba lang spyod sgo nga las skyes/ byang sgra mi snyan pa brdzus te skyes so//mtshams kyi mi'u rigs bzhi ni/ gam shang rgya/ gyigashang hor/ha lo pon/ spu rgyal bod dang bzhi'o//nang gi mi'u rigs bzhi la/ smra zhang zhung / gtong gsum pa/ldong mi nyag so 'a zha dang bzhi'o/ /'khyal ba'i mi'u rigs bzhi la/dred rgyal rigs nas 'khyal/ spre'u rje rigs nas 'khyal/ rmig pa mang rigs nas 'khyal/ rtsangs pa bram ze'i rigs na 'khyal/ zhes pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig chags pa yin no //

12gzhan yang rgyal khams nyi shu rtsabazhi dang / rigs nas 'khyal gamang du byung ngo / /dus de'i tshe bdud rtsi'i bcud zhes bya ba/ kha dog dmar ser/ ro sbrang rtsi 'dra ba zhig byung bas/ de lha shed bus myangs/zhim po tshor nas yang dang yang du spyad pas/ de la kun gyis kyang de'i rjes su 'brangs nas bldags pas/ ༷/sa sra ba dang / lci ba la 31gas par gyur te/ lus kyi 'od nyams pa dang / nam mkha' la 'gro mi nus pa dang / mun par gyur te myangan byed pa'i tshe/ spyi mthun gyi las kyi bsod nams kyis shed can gyi sku ring la nyin mo'i snang ba me shel gyi nyi ma byung / de dang dus mnyam du shed rogs kyi sku ring la mtshan mo'i snang ba chu shel gyi zla ba byung / shed bu'i sku ring la dgu tshigs byung /de'i tshe zas de mang du zos pa rnams mdog ngan la/ nyung ngu zos pa rnams mdog bzang bas/ nga ni mdog bzang la/ khyod ni mdog ngan no/ /zhes nga rgyal gyi nyon mongs pa rnams rtsomapa'i thog ma de yin no//de dag kyang nga rgyal de'i rnam smin gyis sa'i bcud de nub pa dang /de kun 'dus te mya ngan byas pa dang / sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyis/sa chen po 'di'i steng du/ sa'i zhag ro phun sum tshogs pa/ kha dog

3dong ga'i me tog lta bu byung ste/ de yang za ba dang myang ba na khyad sod kyai bar sngar bzhin byas pas/ de yang nub bo//de la yang kun 'dus te mya ngan byas pas/ sems can gyi sbyi mthun gyi las kyis/ sa chen po 'di'i steng du/ myu gu'i tshal zhes bya ba/ ro sbrang rtsi ma bskol pa lta bu dang / kha dog ka dam phu ga'i me tog lta bu gcig byung ngo / /de la yang za ba dang myang ba nas/ khyad sod kyi bar sngar zhin byas pas de yang nub par gyur to//de nas mi rnams snarshakas nas mya ngan byed pa la/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje dang / spyi mthun gyi bsod nams las grub pa'i g.yos pa'i lo tog 'bras sa lu'i tshal zhes bya ba/ shun pa dang phub gamed pa/ nangs brngas na nangs skye/ nub brngas na nub skye/ 'bras bu snye ma re re la yul gag lha'i bre bzhi bzhi gang ba/ ldog pa re re la sor bzhi bzhi yod pa/ de la yun ring du longs spyod par byed pa'i tshe/ zas de snga ma bas rags pa yin pas bshang lci (gci )dang / snabs lud la sogs byung bas skyes pa dang bud med kyai dbang po dag byung ngo //

4de dag gis gcig gis gcig la mig tshugs su bltas pas log par zhugs nas/ de sems can gzhan dag gis mthong nas/sems can gyis sems can la 'o ga par zhugs so/ /zhes zer zhing /rdo dang / sog ma 'phen par byed pas/ de mi mthong bar bya ba'i phyir/ngo tsha'i khang bu brtsigs pas khyim rtsig pa'i thog gde yin no//deng yang lha mi'i rjer gyur rgyal rigs la rgyas par phye na/gsum brgya drug cu yod/ de la bsdus pa rnam pa gnyis bzhad do//dag pa sangs rgyas rje dang / ma dag sems can rje/ sangs rgyas rje ni sku gsung 'gro don mdzod/ sems can rje la rnam pa lngar phye nas/ stong gsum dbang byed spyi phud rgyal po dang / sa 'dzin rgyal po phyogs skyong rgyal po dang / rigs drug rgyal po 'dzam gling rgyal po dang lnga'o//de yang stong gsum gyi mi marjed kyai rgyal po shākya thub pa stong spyi phud kyi rgyal po lha tshangs pa/ phyogs skyong rgyal po rgyal chen rigs bzhi dang / /rigs drug rgyal po gzhin rje chos rgyal dang / /'dzam gling gdung rgyud rgyal po mang bkur rgyud/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal spyi bo skyes la sogs/ /gser dngul zangs lcags dbang sgyur rgyal po yin/

5 yang dbus ri rab kyi lgo phyogs 'dzam bu gling sogs kha'i yu ba/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ byang chubasnying po can der / bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsaganyis (gcig)kyi 'phrin las mdzad sa/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rnams kyi che ba dbyen tsam zhig brjod na/ de yang mkhas pa rnams kyi chos 'byung rnams dang / rgyal rabs che chung rnams las rgyal rigs gsumabargya drug cu yod par bzhad kyang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgyal po dang / ga'adas pa'i rgyal po gnyis su 'dus/ 'jig rten las 'das pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams la dbang byed cing / srid pa la dbang thob nas 'jig rten rtogs pa'i yul las 'das pas na/ shākya thub pa lta bu'o//'jig rten las ma 'das pa'i rgyal po la lnga ste/ bemapo'i rgyal po/ rigs can gyi rgyal po/ bskos pa'i rgyal po/ sde med pa'i rgyal po/ spu rgyal bod kyi rgyal po dang lnga'o/ /de yang bem po'i rgyal po lnga ni/ri'i rgyal po/ shing gi rgyal po/ chu'i rgyal po/ me'i rgyal po dang /rlung gi rgyal po dang lnga'o//

6de la dang po ri'i rgyal po ri rgyal lhun po rin po che sna lnga las grub cing / steng nas 'og tu dpag tshad 'bugaphrag drug khri yod/ steng lha par lha srin/ 'og 'chi bdag rgyal po'i pho brang / 81gas la rgyal chen bzhi'i bzhugs gnas/ gza' dang sgyu skar rnams kyis bsgor ba byed pa de/ ri'i rgyal po'o//shing gi rgyal po ni/ dpag bsam gyi shing ste/ lha rnams kyis dga' bde'i spyod cing / zas gos thams cad de las 'byung bas na/shing gi rgyal po dang /chu'i rgyal po ni/ rgya mtsho chen po yin te/ 'thungs na lto ba dang mgrin pa gang la yang mi gnod/ klu'i rgyal po rnams kyi bzhugs gnas nor bu rin po che rnams kyai 'byung sa yin pas na/ chu'i rgyal po/me'i rgyal po ni/ bskal pa'i me dpung yin te/ me 'bar ba'i dus na/ bsam gtan gnyis pa man chad sreg par byed/ thur du 'bar bas dmyal khams gser gyi sa gzhi chu dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor steg cing / ri rgyal lhun po yang 'jig nus pa de/ me'i rgyal po/

17rlung gi rgyal po ni/ stong gsum 'degs byed kyi rlung yin te/sems can rnams kyi las dbang las grub cing 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir gnas te/ de'i rngams su dpag tshad sa ya drug 'bum/ rgyar grangs med rlung gi stobs kyis chu'i dkyil yang thur du mi 'jiga'atshogs la mi ga81 bas na/ rlung gi rgyal po/gnyis pa rigs can gyi rgyal po la gnyisate/ mi ma yin pa'i rgyalapo dang / mi'i rgyal po'o// mi mayin pa la'ang lnga ste/ lha dang lha min/ dud 'gro/ dmyal ba/ yi dwags dang lnga 'o//dang po lha'i rgyal po dbang po brgya byin yin te/ gzhan la khyad par 'phags shing / mig stong dang ldan pa/ stobs dang rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa/ nye dbang dang rgyal chen bzhi/ rgya mtsho'i klu rnams kyi dpung byed cing srung bar byed pa/ de lta bu ni/ lha'i rgyal po'o/ /gnyis pa lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thags bzang ris yin te/ rin po che sna bzhi'i go cha lus la gon te/ mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs shing /lha dang 'dra zhing / lha rnams la 'thab cing rtsod pas na/ lha ma yin gyi rgyal po'o//

8gsum pa dud 'gro'i rgyal po glang po sa srung yin te/ mgo chu shel 'dra ba mche ba drug pa/ glang po che de la rdzing bu bdun bdun/— rirdzing bu re la sdong bu bdun bdun/ sdong bu re la padma bdun bdun / de lta bu'i glang po che de la lus dpag tshad phyed dang gsum/ bang ni bskal pa 'jig pa'i rlung las mgyogs/ g.yul ngor zhugs na lha ma yin rnams kyang zlog par byed pa de/ dud 'gro'i rgyal po'o//bzhi pa yi dwags kyi rgyal po las kyi gzhin rje yin te/ ri rab kyai smad lcags mkhar sgo med kyi nang du/ 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas/ bsam pa tsam gyis gang 'dod kyi gnas su phyin cing / lcer bu'i lus la gsod gcod kyai sgra sgrogs shing / khams gsum zas su zos kyang mi 'grangs pa de/ yi dwags kyai rgyal po'o//lnga pa dmyal ba'i rgyal po ni/ bzhin rje chos rgyal yin te/'dzagabu gling nas sa 'og dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu bcal pa'i 'og na/a ba glang mgo can dang / stag mgo can gyis gtso byas pa las byed sprul pa'i pho nya mang po 'gyed cing / zangs rgyal po khro chu khol ma lcags kyi shal ma ri'i sdong po/ ral sgra'i so lta bu/ chu bo rab med la sogs

19par sems can sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa la 'jug pa de/ dmyal ba'i rgyal po'o/ /de nas sdelabs che ba mi'i rgyal po la mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad lugs mi 'dra ba mang du sku1da kyang / ma yos pa'i lo thog 'bras sa lu de snga dro'i bza' rgyu snga dro/ phyi dro'i za rgyu phyi dro len gyin yod tsan bol gong nas byung ba'i mi dang / gnod sbyin gdong dmar ba gnyis gyis zhag bcu dang zla ba phyed kyi 'tsho rgyags kyi phyir bshas 'thab mo byas pas/med par song nas skyer ma 'dod do// de nas mi rnams kyis sa lu ma rmos par mi skye bar 'dug pas/sa gzhi bgo bar byed do zhes te/ sa mtshams bcad de so sor bgos so/ /'di nas mar la zhing bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / mu tshigs bral ba'i las kyi mgo brtsams pa'i thog ma de yin no/ /de nas mi rnams kyis sa lu btab (gdab)dgos zer nas sa la btabs/ sa bon 'debs pa'i thog ma de yin no/ /de ltar btabs kyang la las btus nas zos/ la las dngos su 'phrogs/ la las rang la sku1da kyang gzhan gyi de kun brkus nas zos pas/ bdag pos de mthong nas/ khyod rang

20gi 'tshod bzhin du gzhan gyi sa lu gabyin par len pa mi rigasaso/ /zhes smras pas/ ngas ma khyer ces rdzun zer pas/ gzhi de 'khartsod pa dang / sheg pa dang / gabyin par len pa dang / rdzun du smra gdang /srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i mgo brtsams pa'i dang po de yin no/ /de la sogs pa'i rtsod pa grangs mang du byung ba dang thams cad gros byas nas da ni 'o skol gyi nang nas mi legs nyes kyi shan 'byed pa/ brtson 'grus dang snying stobs che ba/ thams cad la byams shing spyi stoms che bar spyod pa/ smra ba thams cad la mkhas zhing tshod rig pa gcig zhing dpon du bsgo dgos zer nas zhing pa thams cad kyi thog nas shas phul nas skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bkur bas/ de la mang pos bkur ba/ zhes mtshan gasdutshol nas sems can rnams bde zhing skyed do//de yang mdzod lasaḥle 81sa gsog 'jog byas nas ni//'dzin chags rnams gyis zhing dpon bstabs//zhing dang sa lu ma byin par len pa rnams la skyob par byed pa la rgyal rigs dang / chos kyi skye dgu skyong ba'i tshul khrims dang / shes

2/raganyams su blangs te gnas pa la rgyal po zhes smras so/ /mtshan yang mngacasabakurapo' rgyasapo zhes bya'o//dus skabs 'di tsam nas mi rigs bzhi'am lngar gyur pa yin te/de yang gsar no sna bdun la sngon ni 'di dag thams cad kyi//las dang bya ba'i khyad par las /rigs ni bzhi'am lnga ru gyur//zhes pa ltar/dzo sems can de dag dge ba bcu spyod cing / khrus dang gtsang sbra la dga' ba rnams bramaze'i rigs su gyur to/ /dge bcu spyod cing / ngo tshozhes/ shes rab che ba/ snying rus che ba rnams rje rigs zhes bya'o/ /mi dge ba bcu 'bab 'chol du spyod cing / ngo tshachung ba/ sdig la mi 'dzems pa/ rdzun du smra ba rnams la ming (dmangs )rigs zhes bya'o/ /de dag las kyang khrel dang ngo tsha shin tu chung ba/ mi dge ba bcu la sogs pa 'jig rten na shin tu slad pa'i dam pa'i spyod pa dang 'gal bar byed pa rnams la rdol pa rigs ngan zhes bya'o//

22rgyal po mang po bkur ba'i sras 'od mdzes/ de'i ring la gza' dang skar ma byung / de'i sras dge ba/ de'i ring la 'od dmarawa byung /de'i sras dge mchog de'i ring la sgra brnyan dang brag cha byung / de'i dus su tshe lo dgu khri thub/ de'i sras gso sbyong 'phags/ de'i ring cho'akha 'brug gi sgra byung / rgyal po de lnga la/ bskal pa dang po'i rgyal po sde lnga zer/gso sbyong 'phags la sras 'khora'adzi sgyur ba'i rgyal po rnams 'khrungs pa'i snga ltas spyi bor sha rmen cig byung / de brdol pa'i nang nas khye'u gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa lta na sdug pa/ sems can thams cad la byams pa/ mtshan dang ldan pa gcig byung sde/ yab kyi spyi bo las skyes pas spyi bo skyes zhes ming btags skul//rgyal po de'i rin po che sna bdun ni/ 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ rin po che bdun dang / gzhan yang dmag dpon rin po che'i tshab tu khyimabadag rin po che bdun dang / zas gos kyi char phagaste/ 'dzam bu gling du lo brgyad

23khri lon nas/ gnod sbyin lha shel gyis bskul nas/ 'khor lo rin po ches sna drangs btsun mo 'khor dang bcas pa nam mkha' la se nga nas/shar dang / nub dang / byang dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i bar du rgyal srid byas te/ de lta na'ang 'dod chen gyis gdungs te/ sdug bsngal bas/brgya byin tha ma de la ngan sems skyes pas/ bsku da nams zad pas lus de nyid du sa la lhung ste grongs par gyur to//rgyal po 'dis sems can rnams kyi mtshan nyid la brtag cing /bzo bo'i gnas dang las kyi bye brag mang po byas pa yin no/ /de dus su tshe 'i brgyad khri thub/ spyi bo skyes kyi phrag pa g.yas su sha rmen las khye'u gcig byung / ming mdzes pa can/ zhes bya'o/ /gser gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gling bzhi la dbang ngo //mdzes pa'i phrag pa g.yon par sha rmen las khye'u gcig byung /ming nyi mdzes zhes bya'o/ /dngul gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gling gsum pa la dbang ba yin no/ /nyi mdzes kyi brla g.yas par sha rmen las khye'u gcig byung / ming mdzes can zhes bya'o/ /zangs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gling gnyis la dbang ba yin no/ /

24mdzes can gyi brla g.yon par sha rmen las khye'u gcig byung /ming mdzes ldan du btags/ lcags kyai 'khelar 'tshos bsgyur ba gling gcig la dbang ba yin no/ /de'i dus su tshe pho bdun khri thub/ de lnga la stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po sde lnga zer/mdzes ldan gyi sras rgyal byed/ de'i sras mdzes dga'/ de'i sras mi srod pa/ de'i sras btang bzung / de'i dus su tshe pho drug khri thub/ dus tshod dge ba rnams de'i dus su byung ngo //rgyal po btang bzung gi dus su sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig ston par byon to/ /btang bzung gi sras lus stobs ser thub yin no//de'i gdung rabs stong phrag dgu nas rgyal po rgyal byed chen po'i dus su sangs rgyas gtsug tor can ston par byon/ de nas gdung rabs stong dang rgya phrag gnyis nas rgyal po me sde ldan zhes bya ba byung / de'i bu dang tshobo rgyud kyi rgyal rabs 'bum tshor rgyal rigs mnga' thang du tshil dbang byas so/ de'i dus su tshe 'e1 bzhi khri thub/ sangs rgyas thams cad skyob ston par byon/ de nas gdung rabs stong phrag bdun nas rgyal po bzod pa dka' zhes bya ba byung / de'i dus su tshe 'tsho gsum khri thub/

25sangs rgyas log par dad sel ston par byon/ chos spyod rgyud gsungs/de nas gdung rabs 'bum dang drug khri nas rgyal po glang chen spyi byung /de dus tshe lo nyi khri thub/ de'i dus su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser thub byon/ de nas gdung rabs 'bum dang khri tsho lnga nas rgyal po kri kri zhes bya ba byung / tshe lo khri lnga dang lnga stong thub/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs ston par byon/ chos rnal 'byor rgyud gsungs/ kri kri'i sras legs skyes/ de'i (gdung )rgyud brgya tham pa nas yul gru 'dzin du rgyal po rna ba can zhes bya ba byung / de la bu gnyis go'utam dang / bhā ra :rdoganyis/ che ba go'uta gni/ yab chos dang chos ma yin pa 'dres pa'i rgyal srid byed pa mthong nas bdag kyang rgyal srid bzung na 'di ltar 'gyur snyam nas thugs skyo ste/ drang srong mdog nag las rabatu byung ngo /chung ba lhar nāthayis rgyal srid byas so/ /de'i tshe yul de na slad tshong ga'agro gabazang mo zhes bya ba gcig yod pa la skyes bu g.yo mā padma'i rtsalag dang gcis dga' mgur spyod kyin yod pa la/ de'i bar la tshong pa gzhan zhig dang 'dod log spyad pas/ padma'i rtsalag

26 khros nas bzang mo'i mde| bcad nas khrag gis 'atre(sa pa'i ral gri dang bzang mo'i mgo gnyis go'uta ma'i phug sgor bzhag pa dang / chad pa bcad pa'i mi rnams kyis rjes nas bstegs pas/ khrag gis 'ashesas pa'i ral gri dang bzang mo'i mgo de na yod pas/ de'i chad pa go'u ta ma la phog nas/ bsal shing la bskyon to//de'i tshe drang srong mdog nag gis mngon par shes pasamakhyen nas/ go'u ta pa'i rtsabar phyin/ bu khyod kyis 'di lta bu myong ba'i las ci byas/ gsungs pa dang / mkhan po nga la nyes pa ci yang med/ nyes pa med pa'i bden tshig gis mkhan po'i zhal gser bzhin du gyur cig smras pas/ de ma thag drang sgong mdog nag po'i zhal gser bzhin du gyur pas/ de phyin chad drang srong gser mdog tu grags so//de nas drang srong gis go'u ta yodang chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud chad par gzigs nas go'u ta yol khyod kyi gdung rgyud kyai phyir sa bon cig zhogs gsungs pas/ be|'u ta ma na re/ bdag sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas gdungs nas gdung rgyud bzhag pa'i nus pa med zhus pas/blob dpon gyis sgrin bsdus bsil bar byas pas/ go'u ta mal bde

27ba'i nyams skyes nas khu ba thigs pa gnyis khrag dang 'dres pa byung bas bu ra shing gi lo ma gnyis su bzhag pas/ nyi ma'i drod dang zla ba'i bcud kyis smon pas khye'u gnyis byung ngo / /de gnyis kyi ming la bu ragashing pa dang / nyi ma'i gnyen du ming btags so//nyi ma'i gnyen rab tu byung / bu ram shing pa rgyal po byas so//sras mang du 'khrungs te/ bu ram shing pa'i rgyud ces mang du grags te gang bar gyur to/ /de'i bu rgyud brgya tham dzinas rgyal po 'phags skyes po bya gabyung / de'i btsun mo che ba la sras bzhi ste/ chung ba la sras mo bzhi byung ba dang / dus gzhan zhig na/ de'i btsun mo gnyis grongs nas pharol rgyal po zhig gi bu mo blangs pas/ de na re/ khyod la bu yod pa de dag rgyal sring la mi dbang bar gal te nga'i bu mo la bu byung na/rgyal srid la bzhag dgos zer padang / der rgyal blon rnams gros byas /bo'iri :rdo1 (res /spro la tsho /sku3ni /lha rbesgo /spre/nas bu la bu nga yang sa/ gal byung rung ga na gson mi shes/ gson na rgyal srid bzhag dgos par gros byas nas btsun mo blangs so//

28de la sras gcig 'ikhrungs/ rgyal srid dga' zhes btags so//de'i tshe rmedzin po rnams kyi bsam pa la/ phu bo rnams rgyal srid la ma bzhag na ni/ phu bo rnams kyai ngo bsrung dgos pas/ da ni thabs kyis phu bo rnams sprug par bya snyamonas tā(na po ga81 can zhig gis phra ma zhus nas sprugs sdu1// dhede rnams kyang sring mo rnams khrid de/ chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram/ drang srong ser skya'i gnas dang ha cang mi ring ba'i nags khrod cig tu rtswa'i spyil po'i gnas btaganas 'dug go de nas de dag lang tsho rgyas pas/ skya bo seng seng por gyur nas drang srong gis mthong nas dris pas/ de rnams na re/ bdag cag rnams 'dod chags kyis gdungs nas 'di ltar gyur smras pas/ de lta na khyod rnams rang gi gagacig pa'i sring mo spong la/ mas dben pa'i sring mo rnams dang lhan cigartse (ba la )dgos gsungs pas/ de dag na re/ drang sgong chen po de ltar bgyid rung ngam zhus pas/ shes ldan dag rgyal rigs rgyal srid spangs pa rnams kyis de ltar rung ngo gsungs pas/ de rnams kyis drang srong gi tshig tshad ma yin no/ /zhes de ltar byas pas/ bu dang bu mo

29mang po btsas pas/ yab kyis gsan nas/ gzhon nu rnams kyis de ltar byed phod pa zhes smras pas/ rgya gar skad du shākya shākya zhes byas te/shākya rtsomapa'i dang po de yin no//de'i bu rgyud lnga khri lnga stong grong khyer ser skyar byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po shing rta bcu pabya ba byung / de'i rgyud nyi shu rtsalnga'i tha ma rgyal po gzhu brtan bya ba byung / de la sras gnyis te/ཿ seṅge 'gram dang / seṅge sgra 'o/ /seṅge 'gram ni phongs skyen par grags te/ 'dzam bu gling gi gzhu thogs thams cad kyi mchog yin no//seṅge 'grama'il sras bzhi ste/ zas gtsang / zas dkar/ bre bo zas/ bdud rtsi zas dang bzhi'o/ /zas gtsang ni gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa/ lta na sdug pa/ stobs che ba/ dpa' ba/ brtan pa/ mkhas shing mdzangs la bsal ba spro ba/ snying stobs che ba/ le lo dang spyod pa ngan pa'i rjes su mi 'gro ba/ chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa/ chos bzhin du rgyal srid byed nus pa yin no//

30rgyal po de la rgyal po legs pa rab sad kyai bu mo sgyu 'phrul modang / sgyu 'phrul chen mo la sogs pa g.yog mo lnga brgya dang bcas blangs so //dus gzhan zhig na/ rgyal po seṅge 'gram grongs nas/ zas gtsang gis rgyal srid mdzod do/ /de'i tshe mi thams cad la 'byor zhing rgyas pa/ mi nad phyugs nad med cing phun sumatshogs pa dang ldan pa/thams cad bu bzhin du bskyangs so// ga dus de'i tshe lha'i bu dgapa tog dkar po rigs dang / yul dang / rus dang / rgyud dang / yum dang lnga la gzigs nas rgyal po zas gtsung gi btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen re'iri lhums su zhugs 31//de yang zla ba bcu zhugs nas mngal gyi dri mas dzigos par dpyid zla tha chung / tshes brgyad/ skar ma rgyal la yum gyi macan khung g.yas pa'i rtsibs bar nas 'khrungs so/ /de ni skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsaganyis dang ldan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa zhig 'dug go /de'i tshe bkrashis pa'i ltas sna tshogs dang / yul chen po bzhir rgyal sras bzhi btsas te/ gag lhar padma chen po'i bu gzugs can snying

31po/ ko sa lar tshangs sbyon gyi bu gsal rgyal/ bsgo lar dmag brgya pa'i bu shar pa/ 'phags rgyal du mu khyud mtha' yas kyi bu gtum po rab snang ngo //gzhan yang ya rabs kyi rigs lnga brgya/ grags 'dzin ma la sogs bu mo brgyad brgya/ 'dun pa la sogs bran lnga brgya/ rti'u khri/ci'u mo khri dang ba glang khri yang skyes so//skyed mo tshal lnga brgya dang / gter lnga brgya yang byung ngo //dbus su byang chub kyi shing skyes pas sras kyi ming la / don thams cad gusapa zhes bya bar btags so/ /de nas rgyal bu yi ge dang rtsis la sogs pa rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing / stobs dang sgyu rtsal gyis lha sbyin la sogs pa'i skye bo dregs pa can rnams thub pas/ shākya thub pa zhes btags 31//de nas sras la btsun mo blang bar zhus pas/gzhon nu na re/'dod pa'i don (skyon )ni bdag gis mtha' yas rig/'thab mo 'khon bcas mya ngan sdug bsngal spa/

32'jigs byed dug gi 'tsha mkha'adra ba ste//me dang 'dra zhing ral sgra'i so dang 'dra//zhes khyem gyi nyes pa mang po gsungs shing / 'on kyang bu mo 'di 'dra gcig byung na blang ngo / /zhes bud med kyi 81na tan yi ger bris te phul pas/ rgyal pos yi ge mdun na 'don par btad de/rgyal rigs bram ze'i bu mo dang //rje rigs ming (dmangs )rigs de bzhin te//su la yon tan 'di yod pa'i//bu mo de ni 'dir stsol cig/nga yi bu 'di rigs dang ni//rus pa mngon par 'dzin ma yin//yon tan bde ba'i chos kyi gnas//nga la 'di yi yid dga' 'o//zhes pa'i yi ge bramakhaze la bskur te btang bas/ brara'ize yul tha dad du phyin nas btsal pas rim gyis sa 'tsho ma mthong nas/ yi ge bstan pas de 'dzum zhing yon tan de bdag la yod ce'o//

33de rgyal po la gsol pas/ rgyal po na re/ bud med 'di rdzun che zhing yid ches med pas/ brtag par bya ba la zhag bdun tshun la bu mo thams cad sdus/ gzhon nus nor ci 'dod pa thams cad ster ro//zhes bsgrags pa dang / bu mo thams cad byung nas yo byad 'ga' zhig zad pa'i skabs su sa 'tsho ma brtol nas 'dzum byas pas bdag gis ci nongs pas ma gos te/ bdag la yo byad med par mdzod zhus pas/gzhon nu yang 'dzum zhing phyag gi sor gdub srang brgya stong ri ba de gnang ngo / /de nas sa 'tsho ma gzhon nu la btsun mor blangs so//gzhan yang grags 'dzin ma la sogs pa btsun mo brgyad khri bzhi stong khab tu bzhes so//de nas gzhon nu pho snyi shu rtsadagu lon dus grags 'dzin mal mngal gyi sems dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nyid kyi lo la skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal bzod grags med pa rnams gzigs te rab tu byung ngo //de nas dgung 'ermo sum cu so lnga bzhes pa'i tshe/ sa ga zla 'i tshes bco lnga la/ srod la bdud btul/ dgung la mnyam par bzhag tho

34rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de'i nub kho na la grags 'dzin ma la khye'u gcig skyes te/ zla ba yang sgra gcan gyis bzung bas/ khye'u'i ming la sgra gcan 'dzin btags so//de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang na re/ shākya thub pa lo drug song /grags 'dzin ma'i bu 'di shākya thub pa'i bu min smras pa dang / grags 'dzin ma ngus nas khye'u de rdzing gi gabong zhig gi khar bor te/ gal te 'di shākya thub pa'i bu ma yin na/ chu'i nang du bying bar gyur cig shākya 'i yiwa rlaste/wawaṃwa wa——6———7wa rdzo gethub pa bu na na chu nga du nga bar ra ga sa bad pas/tshibong de shing gi 'dab ma ltarjo rjes rkeri lteng nas yod pa rgyal po zas gtsang gis gzigs nas yid ches shing dga' nas gos dang bcas pa chu'i nang du zhugs nas pang par blangs te gces par bskyangs so//de yang rab tu byung ste srid pa'i rgyun chad do/ spyir mang pos bkur nas sgra gcan 'dzin yan tshod la rgyal po bum phrag drug cu dang drug khri drug stong lnga brgya bcu gcig bcom ldan 'das yab sras dang bcu gsum byung ngo //

35gnyis pa phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po sde bzhi'i dbang du bgyis na/ri rab kyai shar phyogs grong khyer sgos ldan zhes bya ba na/ dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung zhes bya ba bzhugs pa lags skad/ ji rab kyi smyo phyogs grong khyer bam̐ ḍūrya zhes bya ba na/ grul bum gyi rgyal po 'phags skyes po bzhugs pa lags skad/ ri rab kyi nub phyogs grong khyer rgya mtsho zhes bya ba na/ klu'i rgyal po spyan mig bzang bzhugs palags skad/ri rab kyai byang phyogs grong khyer lcang lo can zhes bgyi ba na/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos sras bzhugs golags skad/ rgyal po chen po de bzhi yang g.yog 'khor dang longs spyod ni mang / chos lugs dang ldan pas/ sems can don la phyogs nas skyong bas na/ phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po zhes bya'o//gsugapa bsgom pa'i rgyal po sde bzhi'i dbang du bgyis na/ shar phyogs skar ma smin drug shar ba'i 'og ri dzā la ya'i khog pa/ 'phags pa 'jim dpal gyi lha rten yod pa/ chu bo pakṣu'i 'gram/ gam shang rgya nag de/ 〈ming srid pa lnga khri/ mni shar gyi lha mo/ khong rang sho lo ru tse/ snye las chad pa'i rigs yin/ bsgo lugs ni/

rgya yi khang pa zhin tu mtho pal//she'a'igyi skas btsugs lcags kyai lham 'tshan nas//gang gis 'dzogs dus gde rgyal por bsko ba yin//'dul ba'i ston pa'aphags pa'angam dpal las su dge/dge sdig gi me phong lta/ skad ni nāgatri ta klu'i skad du pa'o/ /sto phyogs skar thalag sor shar ba'i mgo ri ma la ya'i khog par sangs rgyas stong thams cad kyi lha rten yod pa / chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram/ rgya gar chos kyai mi/ de'i po'i ming srid pa dgu khri/ gni lcagasring sngon mo/khong rang sgom rā dzā/ lha las chad pa'i rigs yin/ bsgo lugs ni/mkhas parnams gyis bzlas bum/ glang po che'i sna la bzhag nas/ de yis bu la dbang bskur ba de rgyal por bsgo ba yin/ ston pa thub pas mdzad/ las su dge ba bcu dang du len/ skad ni sa ta lha'i skad du smra'o//nubazla ba tshes pa'i 'go/ ri ga yikhro'i khog pa na/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyai lha rten yod pa/ chu bo shwalo'i 'gram/ stag gzig nor gyi mi/ de'i phaming lha rgan bdun khri/ gni lha sman sngon mo/

37khong rang kha la ya mun/ gnod sbyin las chad pa'i rigs yin/ bsko lugs ni/ rgya mtsho chen po'i gling nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu sus longs pa de/ rgyal por bsko ba yin/ ston pa ārya 'dzambha lha yin/las su dbul phongs sdug bsngal sel bar byed/ skad ni shag tri gnod sbyin gyi skad du smra'o//byang skar gaspen bdun shar ba'i 'og ri bo 'bigs byed kyi rtsab na/ phyag na rdo rje'i lha rten yod pa/ chu bo sirnyi'i 'gram/ gyigashang hor gyi mi yi tshiming srid pa gsum khri/ ma ni byange btsun sngon mo/ khong rang la he la mi rje/ lha ma yin las chad pa'i rigs yin/ bsgo lugs ni/ dpa' chen bzhis mda' bzhi phyogs bzhir 'phangs nas de dus cig la sus 'dzin nus pa de/ rgyal por bsko ba yin no/ /'dul ba'i ston pa lha mo tsāṇḍa das mdzad/ las su dgra bcom/ skad ni ba su tri ta lha ma yin gyi skad du smra'o//bzhi pa sde med kyi rgyal po ni/ bal po'i rgyal po sgo la ho/ li yul ldan pa'i rgyal po sa la nu/ kha che'i rgyal po la lita ro ta/ rtsami shing mi yi rgyal po bam̐ ro tsan dang bzhi/

38lnga pa rigs rgyud kyi gyel po ni/ skru rgyal bod kyi rgyal po yin/'di bshad pa la lugs mang du mchis te/ rgyal rabs spun po/ gsum khugablon pos brgyan/ gsang ba'am 'bru btus la sogs pa mang du ye da kyang / bsdu na gnyis lags skad bsgrags pa lha rabs bon lugs dang / gsang ba mi rabs chos lugs so/ /gzhung 'di nyid kyi lugs nas dbyen tsalazhig brjod na/ 'o sgol lho 'dzam bu gling gi lte ba/yul gyi dbus pa'i sgang / gangs ri rgyud kyis bskor ba'i ra ba/gangs tai se shel gyi mchod rten gyi ma mtsho gapham g.yu'i maṇḍal gyi 'gram/ chu bo chen po bzhi'i mgo/ rin po che gser gyi 'byung sa/yul bod kyai gling drug ri mtho sa rtsang ba'i gnas 'di la dang po dbang byed rim pa dgu byung zhes gtam brgyud rnams las bshad na'ang bod rgyal bran bcu gnyis kyis gnang ba'i dus su/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gdung rgyud yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la sras lnga mnga' ba'i bar pa bu: shrī zhes pa/ smre ga bya ltar yar 'gebs pa/ rkang lag ngang pa ltar 'brel ba/ smon ma g.yu'i smin ma skyes pa/ dung so 'khor ba cig 'khrungs pas/ bragaze mtshan mkhan la bstan pas/ bram ze na re/

3 9rgyal bu 'di mtshan dang yang ldan/ sku bsod kyang zhin tu che ste/ yab ma grongs gong du rgyal srid byed par 'gyur snyam/ zhes lung bstan pas/yab kyi thugs la nga bsad pa'am/ yang na spun zla bsad nas khos rgyal srid byed par 'gyur snyam nas phyir sprug bsam pa la/ bram ze rnams na re/ rgyal po 'di byang phyogs kha ba can du bskyal na/ sems can la phan thogs par 'gyur/ zhes lung bstan pas/ rkang mdzodags bzhi'i gnya' ba la khri byas nas byang gi ri dang rags bsgral nas bod yul dbus kyi lha ri gyang mtho'i kha la (la khar)bzhag tre(/'di la bzhad lugs mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang mang pos bkur ba go'u ta ma'i rigs rgyud yin pa ni 'dra'o/ /de li ngas pa rnams kyis mthong nas dris pa/ khyed su yin byas pas/ btsan po zer/ gang nas byon byas pas/ skad ni ma shes te/ nam mkha' la mdzub mo bsgrengs so/ /der lings pa rnams kyis yul mi la smras pa/ mi mang po phyin nas bltas pas/ rgyal phran bcu gnyis pa (rgyal sras lo bcu gnyis pa )bzang zhing / dpa' brjid che ba/ yid du 'ong bar mthong nas kun mthun par 'o skol rje med kyi rje ru spyan 'dren dgos zer nas

40btsan khyung dang snubs gnyis/ gnyan tse dang / gar tseganyis/ khu stegs gnyis te/ 'bangs rus drug gis spyan drangs/ ra sangs dar ba dang khyung pos 'khor pa byas/ mi nyan gyi bskon blon po bsgos/ de mgo nag yongs kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol to/ /mtshan yang gnya' ba'i khri la btegs pas/ rje gnya' khri btsan po zhes mtshan gsol to//rin po che'i rgyal sa dam pa/ yul yar lung sogs ka/ sku mkhar phyi dbang stag rtse'i nang bzhugs te/ mnga' thang bka' khrims kyis sku'i rgyan mdzad/ 'jig rten chos bzhin du bskyangs pas rgyal khams bde zhing skyed/ sku srung sde bzhis sku bsrungs rgod ldong mi bzhi bcu rtsabazhis ni phyi'i dgra 'dul/ g.yur ldong sde bzhi bcu rtsabazhis ni nang gi tsha kha snyelams/ sdutsho kha bzhir ni so 'dzugs/ khrom kha brgyad kyis ni sa kho'i dgra 'dul/ rong dor khab po nyi shu rtsaganyis kyis ni bang mdzod 'khyengs/ tshong 'dus bcu gnyis nas nor gyi dbyig phul/ legs nyes kyi bya dar dpa' mdzangs kyis shan 'byed nongs kyi chad pas ngan gasna'i khungs bsnubs/ 'dzangs lngas gser g.yu dang yig tshang gis bstod/ dpa' sna lngas seṅge dang gung stag gis brgyan/ mgyogs sna

41lngas chibs mdzad nas rgyugs su spro/ rje'i bka' khrims ni/ gangs la nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra/ mdzad pa las su pho brang 'um bu bla sgang brtsigs/rku 'phrog dang rdzun spong zhing tshong khye spogs la lta/ rgyal khams bde zhing mnga' thang thams cad skyed pas cho che zhing khungs btsun pa yin no//de'i sras mu khri btsan po/ de'i sras ding khri btsan po/ de'i sras so khri btsun po/ de'i sras me khri btsan po/ de'i sras bdag khri btsan po/ de'i sras sribs khri btsan po/ 'di bdun la gnam gyi khri bdun zer/de yang gcor no sna bdun las khri bdun bang so nam (gnam )la btab//lhag lus ro med 'ja' ltar yal//zhes de dag la dbu la 'od kyi lha thag yod pas dgung lo mang du bzhugs shing / sras 'go mchibs kha thub tsan/ yab gong ma gong ma rnams nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin bde bar gshegs so//srib khri btsan po'i sras gri gum btsan po/ gri gum btsan po'i sras tha khri/ nya khri/ bya khri gsum mo/ /bya khri la spu de gung rgyal du

42mtshan gsol nas/ yul yar lungs kyai sku mkhar chen por bzhugs so/ ༈ /rgyal po 'di'i dus su g.yung drung pon byung / gzhan yang shing bsregs pa'i snying po la sol ba/ ko ba bzhus pa'i snying po la spyin byung /lcags rdo/ zangs rdo/ dngul rdo gsum rnyed nas sol bas rdo gsum bzhus nas dngul zangs lcags gsum bton/ shing la bug pa phug nas gzhol dang gnya' shing bcos/ mthun gnyis gnya' ru bsdebs nas thang rnams zhing du rmos/ rgya mtsho yur la drangs nas zhing la sa bon btab/de la sogs pa'i las thabs mang du byung ngo //de'i sras 6rtosho legs/ de'i sras e sho legs/ rgyal po 'di yis phyi wang stag rtse brtsigs/ pho brang sku mkhar brtsigs pa'i snga bskogs (shos)de yin no//de'i sras de sho legs/ de'i ring la glu dang bro dar/ de'i sras gu ru legs/ de'i sras 'brong rje legs/ de'i sras thong sho legs/'di rnams la sa'i legs drug zer ro//

43de'i sras zin nam zin lde dang / lde 'phrul gnam gzhung btsan/ lde rgyal po btsan/ se stol lam lde/ se snol po lde/ lde lam/ lde snol po/ sprin btsan lde/ 'di rnams ni sa'i lde brgyad do//de'i sras sgo tho ri long btsan zhes bya ste/ yab yan chad yum lha mo dang klu mo yin no//'di man chad 'bangs dang gnyen bsres te/ tho tho ri long btsan gyi sma tsho'i rgyal zhes pa'i sras khri btsan/ 'di'i ring la bsrung (sgrung )dang ldem dar/ de'i sras khri sgog rje thog btsan/ ༈ de'i sras lha tho sgo ri snyan shal zhes pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa ste dgung lo drug cu re gnyis kyi bar du rgyal srid bskyangs te/ ma brtsigs lhun gyis grub pa'i sku mkhar pho brang 'um bu rdzong mkhar la bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i snga bltas la/ nam mkha' nas za ma tog cig babs pas/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo dang /spang kong phyag brgya pa/ snying po yi ge drug ma/ gser gyi mchod rten khru gang / chi/ ma rje'i māgro'i gzungs/ mu dra'i phyag rgya rnams/ nyi ma'i 'od zer la 'grogs te/ rgyal po'i pho brang du babs pas/ bon rnams

44chos sam ci yin ma shes/ gser skyems dang / g.yu phud kyai mchod pas byin rlabs byung ste dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu thub bo//rgyal po 'di'i ring la/ dgapa chos kyai dbu brnyes pa yin no//de'i sras khri snyan gzugs btsano/ de'i ring la 'brog skyong ba dang /zhing gi thul sdebs dang / mtsho gtsang po la ltar ka byas nas yur bar drangs pa dang / phu chu rdzing du bskyel nas mtshan chu nyin la drangs pa sogs de'i dus su byung ngo //de'i sras 'grong snyan lde ru/ de'i sras stag ri snyan gzigs/rgyal po 'di'i ring la/ mdzo dang khye'u bsre ba/ nor gyi rin thang gcod pa/ ri'i rtswa la chun po bya ba sogs byung ngo / /de'i sras gnam ri srong btsan/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la/ rgya nag nas sman dang rtsis byung / rgya dang gru gu nub phyogs gnya' zhur gyi rgyal po la sogs pa btul/ byang nas tshwa rnyed/ sku mkhar khri brtsegs 'bum gdugs bya ba brtsigs so//sna de'i sras byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa srong btsan sgam po/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la mtha'i rgyal khams thams

45to dbang du bsdus te/ rgyal phran thams cad kyis so so nas sku skyes 'bul zhing 'phrin yig bskur to//rgyal po 'dis mdzad pa phyag rjes kyi rgya gabasam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad kyang / phyogs kyi 'phrin yig rnams kyi lan bskur ba la/ bod la yi ge med pa dang / mes tho tho ri snyan shal gyi mchod gnas gnyan po gsang ba yang rgya gar gyi yi ger 'dug pas/ bod yig byas te bsgyur dgos par dgongs nas/ thon mi a nu'i bu la gser bre gang bskur nas/ g.yog 'khor bcu drug dang ba.a te kha cher yi ge slob tu btang ngo lnge———— 1do thozhi bze45)/ga ྅rngo/1re/ zug 'ju dag sa dra'i/ na las bslabs/ paṇḍata sgra' ( lha rigs)seṅge las sgra bslabs te/ bod skad dang bsdun nas/gsal byed nyi shu rtsabazhi drug rang gis bcos pas sum cu mdzad/gzhan yang kha che na ga ra'i yi ge dang bstun nas bsgyur te/ de nas thon mi bod du slebs dus/ rgyal po u ru'i btsun mo tshal na bzhugs pa dang mthal/ rgyal po'i zhal nas khyod kyis yi ge dang sgra bslabs sam/spyan ras gzigs la bstod pa cig spros dang gsungs pas/ thon mis

46zhagar gsal larang mdang gang ba ba nga / zhes (sogs )pa'i sho lo ka yi ger bris te phul pas/ rgyal po shin tu mnyes te/byon gyi khog mar rdo'i gtsug lag khang (dzen khog sna rdo'i lha khang )brtsigs te/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sku bzhugs pa'i drung du/ yi ge 'di rdo la bris te bzhag go /bod du yi ge dang gtsug lag khang la snga ba de gnyis yin no//de nas bal po nas khro gnyer ma'i sprul pa/ bal mo za khri btsun/blon po thon mi sasgoṭas spyan drangs/ de'i rdzongs la/ jo bo mi skyod rdo rje/byams pa chos kyai 'khor lo/ tsandan gyi jo mo sgrol ma rnams spyan drangs/rgya nag nas sgrol ma'i sprul pa rgya mo za kong jo blon po rig pa can gyis spyan drangs/ de'i rdzongs la/ jo bo rin po che dang gzhan yang 'jig rten lugs kyi 'bras chang / nas chang mdor na zas kyi gasku1 sna tshang ba dang /'o ma zho ru bsgyur ba dang / zho las mar dang da ra/ da ra thud du bsgyur ba/ kham sa rdza ru bsgyur ba/ rang 'thag chus bskor ba/ thags khri thags dang / bzo'i rigs pa mang du byung ngo / /gzhan yang / lha sa

47ra 31 che la 31gas pa'i thag gis sbrel ba'i ldema'ibatsugs/ gtsug lag khang dang mkhar dgu brgya tsarma brtsigs sem// de'i tshe rgya gar nas blob dpon ku ma ra de ba dang / bal po'i slob dpon shī la mji dang / kha che'i slob dpon ta nu ta dang / ghu ṇa ta dang / bram ze li byin dang / rgya nag gi blob dpon ha shang mahā de bornams spyan drangs/ lo tstsha ba thon mi sastoṭa dang / dha rma kosha dang / lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje rnams kyis chos ci rigs su bsgyur cing gtan la phab/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la bod stong sde bzhir phye/ shar rtsami dang shing mi/ lho blo (glo )dang zhang zhung / byang hor gyi rgyal thams cad dbang du bsdus te/ dam pa'i chos kyi srol gtod pa yin no/ /de'i sras mang sgong mang btsan/ de'i sras gung srong gung btsan/de'i sras 'du srong 'du rje/ rgyal po 'di'i dus su shar rgyal po'i chu/lgo bal po'i shing kun/ byang hor gyi sgra grags dar chen/ nub blo (glo)bo chun rings/ sbal sta gyi (yi )srang gi nang gong / smad kyai shi gir tshun chad mnga' 'og tu bsdus te/ rgya nas rnga dang rnga / dzña man/ surna/'bur sgo/ rgya gling la sogs pa byung ngo / /gzhan yang rtsal po che'i mi

48bdun byung ste khri mdun yul byin gyis brag gzhongs 'dom dgu la 'byongs (mchong )nus/ gsal snang dung grags kyis g.yag rgod kyi rkang pa na rdeb nus/ ya thog rgod btsan gyis 'dagagyi seṅge ltag spu nas bzung nus/cog ro klu kong gis shing sgom ('dom)do la mda' yis 'bigs nus/ 'brom ltag bzang gis mkhar skya chus 'bebs nus/'gos g.yag chung gis sha ba'i blud bu gser gyis bkang nas klad la bskor nus/ snga gong bod kyi rgyal po rnams las mthu stobs che ba gcig yin no//de'i sras khri lde gtsug brtan nam/ mes ag tshoms/ rgyal po 'di'i sku ring la/ lha sa kha brag dar phu mkhar btab/ mdo smad sgang /gling bcu khri rtse/ thug dmar ru ga chu shar sgo/ phang thang ka mdo/ ka chu pan chung / brag dmar mgrin bzang la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs/ bran kha pud gu sho ka dang / lhags dzñān ku ma ras lo tstsha byas te/ mdo gser 'od dgapa dang / las rgya pa gnyis bsgyur/ pi

49tsi tsandar shris sman dpyad dang rtsis la sogs bsgrar nas chosasrolachen po brtsegashā so// ro༈ de'i sras byang chub sems dpa' 'jim dbyangs kyi sprul pa khri srong lde btsan/ rgyal po des rgya gar nas mkhan po bo lha satwa spyan drangs nas/ kha che ā najis 'dzitstsha byas te/ dge ba bcu/ khams bco brgyad/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyai chos bzhad pas/ bod kyai lha srin 'khrugs pas/ dmar po ri la thog brgyabs/ phang thang chus khyer/ mi nad phyugs nad mang po byung / mkhan po'i zhal nas dam pa'i chos bshad pa la bod kyi lha srin ma dga' bar 'dug pas/ lha srin 'dul ba la rtse( rgyan gyi yul nas slob dpon padma 'byung gnas spyan drongs/ 'o rtsol gsum gyis sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten gyi drung du smon lam gcig (btab )pa yin sa/sungs pas/ sba gsal snang dang gnyis btang nas slob dpon gdan drangs te/ bod kyi lha srin thams cad dam la btags nas/ rgya gar gyi bla( tanta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe byas nas/ bas ma yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta mang po dang lo tstsha ba sad mi mi bdun gyis

50sde stod gsumadang / gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde dang po gsum dang /mdor na rgyal po yon mchod gsum gyis bod mun pa'i gling 'dra bar dgachos gtsang la ma nor ba dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do//'bangs kyai nang nas rab tu byung spula'ang zhabs 'og gi rde'u dbu'i gtsug tu khur ba'i khrims mdzad nas bsam yas la bshad ra (spu)dang / 'ching phu la sgom grwa btsugs/ phyong rlung tshugs su grong khyer skyed pa'i 'byung gnas dang / tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas gnyis btab/ de'i dus su o rgyan padma rgyal po la rig 'dzin tshe chu gnang bas blon po de la mi dga' ba rnams kyis rgyal po la mon gyi spyo chu dug yin pas/ mi gsol bar zhu ba zhus pas/ rgyal po yang the tshogadu gyur te ma gsol/ nang du mdzo mi yong ba'i phyir/ klu rgyal po ma dros zil chen dam la btags nas rdo rje bsnun pas/ zil chen khye'u gcig tu sprul nas rgyal po la grogs po bcol nas/ ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar khas blangs pas/ rgyal po klu'i ngo chen mdzad nas thugs dam glod ( rtsod )do/ /de nas slob dpon lto nub rnga g.yab gling du srin po 'dul du bzhud pa yi no//

31de dus su bod thams ro bde zhing skyed do/ /skye bo'i tshogs mang ba/ 61 legs pa/ dus kyi 'khrugs pa med pa/ mtha' bzhi'i sde thams cad mnan te/ chos khrims dang rgyal khrims gnyis ka shin tu btsan par mdzad do/ /rgyal po 'di'i ring la bon bsnubs shing / dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa yin no// des na/rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dma'ipa zhi ba 'a32 /sngags 'chang bla med dge sbyong padma 'byung // mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan ka ma la shrī la//khri sgong lde btsan lhag pa'i bsam pa can/ /bod yul mun par nyi ma shar ba bzhin//dam chos snang ba phyogs mthar rgyas mdzad pa'i//bka' drin 'khor med dam pa bzhi ka la//bod rnams rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo //zhes kha ton yang byas so//

52rgyal poste sgong rje btsan gyi pas mu khri btsan po/mu khri btsan pos yab kyai thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir du bsam yas su 'dul ba/ mdo sde/ mngon pa gsum gyi mchod pa btsugs/ chos byed pa la 'tsho ba bla nas sbyar/ bod kyi phyug ltogs lan gsum bsnyams/ rgya dang gnyis ga'i cha nas yab la 'dud pa tsam gyis rang ma byung yang bzang mdzad/ rgya dang bod sa bsgos (bgos )byas nas bod dbang ba'i rtswa thams cad rtse mo bod du bltas nas skyes so//de'i sras sad na legs (mjing g.yon)rgyal po des rgya'i sde'i skar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ panḍi ta ka ma la shī la sogs gdan drangs/ gnyags dzñān ku ma ra la sogs pa 'tshotstsha byas te sngar med pa'i chos mang du bsgyur/ de'i sras gtsang ma/ ral pa can/ glang dar ma/ btsun mo chung ba gcig la/ lha rje dang / lhun grub gnyis dang lnga 'khrungs so/ /sras che ba gtsang ma chos la dga' sde rab tu byung nas mi chos la gdams pa'i bstan bcos gcig/ kyang mdzod/dar ma ni sdig la dga' sne rjer 'os min/ bar pa ral pa can la rgyal srid gtad do//

53des 'u shang rdo'i grong khyer btab nas gtsug lag khang rgya phibs dgu brtsegs g.yu sdon can bzhengs/ rgyal po'i zhal nas sngon yab mes kyi ring la rgya dang li dang za hor dang kha che la sogs pa sna tshogs nas chos mang po bsgyur nas brda mi 'dra ba mang po 'dug pas/ chos slob dka' ba yin gsungs nas rgya gar gyi paṇḍata dzi na mi tre dang /'ilendar bodhi/ tā na shī la la sogs pa spyan drangs/ bod gyi lo tstsha ba bka' rtseg (ka cog)gnyis dang / bsnye ye shes sde rnams gyis thams cad skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ tha na bre dang srang la skulags pa rgya gar dang mthun par bcos/ rab tu byung ba re re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun bdun phul/ rgyal po dbus la bzhugs pa la dbu'i ral pa g.yas g.yon gyi sne la dar yug btags nas rab tu byung ba rnams der bzhugs bcug pa dang / g.yas gral/ gaskyesan gral/ sdo/nga gral dang gsum yon tan can la de'i dus phud pa yin no//rgyal po 'di'i ring la shar phyogs pho la shon gyi ri rgyud dar dkar gyi 'tshel ba 'dra ba/ rgya nag po zad pa'i sa mtshams la/ gtugs te dbang du bsdus/ der rdo ring btsugs te/ 'di ma na chad yin zhes pa'i

54yi ge bris te bzhag lho byang glo rbo dang / mon/ rgya gar/ li/ za hor/ nub phyogs stag gzig ge sa mtshams su mtha' dbus kun tu gtsug lag khang brgya rtsabazhengs so/ /'di yan chad bstan pasnga dar yinano//de nas mnga' bdag dar ma dbyig dur (dbu dum )btsan gyi sku ring la/ chos kyi bstan pa bsnubs pa la/ bod yul du mnga' bdag ral pa can gyis panḍi ta mang po spyan drangs pa dang / gser bres phul pa dang / bod yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba mu stegs kyai bram ze bzhis ma theg nas sbyin sreg byas nas bod yul phung ba'i phung 'gong bzhir skye bar smon lam btab nas lcebs pas 'dod pa grub ste/ mnga' bdag dar yodabyig dur btsan dang / cog ro legs sgra dang / dbas ngo re stog sna dang / 'bal 'khor nyer legs pa dang bzhi'i thugs yid du phung 'gong nag po dang / gnam te'u dkar po dang / sa te'u khra bo dang / byang rong gi sa te bzhi'i gdon zhugs te/ rab tu byung ba kun phab/ lha shākya mu ni chu la bkal ba la/ ba//la yang ma nus pas sa mtshag tu sbas/ byams pa chos gyi 'atswatror 'etsho bye ma'i 'og tu sbas nas lha sa/

55bsam yas/ 'phrul snang rnams kyi che( brtsigs te zhal ba byas nas btsun pa chang 'thung ba yi ge bris te/ btsun pa'i rtags ma bor bar la la sprugs/ la la bros/ lus pa rnams la rnga shang dang / mda' gzhu/khye gtad nas lings la btangs/ la la la bzhan pa bcol/ phyis chos byed mi dgos pa'i srol btsugs/ 'bangs rnams la'ang nongs pa'ibaka' chad phab pas/ bka' khrims mgo nas bzhigamanga' ris mtha' nas 'gras pa yin no/ /de'i tshe na rgya na bod dbang ba'i ri gcig yod pa brdibs/ bod nas rgya la 'bab pa'i chu bo chen po rma chu yang yar la zhag gsum 'e1gde la sogs pa'i ltas ngan mang du byung ngo //de nas re zhig nas yer pa'i lha ri snying po la lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje sgom gyin yod pas tshor te/ btsan po la snying rje skes nas /bkrongs pa yin mo// sgoge wa ——— wa ————mchan dar ma dbyig du sna glang dar ma'i dngos ming yin no//

56ming dar ma'i mas 'od sung / de ltar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs pa na/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi tshul ni glang dar ma'i sras 'od srung / khong gis lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje nas sman bla'i mchod pa zhus nas smon lam btab pas/ sman zla'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal srid kyang mas gong ma rnams kyi bka' drin ltar chos khrims dang chos rtsigs dgadu bzhes te mnga' ris chos zhin du bskyangs so//de'i sras la dpal 'khor btsan/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la/ stod mnga' ris kyi gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs/ 'bum la sogs pa'i gsung rab kyang mang du bzhengs nas/ chos brtsigs kyidzidabu sdung ba'o /skyed the rtswa gamagon/(955 47)de'i sras skyed lde nyi ma mgon dang / khri bkrashis brtsegs dpal gnyis/ skyed lde nyi ma mgon ni/ bod khyeng los gi (ska bas )

37'bal mkhazug gar khyung mo dang nyang/pa ā ka badzraganyis kyis gtso byas pa'i rta pa brgya stod mnga' ris su byon pa'i lam khar nya dang sgo nga rnams gsol dgos pa byung nas der ras kyis phur nas drangs pas/ da lta gyad ras bod kyi rgyal po'i lugs su song ba yin no//de nas ra la'i rgyud du phebs/ rta'i lo la mkhar dmar brtsigs/lug gi lo la rtse sho rgya ri brtsigs nas/ dgalag gi gzhung rnams la yul dang grong khyer dang po btab dgongs/ mar yul la gnod pa ma mdzad/ de'i dus su mar yul gyi la dwags stod ge sar gyi rgyud pas ridzin/ smad rnams rang dga'i sil bur yod pa yin no//de'i tshe dge bzhes bkra shis btsan gyis pu hrangs su zhus te/'gro za 'khor skyong btsun mor phul pa khab tu bzhes pa la sras gsum byung zhing / sku mkhar nyi zung brtsigs te rgyal sa btab/ mnga' ris skor gsum chab 'og tu bsdus te rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs so//mchad bod khyeng log nga 'bangs rnams kyis rgyal po la ngo rgol byas pa la zer/

58stod kyai mgon gsum/(1༷༷༷ 1dzin5)sras gsum ni/ lha che ba dpal gyi mgon/ bar pa bkra shis mgon/ chung ba lde gtsug mgon gsum mo/ /de nas sras gsum la mngame ris so sor gnang ste lha che ba dpal gyi mgon la/ mnga' ris mar yul 'bangs zhu nag can/ shar ru thog ser kha gog lang gi lde mchog dkar po/ mtshams kyai ra ba dmar po/ yi mig gi pha bong g.yag sdor/ nub kha che'i la ma rdo phug pa can yan chad/ byang gser kha sgog po tshun chad/ sa rgya la gtogs pa rnams yin no//bar pa bkris mgon gyis gu ge pu hrangs rtse dang bcas pa la mnga' mdzad do//chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis zangs dkar/ sgo gsum/ spyi sta/spo cog bcas pa la mnga' mdzad do//che ba dpal gyi mgon gyi sras/ chos mgon dang 'gro mgon (1025 1050) gnyis/ chos mashesan gyi sras lha chen grags pa lde/de'i sras lha chen byang chub sems dpa'/ de'i sras lha chen rgyal po/rgyal po 'di'i ring la/ li kyir (klu 'khyil )gyi dgon pa btsugs

ze 9 nas dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ gangs ri mtsho gsum mang dus lnga brgya/nyung dus brgya tsam re sgrub pa mdzad pa la 'tsho ba'i yo byad skyo ngal med pa yun ring du mdzad do// lhachen cu la/ (112541150)de'i sras lha chen utpal/ rgyal po 'di'i dus la dwags stod gzhagaganyis kyi dmag bsdongs nas/ nyung ti la dmag mdzad/ nyung sta'i rgyal pos sta se nagazhu dang / ma pham nam skam bar du mdzo dang lcags la sogs pa'i khral dang / dpya dbul ba'i gna' byas nas dus da lta'i bar du'ang yod do//gzhan yang blo bo (glo bo )/ pu hrangs man chad smyo phyogs bre srang gi yul/ chu la me 'bar tshun chod/ nub phyogs ra gan 'greng shing / snag khu tshur yan chod/ byang phyogs ka shu tshun chad mnga' 'ogatu bsdus te/ lo re la khrul sogs 'bul zhing zhal lta ru 'ong ba yod do//de'i sras lha chen nag lug rgyal po des/ stag gi lo la lhan la'i mkhar brtsigs/ 'brug gi lo la kha la rtse mkhar brtsigs so//

60de'i sras lha chen dge ba ( sgo ) dang dge 'bum/ de'i sras lha chen jo ldor/ de'i sras lha chen bkrashis mgon/ rgyal po 'dis rgyud rdo rje rtse mo dang / ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud/ rgyud 'bum tshang ba gser la bzhengs rtso //de'i sras lha chen jo bo dpal/ rgyal po 'dis chos khrims dang /rgyal khrims kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /de'i sras lha chen dngos grub/ rgyal po de'i dus su rabatu byung spudabus gtsang du 'gro ba'i srol btsugs par mdzad nas/ yab mes kyi gtsug lag khang rnams la zhig gsos mdzod do/ /khyad par du chos kyi rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i drung du gser/ dngul/ zangs/ byi ru/ mu stag la sogs pa'i brgya 'bul dang / bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis dang /gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor mang du bzhengs so/ /de'i sras lha chen rgyal lu rin chen/( 112541150)1 de'i sras lha chen shes rab/lha chen rgyal lu rin chen ga(ra du bskyod nas mus nam gyi chos bsten/ yul der mus beem gyi rgyal po dang por gyur/

61rgyal po de'i ring la sa bu'i tang rtse ma zhes par grong khyer seṅge sgang zhes pa brtsigs nas mar yul sa bu sbyang mkhar du btags skul//de'i sras lha chen khri gtsug lde/ rgyal po des sle (gle )ru mchod rten brgya ma sa bu ru brgya rtsaganyis bzhengs so//lha chen grags ga'abug /(1400—1440)de'i sras lha chen grags pa 'bum lde dang / grags pa 'bum gnyis/ grags pa 'bum ldes sle (gli )la sdutshogs pa la mnga' mdzad nas/ rgya ma phyag rjes su gtsug lag khang dmar po bzhings nas rgyal ba byams pa mgon po dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad dang / g.yas g.yon gnyis su 'angayodabyangs/ phyag na rdo rje gnyis ni thog tshad re bzhengs/'dzigs bris rnams la bde bar gnyegs parnams kyi 'dra sku dang /'jig rten bstan bzhag dang / rang nyid mos pa'i lha rnams tshang ba dang /lha khang gsum brtsegs mtho gling dpe ru bzhengs/ gsung gi rten du gzungs 'bumachen mo/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa/ laṅkar gshegs pa

62sogs bzhengs// thugs kyi rten la te'u (ri'u )ser po sle'i 1(gle )yul la gnod pa cig yeld pas gtums nas phyi mchod rten gyi tshul la/nang lha khang brgya rtsayod pa bzhengs/ mchod rten gyi mgon la te'u bkra shis 'od 'phro zer/ gzhan yang sle'i mdo na ri'u glang po che 'dra ba yod pa la/ rgyal po des ri ma gi la dge stsolang bzhi sde gcig btsugs nas 'chi yang 'gyod pa med gsungs pa la/ snyegs dus kyi kun mkhyen tsong kha pa chen po 31 bzang grags pas rang gi shadas khrag la 'khrungs pa'i tshe dpag med mtheb tshigs tsam sku1da pa bya bral gnyis ka bskur nas/yang na grags pa'i mtshan can/ yang na lde'i mtshan can phyag tu phul gsungs pa la/ khong gnyis mar yul du bslebs/ nub ra na grags pa zhes bya ba yod pa la khong gi drung du phyin pa dang / bya bral gnyis la spyan kyang ma gzigs pas/ sle ru 'ongs/ de'i tho rangs nga'i zhal lta ba la/ bya bral/ sge da/ 31na/ sta shi/ su yang ma bkag gsungs pa ltar bya 1 rgyal rabs 'di'i mgo nas mjug par the la the zhes bris te 'dug de bzhin ri chungachung la re'u zer yang de la rte'u zhes bris pa nor te 'dug/

63bral gnyis ka byung bas/ rgyal po bzhengs nas bya bral la bsu ba mdzad/ bya bral gnyis kyis sku skyes phul pas rgyal po shin tu dgyes so//sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la dpe nas sku tshe'i smad la dpe thub kyi dgon pa ma brtsigs lhun gyis grub pa de brtsigs nas dge 'dun gyi sde mang po btsugs so//de'i sras blo gros mchog ldan/ rgyal po 'di'i dus su gu ge nas dmu khrab zil pa/ ma mo'i mun bsgribs/ khrab chung dkar ru/ lha brag dkar pos gtsos byas khrab bco brgyad/ nam ma khrag ldag 'grong rtse ring / glog dmar mo gsod la sogs pa'i ral gri bco brgyad/bdud gri nag po/ dam gri gzhung brgyad rnams kyis mgo byas pa'i sked gri bco lnga / g.yu 'od ldan/ lha g.yu dkar po gtso byas g.yu bco lnga /chibs sga nyi shu/ chibs gro bo lnga bcu/ ngang pa lnga bcu/ 'ol ba nyi shu/ khra bo sumacu/ 'bri zal mo nyi shu/ g.yag kham pa nyi shu/ lug la sogs pa'i khral dpya 'bul ba mang po byung / mnga' ris skor gsum chab 'og tu bsdus nas dar zhing rgyas pa yin no/(byung ngo /)

64lha chen grags pa 'bum gyis rab brtan lha rtse/ lte ba sogs grwa mnga' mdzad/ rgyal sa gting sgang brtsigs/ de'i sras lha chen lha ra/de'i sras lha chen lha gan ('ba' 'gan// rgyal po 'di 'khrug pa la shin tu dga' ba zhig yod pas/ she pa dang bsdongs nas sle'i lha chen grags pa 'bum lde'i sras blo gros mchog ldan/ drung pa gali/ slab bstan dar rnams phab nas mnga' 'ogatu bsdus/ de'i sras lha chen lha dbang rnam rgyal dang bkra shis rnam rgyal/ lha dbang rnagargyal de sku stobs dang / sgyu rtsal shin tu che ba zhig yod pa la/ chung ba bkrashis rnam rgyal g.yo che ba yin pas spyan bton nas gdung rgyud kyi phyir du btsun mo dang bcas nas lings rnyed du bzhag go de'i sras lha chen tshe dbang rnam rgyal/rnam rgyal mgon po/ 4yodabyangs rnam rgyal dang gsum 'khrungs so//sras gsum po de sku skyed shin tu che bas/ gzhan gyi lo skyed pas khong gi zla skyed che/ gzhan gyi zla skyed pas khong gi zhag skyed che ba /// 1rngo/tsho rwaje//ji/ 1pe/ /// //spri/ ////ga byung / / dus su rgyal bkra sa rnam rgyal sa rgyal da la mnga' mdzod do/ /rgyal po des bu rig (bod rigs )gyen chad/ gro shod man chad mnga' 'og tu bsdus so//

65sku mkhar gle'i rnam rgyal rtse mo dang / chu spre'u'i grong sde btab hor gyi dmag byung ba la 'thab pas hor mang po bsad/ rnam rgyal rtse mor mgon khang bzhings nas hor gyi ro thams cad mgon po'i 'og tu mnan/ gzhan yang 'bri khung (gung )nas chos rje ldan ma zhes pa'i rjes 4 ཿṭā 11 ske — /re waril wasangs rgyas da sa gdan drangs nas bkrashas sa nga zhas pa dgan pa btab/ yul yul nas btsunakhralabatabanasasgrubabarnye dkyi bstan pa btsugs/ dgon pa mthong ba'i mtshams su dar chen 'phyar nas/'di'i nang du rkun ma/ rdzun ma/ mdor na rgyal po'i sku srog la bsdos pa'i mi yod kyang de'i nang du tshud pa tsam gyis gnag las thar bar mdzod do//gzhan yang 'bri gung / sa skya/ dge ldan rnams kyi dgon pa lha sa/ bsam yas rnams su/ gdan zhugs/ gser chab/ dar chen/mang rdza brgya 'bul sogs dang / bka' 'gyur/ bstan 'gyur/ gzhan yang glegs bam mang po dang / mchod rten mang po bzhengs so//de nas sprul pa'i rgyal po tshe dbang rnam rgyal de rgyal srid sgru mnga' gsol nas sku na gzhon nu la dmag mdzad pas shar ngam ring man

66chad/ blo bo dang / pu hrangs/ gu ge la sogs pa mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ gho phyogs 'dzum lang dang nyung sta/ nub phyogs shi dkar tshun chod mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ byang hor la dmag rgyab gsungs pa la nub ra ba rnams kyis zhu ba phul nas ma mdzad/ gzhan de rnams kyi jo kun te (gta' ma )pa la 'khredangs/ mkhar rnams la sku tshab bzhag nas mar yul thams cad dar zhing rgyas pa dang / gu ge nas khral dang dpya 'bul ba la/ lo re la gser zho gsum brgya/ ru thog nas gser zho gnyis brgya drug cu/ tsher 31 brgya/ chibs gcig rtsos (gtsod )kyi kyil pa bcu/ mkhar o ljong dang / zhing dar chen dang dar chung rnams dang /gzhan yang khrul dpya la sermegs pa phyogs phyogs nas 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /rgyal po de'i thugs dgongs la lha sa dang / gu ge'i mtho gling rnams kyai thig tshad byas nas sngar yab mes rnams kyis sangs rgyas glang po gdung yang rtse mor bzhag pas/ mi rnams kyis mjal dka'/ phyag mchod/ skor ba sogs mi 'gro ba 'dug pas gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas (der bzhugs su bcug nas )sangs rgyas kyi bstan

67pa mes ral pa can lta bu gcig byed dgongs pa la sems can gyi las zad pas rgyal po de bde bar gshegs so//rgyal po go tsāngs rnagargyal/(155༷ 1590)de dang rgyal phran rnams kyang phyogs phyogs nas langs/ de nas 'jigadabyangs rnam rgyal gyis rgyal srid mdzad/ rgyal po de'i dus su/zug 1(( zur )////khros zug /therga05 thosne/bu rag ( da rags gnyas ma mthun nas / rang ma ga zer ba gcig gi dpung la/ la dwags kyi dmag khyer pas dus kyai 'grib dus dang / rgyal khrims nyams dus la babs pas/ nang gong dmag dpon a li mir gyi dmag brdol ba dang / kho yis g.yo byas nas zhag ci 'gro byas/ de dang (mnyam du)la lung thams cad kha bas bkag nas/rgyal po dmag dang bcas pa gar log la yal/ la dwags thams cad la sbal sta zhugs nas gsung rab thams cad me la bsregs/ la la chu la bkal/ gtsug lag khang thams cad bzhig nas rang gi yul la log song ngo //

68de nas a li mir gyi sras mo rgyal kha thun zhes ṅge/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sprul pa de 'jam dbyangs la btsun mor phul nas la dwags kyi dmag dang bcas pa gnang nas rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur pa yin no/ /de la sras gnyis 'khrungs te/ seṅge rnam rgyal dang / nor bu rnam rgyal gnyis so//de'i dus su 'jim dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi thugs datre|ngas la/dang po ngas su bu rig (bod rigs )gi tshe ring ma lig gi dpung la dmag khyer pa'i lan la grwa dwags thams cad zhig da ngas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i thabs cig ci byas nas kyang dar bar bya dgos dgongs pa la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mi sde la rag las pa yin pas/ da ngas mi sde rnams la khral thud sogs med pa bu bzhin bskyang dgos snyam nas phyug ltogs lan gsum bsnyams/ rgyal po 'dis bu rig gyen chad mnga' 'og tu bsdus nas/ tshe ring rgyal mo khab tu bzhes pa la/ sras ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang / bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gnyis 'khrungs/gzhan yang khong gis dbus g.yo du jo bo rin po che'i drung du/ gser chab/ gdan zhugs/ 'bras spungs/ ra lung rnams su dngul/ mu

69stag spos shel/ byi ru/ cab dar/ mang ja la sogs pa'i brgya 'bul/ de rnams su dar chen dang / 'brug pa sprul sku gdan 'dren pa'i pho nya sogs kyang brdzangs so//sku'i rgya mar rgya tog gser gsum dang / bka' brgyud gser phreng sogs gser dngul zangs gsum la bzhengs nas sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang du bzhengs/ rgya ma phyag rjes su sbal tis me la bsregs pa rnams slar de'i tshab bzhings ba'i thugs bsam shin tu che ba yod kyang sku tshe thung nas bde bar gshegs so//chos rgyal seṅge rnabargyal/(159༷ smo daX)de'i sras chos kyai rgyal po seṅge rnam rgyal sku na chung ngu'i dus nas sku stobs shin tu che ba'i/ gyad dang / bang dang / mchong dang / mda' dang / klog dang / rta skya dang / sgyu rtsal thams cad sngon gyi zas gtsang sras po don grub lta bu'o//

70de nyid kyai zhi ri kyar kyar tshun sogs mnga' ris sgor gsum chab 'bangs su bsdus shing dbang bsgyur par mdzod do/ /rgyal po des sku na gzhon nu la gu ge'i phyi 'brog la dmag mdzad nas/ ṣka se'i byang rgyab tshun chod la/ rta g.yag dang ra lug la sogs pa sa gzhi bskangs nas 'khyongs/ de'i rting gu ge la dmag mdzod nas/ sha wang dang / zha ye gnyis dmar rdog la btang nas sa gzhi thams cad g.yag dang lug gis bkang / bdag mo skal bzang sgrol ma khab tu bzhes nas sras che ba bde ldan rnam rgyal/ bar pa indar bo dhi rnam rgyal/ chung ba bde mchog rnam rgyal gsum 'khrungs/ rīgrub thob kyai rgyal po snag tshang ras chen zhes bya ba/ rgya dkar nagaskyes rgyan/ kha che sogs kyi grub thob thams cad kyi zhal mngon sum du gzigs pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po de gdan drangs nas/ gser zangs kyai byams pa dgung lo brgyad pa'i tshad rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa bzhengs pa dang / rgya gar shar nub thams cad kyai rgya lha thams cad gdan drangs nas byams chos sde lnga po sta lnga bzhengs/ rgyun mchod dge slong lnga bskal pa nam gnas su gtsugs nas mchod pa/ mar me nyin

71'bar mtshan 'bar/ rgya gos ya mtshan can mang po'i 'phan/ rgyal mtshani/ dar chen la sogs pa btsugs/ gzhan yang / 'phags pa rab 'byor gyi sku'i skye ba paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi drung du yumagyi dgongs rdzogs la gser gyi bung tshang dang / cab dar sogs kyi brgya 'bul mang po dang / gsung gi rten du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gser rkyang dang / gser dngul zangs gsum las grub pa tshar bdun dang / bstan 'gyur yongs jogs skra pod du (shog tu )bzhengs par mdzad/ stong phrag brgya pa/ mdo sde bskal bzang / byams chos sde lnga tshar lnga / rgya (sgra )tog gser gsum tshar gnyis/ stag tshang ras chen gyi rnam thar mgur 'bum rnams gser dngul zangs gsum la bzhengs/ ma ṇi dung phyur sogs mang du bzhengs par ma dzad cing / de rnams la brgya 'bul dang stong 'bul/ gzhan yang stag sna dang / an le'i dgon pa ma brtsigs lhun gyis grub pa de brtsigs nas/ sgrub brgyud kyai bstan pa btsugs/

72de dus sbal ti'i jo ab dal khyan gyis sa cha arang sha'i dmag dpung sbran nas mkhar bu ru 'thab mo mang po song bas/ hor mang du bsad nas dgra las rnamapar rgyal to//gu ger dmag brgyabs par gnang nas jo bdag po phab/ gu ge'i rgyal srid rnams mnga' zhabs su bsdus/ ru thog gi ang pa yang phab nas rgyal srid rnams mnga' zhabs su bsdus/ shi ri kyar kyar yang bcag nas dbus gtsang nas sde pa gtsang pa'i gser dngul/ ja la sogs pa stobs chen phul nas tshur gdan 'khor/ mtsho dbar du blo'i (blozware )sde pa bsam grub dpal 'bar phyag 'bul du byon nas legs so che ba byung / phyin chad sku gnyen gyis 'brel zab gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang /mdor na mar yul la tshun/ gu ge'i byang / ru thog gi gser kha gog po tshun rnams mnga' 'og tu bsdus nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do//

73bde ldan rnamorgyal/(162༷ 154༷)de'i sras bde ldan rnam rgyal/ indar rnam rgyal/ bde mchog rnam rgyal gsumakha'akhrungs shing / mnga' bsheshes mdzad pa ni/ indar la gu ge/ bde mchog la spyi ti dang zangs dkar/ rgyal po bde ldasno rnam par rgyal pal la dwags gzhung / pu hrangs/ ru thog bod rigs yan/ mar yul man rnams/ grub thob chen po'i bka' bkod ltar rang rang gis mnga' gsol mdzad/ yab kyi dgongs rdzogs su shel du rgyal bshākya thub 'i sku gser zangs la sgog tshad gnyis kyai tshad bzhings/yumagyi dgongs rdzogs la lte bar sdong mgo ru ma ṇi stobs che/ mchod rten rnamaganyis bcas bzhings/ yab kyi phyag srol ltar/ nub ra/bzang mkhar (zangs dkar)/ bsam mgon/ gting sgang sogs su maṇi dung phyur 'don mkhan dge sgong brgya rtsare pho re la gnang / sle ru spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gser zangs la grub pa thog tshad gnyis dang /gser zangs kyi thub pa'i sku thog tshad gnyis dang / dngul gyi mchod rten thog tshad gnyis dang 'du khang sogs bzhengs shing dge phyogs kyi
