74mdzod pa mtha' las 'das pa/ :rtos gzhal dka' ba bzhings/ bod rigs rnams gnya' rangs yod skabs chu mo glang lo la/ bka'i blon po dpa' zhing mardongs la brtul phod pa shākya rgya mtsho dang / la dwags kyi dmag chen bcas bslangs pas/ mkhar bu dang he gnas sku/ stag rtse sogs dbang med du phab/ sha dkar yang bcag nas pa sa ri la khyer nas ston thog rnams zos nas tshur log de rjes gsum 'brang rnams phag dkar rtse yang phab nas jo khri sul tān phyag 'bul la 'khyongs nas phyir slogs/ shing pho rta'i lo la kha pu lor dmag brgyabs nas chor rbad bcag phab/ ha tam khyan/ sul tān khyan/ a li khyan gsum la so sor mkhar gtad/ pa sa ri mkhar du blon po bzhag la dwags pa rnams la dpung ston la yod sar kha chul nas sbal sta'i dpung du dmag 'bum tsho gsum slebs nas dmag 'thab mang po song / hor (dmag mi )mang du bsad nas rang phyogs la rgyal kha thob bo//kha chul pa rnams phar 'edzeg sa mo lug gi 'e1 spu bod dbus gtsang dang sel zhugs pas/ dmag dpon sog po'i rgyal rigs dga' ldan tshe dbang dang / 'byong sgar pa'i dmag dpon blo bzang shes rab

75bcas dang / bod sog gi dmag rnams 'thon dus rang phyogs nas dgrar 'dzin dang so sor bzung ba zhigayogyur kyang nges med du sa 'dzin sogs kyi nyer len gyis dmag mtshon pa zhig gnang nas ra la mkhar dmar du phan tshun 'khrug rtsod chen po song nas rang phyogs su rgyal kha ma byung bar tshur snur dgos byung / 〈phyogs rnams rngam chas kyis rjes bsnyegs byas/ lung khung mar non nas phan tshun 'khrug pa chen po song nas rang phyogs rnams la rgyal kha che ba byung / spre lo la dpal skya ru 'khrug pa song bas tshur rgyal kha thob pa zhig ma byung / bya lo la pu hrangs kyi mkhar shor/ gu ge yang nang mi zhim pa byung nas shor/ de'i rjes sog dmag la dwags la zhugs/ byang la phyogs kyi la bsrungs kyang grub 'bras thon pa ma byung / chu mo phag gi lo la la dwags stod kyai mkhar rnams yal/ dbyi gu/ lcegabre/ drang rtse/ bkris sgang / rgya mkhar rnams gzhan lag tu gshor ba byung / bam mgor zla ba drug gi bar dmag 'thab byas pas/ rang phyogs rnams la rgyal thob cing pharol gyi mi mang po mtshon thog tu shi/ gteng sgang du'ang 'khrug rtsod mang du song bas de bzhin mang tsalabasad pas tshur rgyal kha thob pas sog

76dmag rnams ba mgo 'og shing pho byi ba'i lo la rgya gar gyi pa cha (bād shāha)a rang sha (o raṅga zeb)yi dpung dmag bye ba drug dang dmag mgo la na babs phi te khyasgron/ mu ril khyan/ sal gar khyan/ 'ga' khad sul tān/ yag yag khyan/ 'jing gir khyan drug gis dmag dpon byas/ mkhar la rtse'i gtsang po la shing zam gcig dang / lcug zam gcig na hong rnams btsugs nas dmag rnams sa gzhi khyab nas slebs byung bas/ stobs kyai 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i dpung tshogs yan lag bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i drag shul che ba blo rgod pa/ lha min gyi brtul dugs su chas ba'i rgyasaba'i ba na gal shin spyo snang ba'i nagaphyogs skya byed las na gzugs bu'i spyod 'gros tshub cing rten dka' na'ang ga mo bas kyi bya bar dbung du sgron mas med kyi bya ba sto ngan pa dmag gi khur 'dzin pa de rnams kyis ba mgo'i bya rgyal thang du 'thabs pas bod dmag rnams shor/ khrab dang mda' gzhu mang po zhirgo lus/ dpe thub bar rim gyis 'thabs pas sog dmag rnams shor nas bkrashis sgang du slebs/ der dmag sgar byas/ mtha' lcags ris bcad/ chus mtha' nas bsgor/ nang du dmag gis mi tshugs par byas

77te bsngad/ de nas phan tshun chings 'grigs nas bde bar gnas/ la dwags rgyal po'i da dung dmag 'byung gi dogs pa che bas/ de sel ched sde pa gzhung gi phyogs nas 'brug pa mi phagadabang po bzang 'grig la phebs dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba ltar 'brug pa rin po che gting sgang du phebs/ mnga' ris skor gsum gyi le na la dwags pa min par gtsong mi chog pyodang / le na nya ga bzhi bcu la rin dngul re gtang rgyu'i thog la/mkhar tshong min pa gzhan 'gro mi chog pa dang / bod nas gzhung tshong lo ltar do khal gnyis brgya ja dang bcas pa 'ong rgyu/ la dwags nas bod la rten dang bcas pa'i lo phyag pa gtang rgyu/ bod du sdod ring phogs 'thob rgyu dang / lam thog khal mganyi brgya/ bzhon rta nyer lnga / rta dang thab 'khodug mi bcu/ 'brog sder nag gur go 'pher gcig rta khal rnams rta zam thog rdzong skyel/ ru thog gu ge bu hrangs rdzongs gsum bod du rtu/ tshorīwa wa snatsho me stal dwags grwa rgyun rnams 'a rtan dang / lha sar ma da dang sman lam gyi mthun rkyen du sbyin nas/ ji men mtsher/nyi) gangs rin po che'i mchod me dang sa phud du la dwags rgyal po rang gis bdag gir mdzad/de nas na bāb dang dmag mi rnams dpung bcas phyir log btang / na

78bab dang la dwags gnyis mdza' bo'i tshul bzung nas dzee dwags nas kha chul la lo re bzhin rta khra bo drug gla rtsi'i lte ba drug g.yag gi ji ma dkar po drug bcas gnang rgyu dang / kha chul nas lo ltar 'bras dkar dmar ras sgrig gsum brgya re gnang rgyu'i srol tshugs pas bde 'jags su gyur to//macan/ rgyal po bde legs rnam rgyal (164041680) gyis dbang sgyur mthad skabs dbus gtsang dang sel zhugs pa yin no//skyi mo gargyal/(152༷ rgya daX)de'i sras lha chen nyi ma rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang rnabargyal/ dbang phyug rnamargyal/ dga' ldan rnam rgyal dang bzhi'o/ /ngagadabang rnamargyal bod la phebs/ dpal ldan 'bras spyangs su blob gnyer mdzad nas mtshan rtags bzhes/ khri rtse dgon gyi mkhan po mthad/de nas lha chen nyi ma rnalargyal/ rgyal srid la mnga' gsol nas rang blor gang shar ma mdzad par mi drag pa rnams dang bsdun nas rgyal

79srid kyi bya ba shin tu btsan pa/ bzang po rnams la yar bstod dang /yon tan can la rtsi 'jog rgan rabs rnams la bkur sdi/ bla ma rnams la re sa gus/ ngan pa rnams la gnya' gnon dang bka' baspyodan sdutshogs bka' khrims gtsang ba/ sku drag rnams la nye ring med pa/ 'bangs rnams la bu ltar brtse ba/ phyogs mi rnams la bdag rkyen/ yar dkon mchog la mchod pa/ mar ngan stsolang la sbyin pa gtong ba sogs dus rgyun chad med par rten bzhengs dang / mchod par brtson pa/ lha sar bla chen rnams la brgya 'bul dang stong 'bul/ rang zhabs kyi dgon sde khag so so la nye ring med pa'i thugs rje dang bdag rkyen phyis su brjod bya dang srol ngan 'byung ba'i sdong po rtsab nas phud/ tshab tu bzang po'i brjod bya dang srol gsar du btsugs/ rdza nang gi ma ṇi ring mo dang chos kyi gzungs par sna mang bsgrubs/ mnga' 'bangs rnams zho ltar chags nas bde bar gyur to//ca047

bde skyong zhesargyal/(me da —174༷)༈ de'i dus su mang spro'i dgon du dpal sa skya'i chos lugs tshags su chud do/ /nyi marnam rgyal gyi sras bde skyong rnam rgyal/ de phyis su rgyal srid la mnga' gsol/ smyo mon thang nas nyi zla dbang mo mdun par zhus/ de la sum sa skyong rnam rgyal 'khrungs nas thugs mthun ma byung stabs rgyal mo smyo mon thang du phyir log phebs/ rgyal pos sa skyong rnagargyal mchog nyid he mi ru bla ma mdzod/rjes su bde skyong rnam rgyal la rgyal mo kun 'dzoms btsun mor zhus/ de la sras tshe dbang rnam rgyal 'khrungs/ gzhan rgyal mo gcig kyang bzhes/ de la sras phun tshogs rnam rgyal bltams/ tshe dbang rnam rgyal dang phun tshogs rnam rgyal gnyis po rgyal srid la ma 'chams par /de dus bod nas bka' thog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu phebs nas/ bu sngon ma min par rgyal srid mi 'os pa'i bka' mdzad/ sku drag gon gzhon bar gsum bcas nang lugs kyi bka' rgya bsnams nas sras che ba tshe dbang rnam rgyal rgyal srid la mnga' gsol mdzod/ phun tshogs rnam

81rgyal gyis gle'i mkhar la nyams gso byas/ tog sa phud dang gser khri gsuma'imanga' zhabs su byas nas khrig se'i ma/bar du bzhugs/sa skyong rnam rgyal he mi ru rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul du bzhugs/rjes su 7skyabs mgon rgyal sras zhus te mtshanasnyanagrags su khyab /yang rgyal mo kun 'dzoms la sras tshe dbang rnam rgyal 'khrungs/ rgyal srid dar zhing rgyas/ gzhan sras gcig byung ba de ni sman dpyad la zhin tu mkhas kyang lha sar phebs te sku gshegs/ sras 31 gcig bltams pas/de hor khang gsar gyis btsun mor bzhes/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu bod la phyir log sne phebs so/ /de nas rgyal po tshe dbang rnam rgyal gyis bzang la'i mkhar nas kun 'dzoms dbang mo zhes pa btsun mo khab tu bzhes/ de skabs rgyal po'i thugs la bdud zhugs/ tog pa bka' blon dbang rgyal dang zhabs gras ngan pa'i dbang du song ste tshang ra'i bhe ('bye )mo rgyal bya ba khab tu bzhes/ bzang la'i rgyal mo phyir bton nas zangs dkar rgyal po'i btsun mo mdzad/ sngar med kyi phyag las mang du mdzad/ sku drag rnams kyis 'di ltar mdzad pa mi 'os pa'i zhu ba phul kyang / gsan dgongs ma byung bar rten byed thabs bral nas zla ba bzhi lnga

82tsam khrig se mkhar du bzang btson du bzhag dmagadapung bsdus nas mkhar la 'tshangs nas 'bye mo bton/ tog pa bka' blon yang go sa phab ste btson la bcug de nas rgyal po slar mkhar du gdan drangs nas 'bangs la log par mi byed pa dang / 'bangs kyis kyang ngan mi byed pa dang / sngar lugs bzhin rgyal srid chos mthun bya rgyu'i mna' tho bgyis/de dus rgyal po'i zhal nas me sbrul lor mi mang gros mthun dam srid kyis bsrems pa'i ngos rang khri thog nas phab pa zur du bkar nas/ rang dbang shin tu 'u thug byung skabs khrig se mkhan slob dge 'dun las lhag pa'i phan grogs kyai drin can su yang ma byung zhing / da lamangos rang yin lugs dran pa'i mthus mar yul khri thog tu 'byor nas/ chos srid gang phan mes chen gong ma'i lugs srol ji bzhin bya rgyu yin zhes gsungs/de nas rgyal po la sod khro'i sras mo be khyem dbang mo btsun mor zhus/ de la sras tshe brtan rnam rgyal/ chung ba tshe dpal don grub rnam rgyal bcas sras gnyis bltams/ yum chung ba tshe ring gtun la khrig se'i mkhan po rgyal sras 'jigs med rnam rgyal 'khrungs serme//

83rgyal po 'di'i skabs khrig se mkhan po rgyal sras 'jigs med rnamargyal gyis da lta'i khrig se'i 'du khang ka ba nyi shu pa steng 'og dang /chos rwa gsar bzhengs mdzad pa sogs 'khor lo gsum gyi sgo nas nang pa'i chos lugs la gang phan mdzad cing / ming dmag skabs mthu sgrub mdzad nas me 'gro ba kun gyis mngon sum du mthong nas seng dmag rnams la shal nad byung nas mang du shi bas mthu rtags gsal bar nges so//tshe brtan rnalargyal/(178༷ 1790)de nas tshe brtan rnam rgyal srid la mnga' gsol mdzad/ bu rig paskyum mkhar nas khro'i sras mo dpal mdzes dbang mo btsun mor bzhes/ de la sras med cing sras mo gcig 'khrungs so// a yu'i no no tshe dbang don grub mi mang rnams dang mthun shas che bas bka' blon du bsgos/ rgyal sras 'di rig rtsal can yin pas bod yig dang / rtsis dang / phar se'i yi ge dang skad/ kha chul/ yar

84gyen gyi skad rigs sogs dang / ral gri mdung sgor sogs sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa/ gzhan yang dgra la dpa' ba/ mi ser la byams skyong che ba/kun la nye ring med par spyan gyis gzigs pa/ sngon mi ser thog nas 'bab khungs med pa mang nyung tshod tshod du len pa ma gtogs med las/rgyal po 'dis mi ser nas 'bab khungs la brten nas dpya khral rnams ran par blangs pa yin no// rgyal po 'di'i skabs bla ma tshul khrims nyi mas stod gzham gzhung gsum gyi la dwags 81ngas la 'bul sdud mdzad nas rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu mo sbrul lo'i nag pa zla ba hor zla gsum pa'i yar ngo'i tshes la ri rdzong dgon gyi gtsug lag khang gi ming gzhi gdan btings/he mi shug pa can/ sa spyo la/ a lci la sogs pa de'i 'khor gyi yul mi mang po zhig dgon pa bzhengs phyir 'tshogs te/ thams cad kyis dka' ngal dang snga phyi la ma ltos par brtsigs pas/ zla ba gnyis ma song tsam du 'du khang ka ba bzhi'i sa dang / sgo mchor ka skrungs dang bcas pa 'du khang dang 'brel ba'i byang ngos su rje nyid kyi gzims spyil/ spyod lam bzhi'i bya ba byed du rung ba/ rung khang ka ba gnyis kyi sa bcas

8581ngas su rdzogs pa grub cing / dgrelan pa'i 81gas bris la sku1gas pa bsgrubs pa dang / rdzong lung na yod pa'i ri khrod parnams kyang gdan drangs nas dge 'dun gyi rje btsugs/ bslab g.yongs su sbyong ba'i gzhi gsum gyi nyams bzhes dam chos 'dul ba bzhin mdzad/ 'khrungs khang sa spro la'i khache pa'i zhing khang rnams kyang ri rdzong dgon par mchod gzhi'i ched du phul/ dge 'dun rnams kyi na bza'/ gzims chas/bsnyun gyi gso sman la sogs pa 'tsho ba'i 21 byad rnams dgon pa gzhung gis gra sgrig mdzad do//tshe dpa don grub rnagargyal/(179༷ snyen ༷)chung gotshe dpal don grubarnam rgyal he mir grwa pa mdzad/ yab kyi dgongs rdzogs la kyai gu'i mjug gi thang du ma ṇi che ba ring du gomapa gsum brgya lnga bcu lhag tsam yod pa'i mgo mjug ① /nyis su byang chub mchod rten dang rnam rgyal mchod rten che ba gnyis bzhengs/ 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa kun gzigs chos kyi snang baphebs nas he mi dgon

86du bzhugs pa la/ rta 'bri/ ra lug 'bru gos/ gser dngul dang /g.yu byur sogs 'bul ba mang po phul/rgyal sar bzhengs nas pho gnyis kyi rjes shing sgrul lor/ shi gar/ skar mdo sogs sbal ṣka yul gcig bsgril gyis dmag dpung che ba bsdus nas ke ris/ ku tu'i mkhar dang / mda' stongs rnams bzung / kha pu lu'i rgyal srid 'phrog tu 'jug pas/ jo mahā mad a li khyan phabu gnyis skyabs med 'u thug nas la dwags rgyal por rogs dang dpung snon zhus pas/ 'di nas no no bsod nams dang / nub ra sngon da no no chung ba gnyis dmag mgo byas nas/ nub ra chu phan tshun gyi dmag dang / mchor rbad dmag bcas shar stsol du khyer pas/ 'dre go ni ru 'byor skabs pha rol gyi dmag mis nyin mchong btang nas 'ong dus no nos snying stobs ma zhugapar khur bcag btang bas 〈rol po'i dmag chag mkhar bcas mi brgyad bcu/ ca lag dang bcas pa bzung nas rgyal srid kyi bya bar thu shor med par byas so//rgyal po de nyid tshe sngon gyi las la brten 'brum nad byung nas dgung pho sum cu tsarma la dkar bzo ru grongs/ rgyal po 'di'i skabs

87mnga' ris tshang dge legs ye shes grags pas rang 'dum dgon pa bzhad sgrub 'dzamagling rgyan phyag btab/ de nas he mi nas rgyal sras tshe dpal don grub rnam rgyal grwa pa 'e1ga nas/ rgyal srid la mnga' gsol/ rgyal po sku 'das kyi btsun mo dpal mdzes dang bcas srid bskyangs/sras mo 'bel chung dang sras tshe dbang rab brtan 'khrungs/rgyal po 'di sku yon rig gnas tshang ma mkhyen cing chos dang 'jig rten gyi lugs sogs mkhyen zab sku(da kyang yab tshe dpal gyi rgyud ngan khur nas mdzad spyod ngan pa sngar srol med pa khyad mtshar can mdzad/zhabs phyi gsar pa rkyang bzhag mi'i ngor bka' khrims la ma brtsis par zhing 'phrog dbang bkog sogs khrims min byas/ mtshan mo kho rang dang zhabs phyi kun kyang nyal du ma bcug par nyin dros bar du mnal gzims/ mkhar gyi nang 'khor rnams mtshan mo gnyid nyal dbang med par bzhag pa'i gan rgya blangs/ phyag bsil du bum pa bcu gnyis tsam gyi chu dang / 'dag chal gyis bkrus te chus bshal/ phan tshun du nyin mo ma phebs bar mtshan mo mar me'i 'od spar nas phebs pa/ sngar gyi las khungs kyi mi dang mi bstun/ zangs dkar rgyal po dang / bu rigs

88bka' shādzin bcas btson du bzhag sngar khrims bzang po rnams zhig la thug kyang bka' shesan tshe dbang don grub kyis thabs mkhas gyis yab lta bur 'gror ma bcug de'i skabs rgyal po la phyag rdzas bsu med yod pas/ tog tu mkhar gsar pazhig brgyabs/ yab rgyal po tshe dpal don grub rnamargyal dang rgyal sras tshe dbang rab bstan gnyis nye mo med snabs phyir spyar ras gzigs kyi lha khang gi ltag par rgyal po rang nyid zur du bzhugs phyir/ mkhar so gzhig brgyabs/ bka' blon tshe dbang don grub dang gros byas te/ rgyal po rang gi sku gzugs dang mnyam pa'i dngul gyi phyag rdor mgrin pa yan chad gser zangs la bzhengs/ dngul gyi sku gdung thog tshad ma za ra tshags dang nyi zla tog bcas gser la byas pa/ phra rgyan g.yu byur sogs rin po ches spus pazhis kyang bzhengs/sa byi 'tsho spyi lo 1867 skabs yar kyen hor yul gyi kho sham zer ba'i mu sul mān rgyal po'i dus rgya nag gong ma chen po'i dmag mang thon nas yar rkyen hor gyi mnga' khongs tshang ma bcom/ 'thab mo lo gnyis tsam btang yang rgya nag dmag dpung mang bas ma thub par ye ni 'jan yul gyi rgyal po ab dul sa tār zer ba dmag mi stong phrag gcig dang / rta

89bdun brgya tsakra khrid nas la dwags phyogs su shor 'ong ba lam du mgo 'khor nas zla ba phyed lnga tsam lam du lus te mi rta mang po shi/ sha 'og tu dpon gasku1ga gsum brgya tsam dang rta gnyis brgya lnga bcu tsam slebs/lam du zas sdug gis bag leb re la'ang gser sgor re btang /de ltar thos pas 'di nas kho zha sa rdig dang / sku tshab gsol dpon 'brog gnyis po/ drang rtse'i mkhar dpon bsod nams rab rgyas la bka' shog thog hor de rnams la khar ji gra sgrig byed par song bas/nyin bcu gcig la khong rnams gler 'byor/ gler 'brang sa/ bza' btung spus ka/ lci ba dang shing sogs ci dgos btang zhing zhag lnga'i ring la ngal bso dang / de nas rgyal po mjal kha zhu bar 'ong skabs gle'i mkhar thog chen mtsho nang du gra sgrig byas/ rgyal po khri'i steng du bzhugs/drag zhan bar gsum 'dzoms pa g.yas gral dang ga81na gral la 'khod/hor khong pa mtha'i rgyal po yin pas/ gdong gral du 'bol gdan gnyis brtsegs thog gos chen gyi kha gdan sgang la bzhag khong pa rang nyid dar zab kyi rgyan gyis spras nas phyag rtags su gos chen thog gser ljangs mdung kha sgor yod re'i tshad/ phyogs rnams su rin po che phra rgyan/

90dbus su padma/ de'i dbus su bum pa ltar byas pa'i gser gyi dbu zhwa dang / rta gcig bcas phul nas phyag 'bul zhus/ ngos nas yar kyen shar du ci byas/ ci song gnas tshul ga ler zhu rgyu yin/ da lta ngos rang la dwags su slebs/ da thub na hang la 'gro rgyu'i bsam pa dang smon 'dun yod/ de bzhin rgyal po rang gis ci gsungs bzhin zhabasabacar zhu dgos zer/ rgyal pos kyang rjes su thug nas/ gtam gling byed chog gsungs/ hor dpon g.yog kun la 'um la pa'i khang par 'brang sa gra sgrig dang / gzhan rnams he mi bla brang du bzhag sang nyin snga mo ab dul sa tār kho rang la zur gsol lug gnyis/ 'bras khal gnyis/ja 'bru dang bag gcig mar ma na gnyis/ bag phye khal bcu/ rta phyag khal bdun/ rtswa shing zhag bdun la zhag rer shing khur gnyis re dang /rtswa khur gnyis re gtang dgos pa'i bka' bgos mdzad/gzhan hor che 'bring rnams la'ang / phye/ mar/ rtswa/ shing bcas mang nyung bltas nas ldang dgos kyi rdzas rnams kho zha sa thug dang ga ga 'brog gnyis la khag khur gyi bka' khyab mdzad/

91de dus bka' khrims ci byung byed mkhan gyi gros mgor nub ra'i hun dar (sngon dar)gyi blon po ga ga bstan 'dzin la rgya lugs gsum la mkhas pa des/ rgya nag gong ma chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs sprul ngo ma yin bzhis/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rtsab yang rgyal po khong la rag las pas/ hor 'di tsho gong ma khong la rgyab log byas pa'i bstan dgra yin nges/ de bzhin khong pa'i gnas tshul gong ma chen por zhu ba phul nas bdag la dwags rgyal por gzigs pa bskyang dgos zhu na legs zhes nus pas/ de la rgyal po yab yum dang shesan 'khor rnams kyang thugs mnyes/ yar kyen du de lugs kyai yi ge kho zha ma mad sa rdig mi ngos bcas btang / zla ba phyed bzhi nas yi ge de'i lan 'byor/ 'di nas mi ngos ring min myur tu gtang nges la de bar bkag bskyel bcas bzhag daselas zhes pa'i bka' byung / zla ba phyed gnyis nas/ theg zer ba'i 'go pa mi gnyis/ gasku1ga mi bzhi bcu tsam dang / rta lnga bcu bcas slebs/ am lha gnyis kyis phyag sman dngul rta mig ma bzhi dang /gos chen bubs gnyis bcas phul/ snyeg dpon g.yon tsho la'ang bdag rkyen bcas zhag kha shas bzhag ab dul sa tār dpon gasku1ga 'khor

92bcas sge dang rkang la lcags sgrog bsnams nas khyer/ hor dpon ga81ga de rnams kyis la dwags rgyal pos las 'bras sogs ci la'ang ma'ibartsis par nged tsho dgra yi lag tu gtad/ da rgyal po dzobu 'brugapa'i nad kyis shi ba dang / rgyal srid gzhan gyi lag tu yalacig zer nas 'u thug thabs zadashus :dzin lam log par btabs/gong gsal zhu gagong ma chen po'i snyan du gsan pas/ bod brgyud rgyal po la gser dam dang / tog dom gdong / rgya dngul/gos chen bzang po sogs gsole ras mang po phebs/ lcags stag pho spyi pho 1829 nang gle'i theg chen gor mar gu ru padma 'od 'bar gyi dngul sku dngul rta migagasumacu la bzhings/ tog gi mkhar du rdo tshad dam rta rmig yodagu la dngul gyi rje btsun sgrol ma sogs bzhings/shel du rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi dngul sku rdo tshad de rta rmig gabadun la bzhengs skul//de nas sngar hor skyabs bcol ba rnams kyis 'u thug gis zhon lagayog par btab pa ltar lo mang ga'agyangs par rgyal po tshe dpal

93don grubarnamargyal sbal sta'i yul du 'brum nad kyis grongs/ rgyal srid kyang jasbyi'i rā dzā gu phab mi gi lagatu 1835 skabs shor/ ga'irasabaska/(18 ༷ smon 4)de nas rgyal sras tshe dbang rab brtan gyis rgyal srid 'dzin/rgyal sras 'di skulangs 'dzin lnga pa ye shes grub rgyas kyis bla ma stag tshang gi thugs kyi sprul sku snyil pa rdo rje'i sku skyes yin par gsungs nas phyag bris slebs pa dang khong he mi dgon du bzhugs pas rgyal sras mchog sprul du grags/ mi kun gyis rgyal rigs kyi ched du lcam bzhes dgos zhus par nga bla ma yin zer nas ma bzhes/ yab dang yang ma mthun/ de nas phyag mdzod mgon po lo phyag la song nas 'brug pa rin po che mjal nas rgyal sras mchog sprul srid skyong mdun ma mi bzhes pa'i sgor zhus pas/ 'brug pa rin po ches/ rgyal sras la chos 'jig rten gnyis ka byed dgos/ bka' blon tshe dbang don grub kyi bu mo chung ba skal bzang sgrol ma mdun mar bzhes shig gsungs nas phyag bris gnang / lha

94bdag tshe ring stobs rgyas dang / dbon po phun tshogs gnyis kyis sku bag mkhar du zhus/ lcam gyis shin tu khrel pa dang ngo tsha zer nas spyan chab mang po gtong bzhin bzhums/ 'tsho gcig gi nang du mngal dang ldan par gyur te / sras 'jigs med seṅge mi 'gyur kun dga' rnam rgyal bltams/ lo de rang la pa skyum jo'i sras mo bsod nams dpal skyed dang zo ra kha tun bcas btsun mo gsum khab tu bzhes/de nas rgyal po mchog sprul gangs rir mjal du bskyod skabs yab dang / sku drag dang / he mi dgon gyi dbu chos tshang mas gaphebs zhus kyang rang rgyal mdzad nas 1834 le'i bod zla ba drug pa'i tshes bzhi la gangs rir phebs/ zhabs gras sku drag gcig kyang mi datredzes gsungs nas ma khrid/ phyis gangs ri nas zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nang la gdan 'khor dus rdzas nas dmag thon yod pas 1855 lor la dwags kyi rang dbang shora'u/ lo de nas bzung lo snar rnga5'i rgyal po gu lab sidha la khral snyan sgor dgu stong 'jil rgyu'i khas len snemadzad/de ni gtso cher yab kyi kha la ma mnyan par bka' bcug ste gang byung byas pa'i 'bras rtags su nges so//

95rgyal po mchotha/sprul bzhugs ma bde bar nub ra brgyud nas drang rtse dang / de nas spyi sta brgyud shim lar shor te phebs so//rgyal tshab tu gle'i blon po rā ju dngos grub bstan 'dzin bsgos/dngos grub bstan 'dzin lo lnga rgyal po byas/ lo drug ngo la wa zir phyir phog nas cher phebs/ dngos grub bstan 'dzin la lo lnga'i babs ma tshang zer nas sgor lnga stong dang / ba mgo'i bka' blon la sgor gsum stong / rgya pa jo la sgor chig stong / gzhan las byed thams cad la chad pa bcad do//de nas rgyal po 'jigs med seṅge mi 'gyur kun dga' rnam rgyal rgyal srid la bskos/ wazir rang nyid bzhengs nas rgyal po'i sku lus la kyen phab kyi na bza' gcig le na'i tsazar gnyis 'brel gcig/mag mal phug gcig gser gyi sor gdub zung gcig bcas phul te/nyid rang yab rgyal pos bskyur te bros/ nga'i dus su 'tshar/ ngas kyang khyod rang rgyal por mnga' gsol/ shrī sar kār mchog la lo re bzhin 'bab sgor chig khri brgyad stong phul/ de min la dwags mnga' khongs nas 'ong sgo ci skuld rgyal po rang la gnas 'jigs yin gsungs/

96yang rgyal po tshe dbang rab brtan gyi btsun mo skal bzang sgrol ma la 1845 lor sras bstan srung g.yul rgyal 'khrungs/ 'di mang spro'i mkhar du bzhugs/ sras che ba kun dga' rnam rgyal la gar lha'i khang gsar mkhar nas ga ga tā rā caji gyi sras mo tshe ring dbang mo mdun mar nus/ de la sras ma 'byor pas/ rub sho'i 'gro pa tshe ring bkra shis kyi sras mo nor 'dzin dbang mo mdun mar zhus/ de la rgyal sras bsod nams rnam rgyal 'khrungs/ de nas lo 'ga' song nas gzir zo ra war 'dod pas ma khengs par bod la dmag khyer nas sgar du bod dmag dang lan mang 'thabs/ mthar wazir tho ra par gyi rkang pa la me mda' phog nas rta sgog nas lhungs/ de ma thag mdung bsnun pa dang ral sgras sge bcad nas bod dmag rnams rgyal to//mang spro'i rgyal srid bzung ba'i bstan srung g.yal rgyal la sras bkra shis lha dbang 'khrungs/ de la sras gsum 'khrungs/ che ba mthu stobs rnam rgyal he mi dgon du grwa pa mdzod/ chung ba gnyis rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul mdzad do//

97de nas sras bsod nams rnam rgyal la gar zhwa'i lhar sgog mkhar nas sras mo mdzes ldan mdun mar zhus te rgyal srid bzung / zhing lug lor 'jigs med dgra 'dul rdo rje snyeb bstan rab 'phel dpal ldan chos skyong rnam rgyal 'khrungs/ me phag lor 7skyabs rje 'brug payongs 'dzin rin po che phebs nas la dwags stod gzham thams cad du ba/dul bya chen po byung / shing lug lor 7skyabs mgon 'bri dgung chung tshang rin po che gangs tram̐ se dang mtsho ma phagasogs la gnas mjal dang 'brel khrus gsol dang mchod 'bul/ dgon pa khag la nyams gso mdzad/de dus chos rgyal bsod nams rnam rgyal/ sgang sngon chos rje rtogs ldan/he mdzod ngag dbang chos bzang / la dwags kyi blon gras sbyin bdag gi gtso bo mun shi tshe ring dpal rgyas/ nang gso tsandan mun shi/ 'um la tshe dbang don grub/ srang ngar bsod nams rdo rje/ byams pa gsol dpon dkon mchog dang bkra shis lha rgyal bcas kyis la dwags su gdan zhus/yul stod dang / g.yung drung / skyed can bar du phebs pa dang / phebs lam rnams su bka' brdar bcas kyi zhabs phyi byas nas gdan zhus/bum sgrub tshe dbang dang dbang chen bcas stsal/ 'di'i skabs khrig se'i

98mkhan po he gnas sku pa rgyas sras ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ de'i rjes mchog sprul byams pa snanyags gnyis bcas phebs/ rgyal po 'di sku tshe mjug la rgan chos byas nas he mi dgon du bzhugs/ de nas sras dpal ldan chos skyong rnamargyal la gar zhwa kye langs gung rang rdo'i sras mo nyi zla dbang mo mdun mar zhus nas mkhar bzung / sras mo gcig dang sras che ba kun bzang rnam rgyal dang chung ba 'phrin las rnam rgyal dang sras mo gcig bcas 'khrungs/ rting na khong chos mdzod lamadzad nas sgrub pa nyams len mdzad kyin sku gshegs/ lha rā ṇa sī dang chu bo gaṅgā / rdo rje gdan sogs mjal bar phebs/ 'di'i skabs stag tshang rin po che ngag dbang 'jama'idapal dge legs rgyal mtshan/ khrig se mkhan sprul byams pa chos 'phel/ bzang la'i mkhar du 'khrungs pa'i ba ku la rin po che/sras rin po che blo bzang tshul khrims chos 'phel sogs dmapa du ma rdzongs 'dir byon nas 'gro ba'i blo dang mthun pa'i bstan 'gro'i bya ba rgya cher po mdzad/ de nas de'i sras che ba kun bzang rnam rgyal la gar zhwa stod pa jo'i sras mo purba ti de wi 'am bde bskyed dbang mo zhes pa mdun mar blangs te tog gi rgyal srid 'dzin/ de la sras mo 'jigs med

99dbang mo dang / rin chen dbang mo gnyis gagatogs sras ma 'khrungs/rgyal pokun bzang rnam rgyal dmag mir zhugs nas dmag dpon me rjer gyi shes gnas bzhes/ rgyal po 'di 1942 'tsher tog gi mkhar du bltams/ de min rgyal po snga ma rnams shel mkhar du bltams rjesal 81da pa de 1974 lor gle'i dmag mi'i sman khang nang du sku gshegs/sras chung ba 'phrin las rnam rgyal mang spro'i dgon du bla ma mdzad/rjes su mi rnams kyis rgyal rgyud kyi che du btsun mo bzhes dgos zhus don ltar sngar gyi btsun mo bde skyed dbang mo dang 'brel ba las sras 'jigs med dbang phyug rnam rgyal dang dam dkon mchog rnam rgyal gnyis 'khrungs/ de dag gi skabs bla ma byung tshul/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa rta lor ba ku la rin po che blo bzang thub bstan mchog nor mang spro'i rgyal sras su 1917 'i1ra 'khrungs/ rab byung de'i lcags spre 1920lor stag sna sprul sku don yod rdo rje mar rtse lang du 'khrungs/ rab byung de'i chu khyi 1922 'i(ra 'phags yul bkras lhun mkhan po sngags chen rin po che dka' chen blo bzang bzod pa shar sngas yul du 'khrungs/rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yos 1927 lor ri rdzong sras sprul blo

100bzang thub ba na nor bu mang spro'i mkhar du 'khrungs/ rab byung de'i sa snag 1938 lor sgang sngon rtogs ldan sprul sku thub bstan bstan pa'i nyi ma ldo phug gong ma'i khyem du 'khrungs/ rab byung de'i lcags 'brug 1940 lor he mi snag tshang sprul su ba na 'dzin chos kyai nyi ma bod byang 'bri gung klung shod zur phu sgang du 'khrungs/ rab byung de'i chu lug 1943 lor khrig se shar sprul rin po che ngagadabang byams pa bstan 'dzin chu thod 'bi'u lu pa zhes pa'i khyegadu 'khrungs/ rababyung de'i me khye 1946 lor mnga' ris sprul sku bsnan 'dzin chos rgyal lha ldan lcang ra shar dang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i yab gzhir 'khrungs/bla ma de rnams kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bya ba mdzad tshul ni rang rang gi rnam thar las shes par bya'o/ /de dag gi skabs de nas zung mi mangs la dbang cha rnyed/ gle'i nya bcu'i bsod nam nor bu sogs srid lugs la mkhas pa du ma byung / spyi lo 1947 le1ra rgya gar la rang dbang thob/ 1948 sa byi chenar la dwags su gnam gru sgospu/mar slebs/1954 shing 'brug lor shrī nā gar nas gle bar gyi mo ṭor gyi lam bsod nams nor bus grub bcug nas mo ṭar 'byor/ 1974 shing

101྅re| /khri/ la tsho /)/rdo the ni //( 1dostag ra rgyal pa rnams la dwags su lta skar du nga 'a gas/ nas bzung la dwags kyai yul rdzongs 'dir mi nor tshang ma yar 'i zla ba bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel/ 1966 lor 7skyabs rje ba ku la blo bzang thub bstan mchog nor dpal bzang tsho dbu 'dren mdzad nas 7gong sa rgyal ba yid bzhin nor la dwags su 'go ma gdan zhus te/gle'i jo khang du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang chen stsal/1976 lor 7gong sa rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa sku 'phreng bcu bzhi pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho phebs nas zhi ba'i tshal du dus khor pho brang du la dwags ser skya pho mo rnams la dpal dus kyi khor li dbang chen rdul //rdo /// //) 〈sna|'o ri 4 4 shāsne/ shes na da la ra la brtan nas nyan gsum rang gas par stsal //

/02zangs dkar 'a/la/zangs dkar chags tshul gyi lo rgyus thung tsam brjod na/ bde legs yon tan kun 'dus rje btsun bla ma dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma yis/ /'dod dgu mchog mthun dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /de la bkrashis g.yang chags zangs dkar gnams chos 'byung 'dir/ dang thog gling ge sar phebs nas/ sa gzhi thams cad zhabs kyis bcag ༷: rgyan padma phebs nas/ mi ma yin rnams dam la btags/ sa bkra ngan pa rnams mnan nas/ srin mo gan kyil du 'grel blta bu'i sa gzhi matre0re khar sa ni ka ni ka /snying khar pi pi stang gi gnya' nam gu ru/ rkang pa'i khar byams gling gi gnya' nam gu ru rnams bzhengs nas/ rgya gar gyi dur khrod bde chen brdal dang 'dra bar lung bstan/ de'i sgo srung shar du tsore/ lgo na dpal lha mo/ nub na dur lha zhakhrug pa/ byang na yid bzhin gyi nor bu yod de/ de'i dkor bdag tu jo po spyan gcig ma/ sa ni'i tshogs dang bya rnams dur shing dang du bya ru dang / mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas su lung bstan/ yul chags tshul

/03byang ngos su rang 'thag sha dang ri nam/ gho ngos su pib ca dang ku mi chags pa'i thog ma yin/ de nas gzhan rnams rigapar chags/de rgyas su song ba'i skabs su kha chul gyi gamatshag byas/ drang rtse'i mkhar kham pas zin ('dzin ) pa'i dus/ phar tshur nas rta shor mi shor mang du byung bas/ stong sde bar la gnod pa sna tshogs byas pas/lan du gu ge'i khrir dmag 'a༄1ngas nas/ zangs dkar gyi yul rnams dang / mkhar thams cad me yis bsregs/ mi mang po bsad/ lhag lus khyer nas yul stong / de'i rjes su phyogs phyogs nas mi mang po 'ongs pa la brten nas yul chags pas/ dpa' gtum zhang zhung gis bzung / byang ngos skya pas bzung / stong sde lha sa dang gung blon khye shang gsumakhagyis bzung /de'i skabs su rkun jag la sogs pa byung ba la brten nas dka' ngal chen po byung bas/ spyi sta'i gu ge'i phyogs nas lha chen shā kya thub pa zer ba zhig gdan zhus nas/ zangs dkar pa kun gyis rgyal por bkur/de la rgyal mo 'bru sha nas 'khyongs/ nang par bag phyag la byon pas lamodu yab rgod pas rgyal mo 'phrogs nas/ rgyal po shāka thub bkrongs su

104bcug de'i rjes su rgyal mo sras bu zhig bltams nas/ chung ba'i dus su gsos/ lo lnga pa'i dus su yab rgod pas/ nga'i bu min zer nas/bdag po mabargyabs pa'i rkyen gyis kha chul du song nas/ ga rog kun gyi gtseb tu bsdad pas/ byad gzugs ngan pa'i stabs kyis rigs bzang ngan ma shes te/ glang po che la brtag tu bcug pa'i tshul bstan nas/pus mo btsugs ste de nas shāka thub kyi bu la btsugs pas/ de kun gyis rigs can yin par shes nas/ ming seṅge ldor btags te/ kha chul rgyal po'i bu mo btang / ka skra bar gyi rgyal srid sbyin nas der bzhugs/de la bu gsum byung gal/ che ba la ka skra bar gtad/ khong rang gnyis bu dang bcas pa thon pa/ blo bzang lde la dpon tse'i chu'i bcad sa tshun chod lgo ngos kyi rgyal srid gtad/ khri nam lde la chu yi byang ngos dang tshozar bzang la/ me lce'i grog po man chad gtad/ blo bzang sde'i dus su gu ge nas jo dpa' dar zer ba zhig der byon te/ rgyal po la gser sga dang / g.yu'i srab phul nas/ bib cabaca' ba shun gsum gsol pa yin/ jo dpa' dar yul de gsum gyi mi dang bsdongs/ yar yul phyogs kyi tshong pa mi bcu bdun bsad nas/ gad gragadu pas pa /

/05dbyar dus chus 'byongs nas/ dngos mi re'i rjes su rtsad chod byung bas/ shun du ma chags par/ mar gzhung la bros/de'i skabs su rgyal po blo bzang lde'i sras gsum yod pas/ che ba tshang rgyal po la dbon tse'i chu bzhags tshun/ dbyi khal mar gling gi tsan dan 'phrang ag ce'i lung pa man chad/ bca' ba yang de'i dus gtad/ che ba tshang rgyal po yin/ rgyal po chung ba bde mchog skyabs zer gal rgyal po ra dug la mar thang gi bugs su yod pa'i lung pa man chad/tsha zar me gyelung pa yan chad/ phug dal gyi stong sde phrang yan chad/ zha phyag gi brag nag tshun chod/ g.ya' gnatshimatsho gar zhwa'i chu yi tho mo che man chad/ stong sde'i sa khyad yin/ de'i skabs stod sde'i ling dpon blo gros dpal sgrub yin/ bde mchog skyabs pa la sne stag rtse'i lung pa man chad/ gar zha chu tshun chad/ zhing kun la tshun chad gtad pa yin/khri nam dpal lde'i sras rgyal bsam rin chen dpal lde dang 6ltaga'adzom pa rgyal mo gnyis kyai dus su/ byang sems kyi sbyin bdag mdzad nas/ dgas rkang / dar lang dang / tshozar gsum chos gzhi la phul pa la brten nas/ tshazar gyi dgon mo che btabs/ de'i rjes su mkha'

106'gro'i sku la brten pa/ byi gdakar mo zhig gis 'a rtsasna byas/ phyaga'atshal sgang du phebasapa dang / byi ba gar song cha med du phong / phug dal nas lha'i brdungs byung ba dang / yar phebs nas/ drang sgong gsum gyis bsu ba dang bcas/ phug dal duspyon phebs/ drang sgong gsugagyis bsnyen bkur byas nas/ rigs/ bu khyod legs so byas nas/dgon pyodang g.yu mkhar gyi zhing /ring gcigadang bcas phul nas/ nged gsucasagyi gdul bya rdzogs nas mi 'dug pas/ khyod kyis 'di bsnams la bstan pa dang / sems can dzeephan pa rgya chen po mdzod/ ces gsungs nas/ drang srong gsum po phyagapa gzhan du phebs/ de'i dus su dpa' gtuganas tshang rgyal (tshe dbang rgyal po)pos mar gling phul/rtse ste'i bde mchog skyabs/ skyed nyi dro gra ma can dang yan dang / thang so man chad phul/ de rjes su byang sems dang tshang rgyal po gnyes bka' bgros mdzad nasabade mchog skyabs la/ khyed kyis nged gnyisal dkor dpon btsug dashesas pa 'dug pas/ sa gzhi zhig byi na cithataces zhu ba phul pas/khong rang la zhing dang las mi khral pa bcas phran bu por nas/ de lhag

107thams cad rgyal po dang bla moganyis la yul dang ri tshang mophul/ klung sa gang yin kho rang la bor/khul yan du tshang rgyal po'i dus su yar kyen nas mir za nyelhar dmag gsum stong khrid de 'ongs pas/ tshang rgyal po yul mi dang bcas lha'i lung par bros pas/ rjes su dpa' gtum gyi mkhar khos zin ('dzin )pas/ tshang rgyal pos bca' ba mkhar pa'i chos grub dpon po 'dzogapa'i drung du btang byung bas/ nga la gtam snyan zhu rgyu yod byas nas shod du bcug pas/ rgyal pos mdzo khyung rogapo dang 'gar khra leb gnyis nga la stsal/ khyed rang la g.yu mkhar gyi grong gnyis rnamasaphul zhu 'du ga byas pas/ mdzo khyung rog dang 'gar khra leb phul pa'i chogagayu mkhar ba grong gnyis nga la mi dgos/ nga ste ste pa dang yon mchod yin pas mi dgos zhus/ mdzo dang rgyal nor gzhan yang stsal nas/rang mir zashe ra khyod mi spyang po zhig min nam/ 'di ru ma sdod/log la song / mon pa du sbagadang dmag mang po de ring rang slegayong zer bas/ mir za helhar nyin mtshan shor nas/ su ru dkar rtse la bud

108song ba dang / de'i rjes su sgron po la ag tse man chad/ kha ce lhab tseyan chad/ phug dal pa la phul payin/yang tshang rgyal po'i dus su u pa rag gi jo 'jaladabyangs pa dkar rtser shong song bas/ de'i rjes ha zhi jos dmag bskul nas 'khyong ba'i dus su/ dpa' gtum na kha bakhru re babs yod pa/ der slebs pa dang / dpa' gtulamakhar la 'dzigs yod pa'i bud med bzhi yis mgar ra rta sgo ru mun rdo 'phangs pas/ jo 'jim dbyangs de ru shi/mkhar yul med pa dmag gis gang / tshang rgyal po phyi 'tshog tu bcings nas/ zur rtse'u'i sgrog mda' la gtags skuld 'dug pas/ phug dal nas drung pa rab bstan mar bskyod nas/ rgyal po sgrog mda' nas bkrol/phug dal na tshogs bzang gis mgo byas nor mang po khyer te ha zhi sdo la zhu ba phul nas/ rgyal po la zhus nas yul mi phal cher stsolag de lhag khyer te/ dkararer slebs song ba/ tshogs bzang tshang (chang)bskan(bskangs )nas bkrashis byas pa'i/ tshogs bzang phar gro tshura'agro byas pas/ de rjes su yul der mi mang po shi ba dang /tshogs bzang phug dal du skyel bar 'khyongs/ dpyid ka dpa' gtugapa

109grags pa dpal bzang po nya pa sogs kyis ha zhi jo la phyag byas pa 'bu thos yongs/ sa nas sa la bsdad pa'i/ yang 'bu zos rtses sna nyi shu rtsagacigathongs shig gsungs pa dang / de ltar btangs pas/ sku mdun gyis mi thams cad tab rgod byas pas/ thugs mnyes nas/ sa ni pa/u pa rag pa/ pi pi stang pa dang / dpa' gtum gsum gyi yul mi tshang gaphyir log btang nas 'khyongs so//de dus su mu ni'i lha rtse ma gtogs/ mu nee yul pa dang sa khyad thams cad dang mu nee nas zhing khang cig la sogs pa'i sa khyad rnams drung pa rababastan la phul pa yin/ ha zhi jo dang byongs (byang ngos)rgyal po/dpa' gtum gyi rgyal po gsum bzang 'grig pas/ pu rig gi rgyal po dang byang ngos (dkar sha dgon pa'i 'og tshang mal gnas pa'i mai mang )kyi rgyal po gnyis kyis dpa' gtumagyi rgyal po la chad don byas par/khyod kyis drung pa rababartan la/ dgon pa 'debs pas sa khyad chos gzhi dang bcas pa phul na/ bzang 'grig gsu bar brten/ sa khyad phul pa ltar dgon pa btab pa'i sa la nag tshangs yan chod/ chu sdon gyi sgang man chad/ chos gzhi la bla mkhye phrug gi chu bab sa/ gro zho man thang

110tshun/ rgya lam gyen chod dpa' gtubagyi rang 'thag yan chod/ u pa ragadang zam zhing gi dbyar gnas la agabe'i tshogs bcas phul pa yin/yang tshang rgyal po la hor mi rigs (3 dmag)lan gnyis byung bas/ phyi ma la hor mi rigs 'gro ma nyan par/ drung pa rab brtan gyis chibs gsum phul par rten kho phar sgrog de'i gtang rag la rgya gong 'og gnyis tshogs dang bcas phul payin/ stong sde rgyal po ra dug la ba sgo'i rgyal po'i dmag byung bas/ de dus rgyal po ra dug pas mthugapar/ phug dal nas bla yoslobadapon rnams phebs nas/ nor mang po phul nas/ ba sgo'i rgyal po la zhu gzhus nas/ rgyal po ra dug pa dang tshang yotshazar mel tse lung pa nas slog nas lusangs/ stong sde'i rgyal por bkal pas/ de'i bdag rkyen du stong sde yur gabrag nag yan phug dal la stong sde phrang yan sre ba can gyi la tshun chad/ 'o ma lung gi la tshun chad/ zha sbug gi stong sde brag sne zer saman chad/ ya nam maḥṭā tshun gar zha'i chu'i sgo 31 che man chad phul pa yin/

111rgyal po blo bzang dpal lde'i dgongs rdzogs su tshe dbang rgyal pogazha ser thog la zhon labagyisachos bzhi pi pi stang / ub ste/ su ru gsum mdo dang bcas phul/ yang tshe dbang rgyal pos byang sems chos gzhi ru phu pal/ dpa' gtum dud khagacig shi lha (shing lhag)dud khagacig 'ib cadu dud kha gsum/ te la ring gri gul rdzongasakyi bu gu/ rshardo la skor ra ru'i mar tang bcas phul/ yang tshang rgyal po'i yangakyi dgongs rdzogs la/ byang sems dkor du phul pa la/mkhar smad podud khagacig gnyer ba nya ra la/ mdzod pa ya gadrag pa dang gsum phulapa yin/ shi lha nas mkhar dang chun pa chen po gnyis zhesale bcas phul pa yin/ ste ste'i jo shag lde'i phul pa la/ phi thelaphan gar zha chu'u tshun chad phul payin/ jo khra rig gis phul pa la/ zhing khang gsuyodang / sa nidagon 'ogadang bcas phul g.yin/ yang byang sems la mar yul stod kyi rgyalapo mnga' bdag pas phul pa la/ ru shod nas lung pa shes rong / ra pho mchod rten gyi skor rnams dang / nag mtshur tshwa kha rkyang chu'i grog po gsum/ shel gni can 'gro yan chad phul pa yin/ nyung sta rgyal pos phul pa la/ chos sku rtse'i dgon pa yan

2chad/ lagaphrang zho gling / gye mur gre gri mos/ zhi bde'i lung pu phu mdo dang bas phul/drung pa sangs rgyas blo gros dkar sha'i dgon bdag mdzad nas/de ru spyan longs pa dang / dkar sha pas khong bton btang / de nas drung patshe dbang bstan pa/ tso po tshe ring dpal sde/ blon po rgyal mtshan rnams kyis bdag rkyen mdzad nas pi pi stang du 'khyongs/ khong lo bcu gcig bzhugs nas grongs/ g.yung drung pa tshe dbang bstan pas zhing che chung bdun drung pa tshe dbang rab brtan la lto skal la btangs/ yang g.yi 4 gyi rgyal po be to pos phul pa la/ g.yi car mkhar snang ba btso ba nas srod ma'i mal blo bzang tshe ring gi mal gsum phul pa yin/ ces /// theb ྅rngo/ /ji/ /// /go shelha ྅rngo/ /rdo phug thal 'a ga ba//sa pa lugs ga ltar sa na //

113spangs dkar bzang la'i rgyal rgyud kyi sgor/spun mched che ba ( lha chen)dpal mgon la dwags rgyal po mdzad/ chung ba bde gtsug mgon zangs dkar pa dam (dpal sdum)rgyal po mdzad/ de'i sras seṅge lde/ de'i sras 'dzom grags lde dang /chung ba maṅgal lde/ 'dzocasagrags lde dpal sdum mkhar na bzhugs/spun mched maṅgal ldes bzang la la bdag brgyabs pa'i gdung rabs 'di bzhi'o/ /maṅga la lde'i sras rin chen dpal lasde/ (de'i sras dge 'dun dpal lde ) de'i sras bsod nams dpal lde/ de'i sras bkra shis dpal lde/ de'i sras mgon dpal lde dang drung pa rgyal tshab (bla ma'i bel sa'i ming ngo )brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ che ba'i sras gnyis las chung ba drung pa rgyal tshalabartson 'grus rgyal mtshan dkar sha dgon par bla ma byas/ che bamagon po dpal ldes rgyal srid mdzad nas de la sras gnyis/ nam mkha' dpal lde dang bla ma mdzad pa'i drung pa phyag pa shel bzang rgyal mtshan/ che ba'i sras gnyis khri dpal lde dang tshe dbang dbas rje/ che ba'i sras tshe dbang rab bstan dpal lde/ chung ba

114zhabs drung rmetsho bzang ye shes rgyal mtshan bla ma mdzad/ che ba'i sras ye shes dpal lde/ de la sras bsod nams dpal lde dang ye shes rnamargyal lde/ che ba'i sras ye shes mtha' yas bla ma byas/ bar g.ye shes don yod dpal lde/ tha chung ye zhes phun tshogs dpal lde'i sras mo zla mdzes dbang mo// de'i mag pa don grub tshe dbang dpal sde/ de gnyis chung ba'i dus su ye shes phun tshogs dpal lde grongs nas/ de'i lcam rgyal po bkrashis bsam grub bya samag par bsnams nas/ de gnyis kyis na gzhon pa de gnyis kyi mgo skyong mdzad/ zla mdzes dbang mo la sras gsum/ hākho bzang rnam rgyal dpal gne (grongs)/ sku mchog ba ku la/chung g.ye shes tshul khrims (da lta shi nas med) blo bzang rnam rgyal dpal lde'i sras tshul khrims nyi ma/ ri rdzong dgon pa'i sku mchog (da lta'ang yod)/ chung ba tshe brtan rnamargyal sde (grongs)la sras bsod nams don grub rnam rgyal lde dang sras mo bstan 'dzin dbang mo (da rung phru gur yod/)

11521thegaskusgo (spu3ni byerdo 'a /) zi11rgyal na da dang sa phun gas gnyis sa wa ra ra tso la ra mda' mang po byas nas/ lo 9 song ba dang / rgyal po de gnyis tshe 'das/ (la dwags rgyal tsho ming mthar rnam rgyal lam lha dang zangs dkar la de'i tshagatu gne 'dug)//'phya74

116rgya shis skor/lhag par du rgyal sras rin po che'i gsung las/ la dwags rgyal po rigabyon pa yis bu la gsang gtagabaka' chems kyai tshul du/ rgya pa jo bo'i rigs mkhar gyi las tshan mtho sar mi bskyal te/ mtho sar bskyal na/ la dwags rgyal po yu'a'i'akhor tshang ma la srab bcug nas/zhon pa zhig yongs las mi 'os tshul/ gsungs pa shes ldan kun la rlung ltar du brdal ba yin 'dug kyang / mes nyi ma'i skabs/ rgya pa jo bo 'brug grags kyi nu po thog mar btsun pa/ phyis de las ldog te/rgyal po nyi ma'i drung 'khor du chud/ mi ring bar bka' blon du 'khel/de nas brtsams te/ la dwags rgyal po'i dbang thang gi steng nas za bar rngamapa 'ba' zhig byas na dus 'das shing / dper na/ sa zhing kho nas mtshon na/ kho rang sabu skrun rnams nas mkhar gyi sa rigs kha nas gsang chod du blangs pa dang / mkhar gyi phyag 'debs nyo ma(nya ma )nas kha la rtse'i bar phyogs gcig tu baspelams na/ de bas ldab 'gyur las kyang lhag pa tsam da lta mngon sum 'di yin tshod la/ pu rig a khu

117mul be'i rgyal po'i dbang yul du yang blon bsod kyi bu spun gyi sa zhing dang / a khu rgyal po'i phyag 'debs gnyis :rton po la lag 'debs byas pa ma nges yod skad dang / der ma zad/ blon po'i 'bangs sde yang a khu la brngo ba tsam yod 'dug pa/ de thams cad la dwags rgyal po'i dbang thang steng nas gsang chod byas pa kho na yin la/ kho rang gi pha gzhis dngos ma ni/ gong zhus la dwags stod kyi rgya yi mkhar sde/ de ni la dwags yul srol bzhin bu rgan bas 'dzin pa las/ gzhon pas mi thob ste/ don des rgya pa jo bo mi rabs ci rnyed mang du byung ba yang bu chung chos sgor zhugs bzhis/ thems rkang gcig las ma 'phel la/ngeng kyi mes nyi ma'i skabs/ mkhar gyi sa ris blon pos ci bder spyod chog pa byung gzhis/ blon bsod rang gis bu skrun chos sgor gcig kyang yobacug nas/ mkhar gyi sa gzhis phangs med du bshes sha byas/ kho rang gi bu mo rnams mkhar gyi sras mo'i dod du dpon khag rnams la bag mar btang / rigs kyang mnga' bdag yin pas/ mthar rgyal srid dngos thob bar re zhing / mkhar du dbangachodadangachodayod (mchordoyon )hamapa tshabs po che 'ba' zhig gi(sa)dus 'das pas/ 'bangs gyen

118ldog gi rnam pa bzod dka' byas pa/ rgya dkar rgya nag bod kyai rgyal po mtshogs/ rgyal srid la rgya'i bdatharapo su yin bsams kyang / bka' khrims kyis rtsar btang dgos 'os su bab pa'i ngang tshul zhib par dag thog zhu tshig 'bul dgos yod kyang / bzang mtshams lo dus la zhib gleng mi dgos pa dang / der ma zad/ mtha' dag nyan pa yang / mi spyod tshul bka' nan lci ba phebs snabs 'dir zhu ma spobs shing / gang ltar blon tshul rang nas mkhar la rtsis med kyi la rgyar gnod 'gal shin tu che bar brten/ mkhar nas rgyal khrims kyis rje bton gtong dgos byung song ba dang / blon bu gnyis nged la srog skyob tu byung bzhin/ nged nas kyang srog skyob rje dam pa la'abrug pa'i bka' bzhin kha zhe med par byas pa/dkon mchog dpang bzhag yin yang / nged la rtsis med mgo bsgor btang / he mi dgon pa sngar nas nag chen mtha' dag thar pa'i gling yin kyang / de la yang cha 'jog pa med par/ slad mar dgon sde'i bstan don la rgya la gnod pa'i dper 'os pa byas nas/ gros te asmyokhu rgyal po'i rtsar song /

119rgya pa jo la stod rgyal po bya ste/ mul be'i rgyal po (jo)la smad po ri de sa snatsho stongargyal bya sta/ gnyas shugs ga yad da 'dugargya pa ja shal sman sta'i 'o dezhi ngabla bar mag mal bslangs nas mkhar la ngas/ ban mul ba pob tibi brgyal da thub khang ltag bar mag mal bslangs nas mkhar la sa'ikhri yoge snyo 1———— —————nga ba mas da pa na ces zer //

120dbang po tshulakhrims rdo rje'i sgor/(7dpa' bo tshul khrims rdo rje ni/ chos rgyal nyi ma rnam rgyal (168041720)phan gyi phyag las nyi las pa mang po mdzad pas/ rgyal po'i phyogs nas khong la bstod bsngags bris te phul par mdzad/ de'i 'dra bzhus 'di la gzigs mdzod/na/ zhabs 'degs grub pa rnams gsal por khungs ldan du brjod na/mi'am ci'i grogs gyur/ tasbu ra'i rgyud mang bsdebs pa lta bu'i snyan tshig tu cung zad gling bar bya bas/ khyed cag kun rna ba'i sgo legs par gtod la dga' bar gyis shig tshul khrims rdo rje 'di rang lo bcu drug gi skabs bsod nams lhun grub dang mnyam kha pu lur phyin nas/ zhabs 'degs kyi thog mar bha bha ha tham khran 〈bu 'dzin 'chang gi skabs blo rig grim pos nyin mtshan du ma ltos pa/ dgra 'thabs kyis bya bar blo 'jug pa'i hur thag byas pas yul du phan pa byung ba dang / shing mo lug ( 1715 )lor 7gong sa nged yab sras rnams pa skyum la dmag 'jug tu phebs dus tshul khrims kyis gang spyir mtshan gyi byag brda selags 'thab rar song nas/ nyin mtshan ltos med du hur theg mig ltos la phan pa byas shing /

skyi 121me skre (1716 )lor 'dab lad khyan dang nang ma mthun par/shi sgar pa dpung du sbran nas/ sa gling mkhar bzung nas bha lhar 'u thug po 'gro skabs/ bsod nams lhun grub dang mnyam du phyin nas/ sa gling mkhar nas 'dab lad khyan phab skabs dmag stabs kyi gros rogs dang gang spyir bsod nams lhun grub gyis ngag bsgos hur theg byas 'dug pa dang /sa mo phag ( 1719)lor skar rdo pa la shi sgar nas dmag brgyabs/ 'jigs skrag ma bzod par 'di gar dpung rogs zhus par/tshul khrims rdo rje de skabs rang skya 'pher ba byung nas/ dmag mgor btang bar/ ha nu bar phyin nas/ shi sgar pa la snga 'gros pho nya zhi drag gnyis kyi sgo nas bsrings nas/ de bar ha nur 'then 'dug par/ blo gros kyi 'jug pa thabs la mkhas shing / nad steng du sman slebs pa lta bu song nas/ de thog nas dmag bteg dgos med pa shi sgar pa 'di ga'i zhabs 'og tu 'thus pa byung /lcags byi (1720)lor bsod dang dkar rtse gnyis gcig srid byas/ kha rul dang chu thug sogs pha ro'asapos bzung skabs/ chu

122thug dkar rtse'i phyogs la dmag mgor rab brtan btang / bsod phyogs la dmag mgor tshul khrims rdo rje btang bar/ gur sgar thang du dmag sgar btsugs bsod phyogs brgyud dmag lugs su thal mar phyin nas/ mkhar gdong du 'khrug pa song bas/ mkha' ('gro )ri la/ri (snar dmag 'degs btang) bar/ tshur skyon cung zad tsalamed par ri sna bcag nas/ (mkha' 'gro)ri bzung bar sna ltag tu dmag sgar btsugs nas zhag bdun gyi bar mkhar skor btang bar/ sbag ram lhag phab/ khas slangs nas 'dir phyag la 'aX1ngas/ mu stag khyan la sbar rtse dang lha lung bsil mo sogs mkhar skal du btangs/ bsod kyi mda' man chen 31 bcas gtam don du phan rgyur 'dir 'a(1ngas so//chu stag (1722)lor shi sgar jo gzam khyan gyis/ skar rdo sbal sta mtha' dag rong yul 'bru sha sogs rang dbang bdag bsdus byas/lha lha ha tham khyan la dmag bshams pas/ 'jigs skrag chen po byung nas/ 'di gar dpung dmag gi rogs ram zhus pas/ dgun zla 12pa kha ba'i dus byang la phyogs nas tshul khrims rdo rje dmag mgor brdzangs par/ ldum ra brgyud nas ma 'gyangs par phyin nas/ bha bha ha thagakhyan

123pha bu jo bran dang mi zhim pa sogs mtshams sbyor bzang pos nang 'grig tu bcug skye ris kyi khar thad dar phyin nas/ ku res sogs su bya ma mthong par mkhar yul sogs lagatu blangs/ skye ris su 'khrug pa song bar/ mir gyi bu zhigarang phyogs rngas lag thal du song nas shi skabs/ rang phyogs kyi sbal ti jo bran thams cad nas rang re chos lugs kyi gtaga'adon rtsis pa'i/ thams cad dgrar gyur pa sogs dka' ngal phrad dus/ tshul khrims rdo rje 'di dgra phyogs su dpa' la/rang phyogs su mdzangs shing / zur mkhas pa'i blo gros kyi 'jug pa rgya cher bskyed nas/ phyi nang thog mtha' bar gsum du gang la gang 'tshams kyi mtshams sbyor byas par/ rang phyogs kyi sbal ti rnams kyi blo 'gugs thub pa byung nas/ skye ris mkhar la mgyogs kyi 'phrul 'khor btsugs nas/ mag mud khyan srog rtsig tsam ('jigs pa tsam)yang 'gro ma bcug par/ spab (phab)nas mkhar lag tu blangs shing /de'i 'o rangs su/ shi sgar skar rdo rong yul 'bru sha sogs kyi dmag dpung phyogs cig tu bsgril nas/ rang phyogs dmag sgar thog mchongs nas 'khrug 'thab chen po 'gro dus/ tshul khrims nas rmetsho gros kyi 'dzim

124stabs ma 'khyor bar ya nga bag tsha med par/ dgra 'thab la mkhas pa'i bkod pa thogs pa med par bsgrigs nas phar 'thabs pas rol po'i dpung chen dus cig tu pham bcug sarol po shi ba dang mtshon sogs rtsis su med pa phal cher tshur 'khyongs shing / (dgasde )'jig rten pha rol gyi lam du brdzangs/ go mtshon rta dang bcas pa tshur blangs skul /ji ltar zhes bya na/ gzhan sde 'joms pa la mchog du rngagapa'i dmag dpon/ dgra thog tu mi bsrun pa'i gzugs kyi dpa' skong / mi snyan pa'i ngag gis tshar gcod/ snying rje med pa'i yid kyis dgra bo rtsalag dang bcas pa gzhob tu sreg pa la dpa' ba'i me phung lta bur gyur cing / pha rol g.yul las rnam par rgyal bas/ mtshani don la rgyal srid rtser 'degs pa'i byed po kho nar gyur zhing / shi sgar jo ha san khyan 'jigs skrag chen pos rang yul 'bru sha phyogs su gros/ slar tshul khrims shi sgar du phyin nas/ a li khyan mkhar du jo la bskos/ skar rdo ru 4mad tha par khyan jor bsgos/ skar stag sha/ par kya ta/ rtol ṣka sogs nas jo gzir bcas rang rang gi dmag rnams dang bcas der phyag

125'bul du legs (po byed)par 'tshogs shing / 'di ga'i mtshon don du/ zhi sgar gyi shing rgyal che ba rnams bcad/ brag la yi ge bris/ stsodan dus thog mar yal pa'i sang rgyamasang po'i gdung gi ring sgel gyi phung po can/ sangs rgyas bse rur sku bltams pa'i rwa co/ du sbag dkar rtse pa sermegs dang / lcags kyi mda' man ming grags can mtshogs 'di gar phyag tu 'byor zhing / gzhan yang rang spen rtse ( sman mdzer)khung bur yal ba'i lag cha rta ha rib sogs rjes sob thub pa byung zhing / mdor na sbal ti rigs can thams cad kyi spobs pa thung ngur byed pa'i gnyen po kho nar gyur to//chu yos ( 1723)lor gces ma nor 'dzin dbang mo/ glo'i sde pa bcas phar phebs skabs su/ tshul khrims rdo rje gdan skyel du brdzangs pas/ blo re sde pa yab nas mdzad ma bde ba zhig la/ 'dzum lang ba dang 'khon/ sde pa rang / a phyi nor 'dzin/ zhal ngo dpon blon bzhi bcu skor skag rdzong du mon gyis btson du bzung nas/ glor mon gyi 'jigs nyen gyis gzir dus/ tshul khrims rdo rje bro shod du phyin nas/sde 'ching lha dur sku zhogs zhu sbyor mkhas pa byas nas sog po rta pa brgya

126sgor zhig dang / la dwags pa bdun cu skor bcas kyis/ gle'i dmag zhib bskul byas skag rdzong du dmag drangs par/ rdzong nang nasamon gyis 'khrug 'thab la ngar ba rnams phyir thon nas/ nye bar slebs nas 'thab mo mtshong bar/ tsetshon gyi rgyal po gcig tshul khrims kyis me mda' brgyabs nas bkums pa dang / slar dmag 'thabs bcag nas re na mang tsam mtshon thog tu shi ba dang / de thog 'dzing ra btsugs nas gru'i rgyal por bang chen bsrings par/ gru pa'i mon stong phrag cig slebs byung ba dang / skag rdzong la skor rgyag dam du btang bar/ nyin mtshan bco brgyad kyai bar 'thabs nas/ slar mon gyi rgyal po phab/ mkhar bslangs nas/yab sde pa/ a phyi nor 'dzin/ zhal ngo dpon blon bzhi bcu tsalatshur lag tu blangs shing / pon dang 'dus pa(mthun pa )byas/ sngon dus bhi ( lha khri ) sras dang bsagagrub dpal 'bar gyi skabs sdon sgrol rgyun la gnas dgos kyai phan tshun gnyis su mna' chad dam po bris/skag rdzong gi mgon po'i sku rdo nag las grub pade dang / rgyal po rang gi lcags kyi phrang ba rnams dpang du bzhag nas/ 'chings dang bsgrigs nas zhabs 'degs phul du phyin pa grusapadang / ji ltar na/ khyab 'jug gi

127dpa' brtul dang phur bu'i tā( gros zung du 'brel ba nang bzhin la dwags kyi bstan srid la rgyar mtshan don du snyan pa sogs bod kun gyi dpa' bo brjod du gling rgyu'i byas can kho na byung ba dang /sa bya (1729)lor dri ba dris lan du pho nye (nya'i)sgo nas/gu ge nas 'di khar mdun ma pa'i skor du / sdon du mi sna drag pa re skyar nas yang yang brdzangs kyang / don rtsa(thag gcod/)chod pa zhig ma byung rnga/sa/ slar tshul khrims rdo rje btang bar/ 'gyangs med du 'dir gdan 'dren byas pa dang /zhing stag ( 1734)lor ngos nyid sa yi tshangs pa chen po khrir khod nas/ mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru ma35na 'phyar zhing /rin po che sna bdun la longs spyod pa'i skabs dang por/ 〈(rol ba )rgol nag phyogasasbal tram̐ rigs can rnams glags lta ba'i phyir/ 'di ga'i sa mtshams kha pu 'edzir sgon nas/ 'do lad khyan la srog rtsigs ('jigs) tsam yang mi 'gro ba la 'u thug skabs/ 'di gar dpung rogs zhus byung bar/ 'di ga nas rang nyid kyi la rgya'i thog g.yin snabs/ tshur 3rlol gyi dgra bo gnya' ba rengs su bcug pa'i mi 'thus

128shing / ngos nyid sa yi bdag po chen po nyid kyai chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur zhing / snga 'a11sa su rgyug dmag lugs su bzang mkhar 65 khu lags dang tshul khrims rdo rje btang bar/ ji ltar 'brug gi sgra dbyangs mi zad par thos tshe/ ngang pa'i khyu tshogs dngangs shing skrag nas/ phyogs bcur gros pa la brtson pa bzhin/ phyir (tshur)rgol ba mtha' dag gi snying shugs thon te/ glog skyebs kyi sbugs su skyabs la 'dzoms de 'dar zhing zhum pa/ slan chad rgol ba'i spobs pa spreg med du bcom pal mngags pa'i gnyen por gyur pa gang de nyid/ pharol po dpung chen gyi steng du dmag chen rnams dang / rgya mtsho chen por ngang pa 'jug pa bzhin/ the tshom med par phyin nas/ pharol gyi dmag gsugastong lnga brgya brtson du bzung / gsum brgya skor 'jig rten phyi ma'i lamadu ltad mor brdzangs par byas/ go mtshon rta dang lag cha rnams tshur blangs shing phyag tu 'byor/ slar brtson pa rnams tshe thar du phud nas/ ma 'ongs par drin bzo'i la rgyar phan pa byed pa'i mna' chad bkal nas btangs shing / mtho rtse mkhar bde thabs kyis bkod par byas shing / dug gi rtsab bton pa bzhin/ dgra bo rtsad nas bton to/ /zhes de dang mthun pas/ 6rtosad

/2 9(a zam )khyan gyi bu rnams rtsabaton byas nas 'khyongs/ tol star a she rapha jo bo la bsgos nas/ skar stag sha nas sa skyad sba ri g.ying 'gud sogs dang / nas lag cha rnams dang nor sogs byung ba rnams/ bha lha nam bde bar nam dgos su bzhag skye ris ku ngos (res)gnyis su jo sul tān bsgos nas bzhag mdor na sbyor dngos rjes gsum 'dad ldan pa'i sgo nas/ sbal ti rigs can mtha' dag ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar/ 'di kha'i zhabs 'og tu 'dus nas sdod pa'i mna' chad bris/ mtho rtse mkhar gyi nang gral rnams khong bskams/ 'phral phugs kun tu 'di ga'i bstan srid la rgyar phan pa'i zhabs 'degs sogs dper brjod du bzhag rgyu'i bya ba rlabs po che mdzad do//po(

130chos blon shākya mtsho/nged lha bzhin yab mes rim par rim par/ shā kya rgya mtsho'i tshimes rim can du zhabs tog pa yin 'dug pa dang / khyad par shākya rang nyid 7mes chen bde ldan rnam rgyal gyi sku ring la/ pu rig nang khul yod rdo cog dang / kha pu lo'i rgyal srid rang zhabs su bsdus pa dang /glo bo'i skag rdzong mir (dma' bar)'bebs byas/ glo bo mes zhang tshor zhabs 'degs grub pa dang / da ling bcag nas gangs rir jag bcom med pa dang / pu rig tu kha chul gyi dmag dpung slebs skabs/na babs ib ra lham khyan dang / tram̐ mur lhag sogs hor kha chul pa'i dmag stabs chen yang yang byung bar/ shākya rgya mtsho'i ḍā'i gros thabs mkhas kyis rim par ldog thub nas bde 'jags byung ba dang / yab chen rgyal po bde legs rnam par rgyal ba'i sku ring la/ dbus gtsang nas sdutshog dmag gi dus zings langs skabs ra la dpal rgyas 31gas su dmag 'khrugs shin du che bar/ shā kya rgya mtshe'i tā( spyodzis thabs kyis bde bar ldog thub cing / la dwags gzhung la phyogs bzhi'i dmag dpung

131stobs che lhags par/ shā kya'i blo gros kyi goms snabs yo'akhyor bar/pa ca(blad shāha )chen po nas dmag dpung sbran te/ pharol po rnams rmeg med du 'ugs cing / dbus na za'abrug pa thams cad mkhyen gzigs pho go gting sgang du spyan 'dren nus nas/ gzhung sa mchod yon dang / rgyal po lha chen po ji srid bskal panagaganas bar du lugs legs kyi bzang 'chings bsgrigs nas/ mnga' zhabs bde rogs byung gdang / sgos su mnga' ris 'di khul ngos nas rsān /11 /dre/ /sdi//ji/ 1rtsi/ 4༄ //rto /ces 'tsho nga da skabs/ dgra 'dul/ nang gnyan nga gas mdar na/ gzhis su blon po rin po che lta bu dang / byes su dmag dpon rin po che lta bu'i bya ba tshul mthun byas shing byed rgyu dang bas rtogs brjod mdor bsdus so//

132ko ra sgo gyi sgor/sngon ma la dwags rgyal po'i pho rgyus dang / sing pa'i dmag gi pho rgyus de/ bla dwags rgyal po'i dus la/ bran mi ser tshang la'adu gzhi la nas gyen phyogs/ sbal ṣka yul gyi chor rbad la nas gyen phyogs/zangs dkar gyi la 'dar gyen phyogs/ ldum ra she 'du la nang zhugs/byang thang gi pho long 'dra 'dra nang zhugs/ de tshang ma la dwags rgyal po'i mnga' 'og gi bran yin pas / hu kum tshang ma bla dwags rgyal po'i min pa/ sus kyang med pa yin/ kha chul phyogs nas la dwags rgyal po la sa lām zhu ces la/ kha che ma lig zer mkhan dang / kho la ya do mi rta pa brgya tsam 'ongs 'dug pas/ de'i lan la la dwags rgyal pos kha la rtse pa drag shos don grub zer mkhan dang mnyam po/ la dwags pa'i thon khungs g.yag gcig lug gcig ra ma gcig khye gcig yang bzang nor kha shas dang sbags te btangs/ rgyal po'i phyag mdzod la ste mo pa blon po ga ga phun byugs rab brtan yod pa yin/ 'degs dpon la lhan la'i stotho gsol dpon pa yod pa yin/ sha dpon la a lci sha gnyer pa stobs ldan

133dang / rub sho pa 'go pa gnyis ka yod pa yin/ rgyal po la khar ji ci dgos mkhan sdum ra nas 'khyong 'dug ga ga bstan 'dzin zer mkhan ni khar ji yi gnyer pa chen mo la yod pa yin/ gsol mar dgos mkhan tshang ma zangs dkar pas 'khyong 'dug yang zamin hār la bab gsos dang khral mthud cang med pa yin/ lha sa phyogs la lo phyag pa cha tsan/ yul re re nas kho la ya do mi re gtong dgos 'dug pas/ de la gla cha ja'u gnyis re btang 'dug yo phyag gi ko ba (do bo )yul rer gnyis re dang / yul chen mo la ko ba gsum re 'phog 'dug yang kha chul pa dang / yar kyen pa/ gar zhwa pa tshang ma tshong la 'ongs na/ sho gam re blangs srol yod kyang / pu rig pa/ sbal ti'i yul pa/ la dwags pa gsum gyi thog nas cang len pa mi 'dug de nas dkar zhwa'i khang gsar nas rgyal po la sku bag cig zhus pas/ rgya'/ 31 de la sras shig ma bltams pas/ rjes su rub sho'i (ri shod ) rigo pa'i bu mo 'ashesangs nas/ de la sras rgyal bu zhig bltams/ mtshani la no chung ngu btags/ de nas rgyal bu khri la bzhengs tsan/ yul so so la sngon la rgyal po'i bu lon mang po yod pas/ zhing tshang ma bu lon la yal te yod

134pa yin/ de nas rgyal bu khri thog tu bzhengs pa'i zhag la de bu lon ci yod mkhan tshang margyal pos phud stsal pas/ de nas za min tār tshang ma shin tu mang po 'thad song //de nas pho mang po song ste stang na/ rta lo'i zla ba dgu pa'i nang du gaspyir phyogs nas/ seng pa'i dmag thon pa'i skad cha tshor/ de nas rong chu rgyud/ ldum ra/ sbal sta yul/ la dwags/ pu rig (bod rigs )tshang yonas dmag bskul byas nas pu rig phyogs la khyer nas/pu rig gi sangs sku la seng pa'i dmag dang thug ste/ de ru seng pa dang 'thab 51 btangs/ seng pa rgyal nas/ la dwags pa pham ste/ rus mi la phyogs nas mtshan la shor te 'ongs/ de nas shar go la la slebs/ming pa'i dmag tshang galang dkar tseru zla ba gcig tsam 'dug zla ba bcu pa'i zla hril te de ru dmag sgar btab nas 'dug yang zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes maserdzo la seng pa tshang gapa skyum yul la slebs/ pa skyugayul spu zhag bco lnga 'dug nas/ ming pa tshang ma yang lang dkar tse ru log sne song / de ru zla ba bcu gcig pa 'thon ring bar du 'dugayang zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes matre la la dwags pa'i dmag tshang mas

135grabs byas pas/ dag sa dgun la kha mang po skulang / sing pa tsho la gos med pas/ grang mo song ste khong kun gyis 'thab mo gtang mi thub/ nga dang la dwags pa rgyal yin zer nas/ sing pa dang 'thab par song la dwags pa dmag mi stong dgu tsam yod pa yin/ de tshang ma seng pa la rgyab 'ded la song / de nas la dwags pa tshang ma skyed mar tse ru slebs te/ skyed mar rtse ru seng pa dang 'thab mo che ba btangs nas/ la dwags pa pham/ la dwags pa ci'i phyir pham zer na/ la dwags pas rang gi rgyags dang gon chas stan tshang ma khur te/ kyis kyis bskangs te yod pa yin/ de'i kha thog la du bag kyang yod pas/ khu ru mang po yod pas/'thab 31 btang ma'ithub par la dwags pa pham/ sing pa rgyal/ ming pa'i tu bag ral gri thogs nas la dwags pa'i mi sum brgya tsam de ru shi ste/ dmag mashel tog pa bka' ṇḍalan yang de ru grongs/ la dwags pa kha shas ming pas bzung ste khyer/ de nas tshang ma gar song gar ma song shor te'ongs/ kram bis pa phyag mdzod rnam rgyal gyis seng pa dang zo ra par la/lagaston bcos sne 'khyongs nas mkhar bu ru 'byor/ de nas g.yu/nga drung pyodang wan la pa tshang mas seng pa'i dmag tshang ma mkhar bu ru

136bslebs zer pas 'jigs te/ ming pa la zhu bar rta gcig dang /dngul kha shas khur te mi tshang ma mkhar bu ru song ste/ sing pa'i dmag la mgo bskus/ de nas ming pa dang zo ra war shin tu mang po 'thad/g.yung drung dang lhan la pa la yul la gnod skyon sleb mi bcug zer te/dmag mi re re srung pal btangs/ de nas g.yung drung la slebs pas/yang lte ba pa dang ting mo sgang pa tshang ma 'jigs te/ yang rta gnyis dang dngul kha shas re khur nas/ grong re mi re g.yung drung la song sde/ sing pa la 'ju byas/ de nas yang sing pa kun mang po 'thad/ lte ba dang gting mo sgang pa la dmag mi re re srung ba la btangs/ de nas yang ming pa myur la la 'byor/ yang snye mo ba sgo pa dang / a lci/ sa spro la/blu kyir pa tshang ma nor re khur te ming pa la bsus te myur la ru slebs pas/ yang ming pa kun 'thad nas/ yul tshang ma la srung mkhan dmag mi re re btangs/ de nas ming pa'i dmag tshang ma snye mo ru slebs pas/'di tsug zer/ dngul btang na/ ming pa'i dmag tshang ma log ste cha bya 'dug zer/ la dwags rgyal pos gsan pas/ dngul rdo tshad ma mang po sle'i mkhar nang nas phyung ste/ snye mo ru slebs te seng pa'i rtsar song ste/

/37ming pa tsho yis nor dang dngul tshang ma yang len te/ seng pa 'thad nas nga zha 'e1ga ste cha yin/ da lta la dwags la lta la srib cig cha yin zer nas/ zo ra par dang dmag mi tshang ma la dwags la 'ongs te/ ga yul nas kyang me mda' gcig kyang rgyob mkhan med par sle ru slebs nas/dkar bzo ru dmag brang phab nas 'dug zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes mgo la slebs nas zla ba bzhi thug sing pa dang la dwags rgyal po 'thab mo med par 'dug de nas zo ra war gyis zer don la/ kha la rtse drag chos kun dga' la/ khyod rang gis la dwags pa 'di tshang ma'i khag 'khur dgos zer pas/ kha la rtse pa drag chos kyis lan la/ nga dag sa tshug pa la dwags rgyal po'i zhabs phyi bco mkhan yin/ mtshad par gsang rab skyogs zhabs mang po zos/ da lta rgyal po la ngo log mi bco/ de tsug zer pas/ zo ra sar la khro mang po 'ongs/ de nas la dwags rgyal po dang / zo ra war gnyis nas chad don brtan po bcos te/ la dwags pa tshang ma la bab grong pa re re la bod dngul bcu dang a na drug re dang pe nee gnyis re bcos te/ sle'i blon po dngos grub bstan 'dzin rā dzā bcos te/ ba sgo bka' blon la dwags kyi bka' blon bcos/ rgyal po chung ngu

138dkar zhwa phyogs la shor te bskyod/ bā bā rgyal po la la dwags kyi las cang chad mkhan bcos ste bor/ de nas kha la rtse drag shos la dwags kyi khag mi 'khur zer mkhan po la khro bcos te/ zo ra par la ya do bcol te/ kha chul la khrid de btson pa bcos te khyer/ de nas ming pa'i dmag mi sum brgya tsam zhig la dwags la kyi la (dmag sgar )bcos te de ru bor/ de nas ming pa dmag mi lus mkhan kun khrid nas/ zo ra war kha chul la song / zo ra war gting mo sgang mkhar du slebs nas/ mkhar nang gi rgyal po nyi ma rnam rgyal gyi gter mdzod bcag ste/ rgyal po'i snamaral dang / mu rtag gi chun po/ byi ru'i lag pa/ rgyal po'i chibs kyai sga stan dang / bzang nor tshang ma ming pas khyer/de nas yang lo drug 'dug ste/ lo bdun ngo la yang sle ru yod mkhan gyi ming pa kun la bltas te/ la dwags pas grabs bcos te/dmag gtang bya khrig khrig byas/ hem babs pa su ka mir zer mkhan zhig yod pa yin/ de mi yis pu rig na dmag bskul te 'khyong bya byas pas/ yang zo ra war gis ming dmag mang po khrid nas/ zangs dkar phyogs kyai lam nas 'ongs te sle ru slebs/ la dwags pa dmag tshang ma

139dang / pu rig pa dmag tshang ma ming pa'i dmag la 'jigs pas/ tshang ma zo ra war gyi mdun la song ste 'di tsug zer pa/ nga zha tshang gnyid rang la sa lham bco ces la 'ongs pa yin/ nga zha tshang ma la ar ji yod zer te brdzun btangs/ de nas gzir gyis zer/ khyed cag kun gyi ar ji ci yod kyang gsan yin mol nas/ khyed cag mi kha cig 'di ru 'dug gzhan ma tshang ma rang rang gi yul la phog ste song zhig mol/pu rig hem babs pa su ka mir dang / gcig gtan pa yis mal mir dang / pu rig pa yang mi kha cig 'dug bcug de nas zhag kha shas song ste/ mgo ma dmag skul gtong mkhan su yin zer nas dri ba btangs pas/ rting na hem babs pa su ka mir byung nas/ su ka mir la chad pa bcad/ lag pa g.yas pa bcad de/ lag mun po mar tshan de'i nang la btang bcug yang lag pa de kha la rtse'i zam pa ru gdung ma'i khar gzer brgyabs te bor/ de nas yang 'khyongs te kha la rtse zam pa ru lag phyis shig gi nang du btums te 'dug kha la rtse ko khri'i nang cig gi nang la bor pas/ mtshan la byi la zhig gis lag pa de khyer/ rting na kha la rtse pa tshang ma la chad pa bcad yin bsams te/ me me bla ma zhig shi ste skuld pa

/40yin/ kho'i lag pa bcad de kha la rtse'i zam pa ru gdung ma zhig gi maso la btags te por/ su ka mir gyi lce yang bcad/ de nas yang sbal sta yul du dmag 'khyer ba la la dwags pa tshang ma la dmag bskul btang sne/ g.yung drung nas gyen phyogs la dwags pa khrid nas/ dmag mgo ga ga bang kha pa bcos te/ ha nu'i tshor rbad la brgyud nas song / seng pa'i dmag tshang ma dang mnyam po ma di na sha zer mkhan stang ma zhag la btangs/ pu rig pa dmag tshang ma dang / rngasnyi nas dmag ston slebs mkhan de tshang ma khrid nas/ zo ra war dkar 'khyil lo'i lam phyogs nas song ste/ tse tse can zer ba'i sa khyad la bslebs/ phar phyogs nas sbal sta yul gyi dmag dang thug de ru 'thab mo btangs nas/ sing pa kha shas kyang shi/ dkar 'khyil pa zhe zam din zer mkhan po dmag mgo yin pas/ kho yang shi/ de'i rting na 5zir zo ra war rang gis 'thab mo btangs/ sbal sta tshang ma skabs shig la shor/ de nas sing pa'i dmag dang / la dwags pa'i dmag tshang ma skar rdo'i mkhar la slebs slebs tshug pa me mda' rgyob mkhan gcig kyang med par skar rdo'i mkhar la slebs/ de ru tshang ma 'dzoms te/ dmag brang phab ste/ zhag ma bcu

141gnyis phan tshun gnyis ka 'thab mo med par 'dug skar rdo'i jo ag mad sha mkhar nang du yib nas zhag bcu gnyis song ste rting na/ rang med la jo ag mad sha mkhar nang nas babs te/ zo ra par la mase| bsku ba la 'ongs/ gzir 'thad nas jo la 'di tsug zer/ cig tan pa jo ra snyam khyan gar yod/ kho bzung ste 'khyongs zer/ jo zhog mad khyan gyis/ ci shes nga la kha bar med zer/ wazir gyis kho ma 'khyongs na/khyod rang la khag po bco yin zer/ jo ra snyam khyan ci'i phyir btsal 'dug zer na/ sngon la zo ra war kha chul nas 'ongs 'ongs bar du la dwags pa tshang ma la dmag skul btangs/ de'i phyir du jo ra snyam khyan la rtsad gcod drag po btangs/ rting na jo ag mad shas yul tshang ma la 'tshol mkhan gyi mi btangs nas/ ra snyam khyan bzung sde 'khyongs/ zo ra par gyi mdun la slebs pas/ zo ra wang gyis hu kum zhig btangs/seng pa'i dmag tshang gdang / la dwags pa'i dmag tshang ma/ pu rig pa tshang ma dang / sbal sta yul gyi bu tsha dang bu mo gon gzhon zhar ba zha bo tshang ma dus gcig gi nang du bsdus te/ yul gyi gzhung la 'ol thang chen mo zhig 'dug pas/ de'i khar tshang ma 'byongs/ zo ra war dang bā

142bā rgyal po gnyis ka la gur re re btsugs ste 'dug de nas dmag tshang ma gral la 'dug bcug ste/ ra lham khyan se pa bdun gyis bzung ste de ru 'khyongs te/ kho la a phim mang po za bcug ste ra ros bcug zur mo (zug rngu )mi 'ong ba'i phyir yin zer 'dug dmag tshang ma'i dkyil du bor/ mi zhig gis shing mchan khung gang 'khu1ngas/ yang mi zhig gis zangs bu chung tse zhig gi nang du mar nag ba ṭi gcig tsam brgyangs te 'khyongs/ de nas sgyid pu btsugs te/ de'i khar zangs chung de bkal te/ me phus nas mar 'tshig bcug mi gsod mkhan gyi dum bu zhig 'ongs/ ra snyam khyan bzung ste/ sdon la lag pa bcad de mar tshan rma kha la bskus/ de nas lce yang bcad/ yang rna mchog gnyis ka yang bcad de/ dmag tshang gal mthong bcug de nas mi tshang ma'i gzhung la 'phangs te bor/ yang pa skyum pa bong pho pa hu sen zer mkhan po yang ming pa la ngo 81sa byed mkhan yin pas/ kho'i lag pa g.yas pa yang bcad/ lce yang bcad de phud btangs/ kho gshi bar lus/ ra snyam khyan zhag gnyis tsam ku co gtong bzhin 'dug ste rting na shi/ de nas ming pa rgyal/ mal mal la song ste/ seng pa kha shas skar rdo ru

143por/ skar rdo pa jo ag mad khyan dang 'go skyong tshang ma khrid de/ phyir log ste la dwags la 'ongs/ bā bā rgyal po (tshe dpal don grub rnam rgyal)dang bang kha dziganyis ka skar rdo ru grongs te/ spur tog du saspyongs te me la phul/ de nas gzir gyis skar rdo'i mkhar nang nas nor ci yod bskur te sler slebs/ dgun gcig la dwags la 'dug/dpyid kyai zla bganyis pa'i nang du byang thang du dmag khyer ba la/yul tshang ma ru dmag mi btang ste/ mi tshang ma la khur bkal te khyer/ yang kha chul phyogs nas seng pa'i dmag ston stong drug tsam yang bslebs pas/ de mnyagatob sum cu yang 'dug de nas la dwags/sbal sta yul/ pu rig yul/ ldum ra gang song nas mi bsdus nas/dmag mi stong bcu gnyis tsam 'dzoms nas/ byang thang la khyer/ grong pa re re la be dar khal lnga re bkal te khyer/ de nas ru thog tu slebs te/ de ru 'thab mo ma btang bar ru thog tu nor ci yod mkhan tshang ma bskalag ste/ la dwags la bkal te btangs/ grelag po rab gsum la slebs te/ de ru bod pa'i dmag kyang thon/ de nas seng pa dang la dwags pa gnyis grabs bcos te/ nga dang gis grog po'i chu bskyel yin

144zer te/ grog po'i chu bskyel/ de nas bod pa'i dmag tshang ma zhag gcig gi lam phyir log song bas/ ming pa'i dmag tshang ma yang song /grog po rab gsum gyi stod la ming pa dang la dwags pa'i dmag sgar btsugs/ bod pa'i dmag tshang ma dmag brang btab sne 'dug mtshan zhig la rnam mkha' nas se ra ru mang po babs nas/ nam langs langs par ming pa tshang ma la gon chas med pas se ra ru'i nang du nubaste/sing pa mang po shi/ de nas nyi ma rtse shar dang bod pa dang ming pa gnyis das 'thab mo che ba btangs/ nyi ma phyed tsam la zo ra war la bod pa'i tu bag phog nas/ rta'i thog nas sa steng du lhung sne shi/ bod pa'i dmag tshang mas zo ra war gyi sha tshang ma bcad de zos/ su sus khur te khyer/zo ra war gyi mgo bcad de ngasgru ru bkal/ de nas bod pas seng pa mang po bzung ste bod la khyer/ sgod pa'i zhib gcod zer mkhan gyi mi chen mo zhig dang sing pa'i dmag tshang ma nang 'grig song bas/ de nas phyin phan tshun gang nas zer pho med mkhan byas/ sngon khrims nang ltar lo phyag pa 'grul bya chad yig brtan po bcos te/ seng pa'i dmag tshang ma la dwags la 'ongs / bod pa tshang ma bod la song /

/45yang zla ba gsum song ba dang / kha chul phyogs nas bod la dmag 'khyer ba la/ de wan nyi ri caji dang gzir ra tun gnyis kyis dmag mgo bcos te/ ming pa dmag mi stong brgyad khrid nas/ zla ba lnga pa'i nang du sle ru 'byor/ de nas yang la dwags dang / ldum ra/ sbal rta yul/ pu rig yul mi tshang ma la dmag skul btang ste/ za min hār tshang ma la be gar bkal te khyer/ mi drag rigs tshang ma dmag mi bcos te khyer/ de nas bod pa'i dmag kha shas lce bde'i mkhar nang du slebs te skuld pas/ de tshang ma la mkhar nang du chu med mkhan bcos te/sing pa'i dmag mi kha cig de ru bor/ de wan dang sing pa mang po bod pa'i dmag tshang ma la 'das te song / de nas chu shul la thub ste bod pa kha shas bsad/ kha shas bzung ste 'khu1ngas/ bod pa'i dmag matre ra ga sha zer mkhan yang bzung ste/ sngon ma 5zir zo ra war bsad pa'i srog lan yin zer nas/ ral gri dang sge bcad/ de nas bod pa pham/ sngon khrims la dwags rgyal po'i khrims la cha bzhag bya byas/ stsodan 61 zo ra war shi tsan/ sing pa bzung ste khyer mkhan tshang ma phyir log gtang bya byas/ bod pa bzung yod mkhan tshang ma log ste gtang bya nang 'grig song / bod du yod mkhan gyi seng pa tshang mas bod pa mo zhingazhe la

146(mna' mar )'khyongs/ su re la phru gu song ste khrid nas/ tshang ma kha chul la song / bod pa seng pas bzung ste khyer mkhan kun la jasbyi ma a nee la (mna' ma )gakhyongs te phru gu gnyis gsum re song ste khrid nas bod phyogs la song / bod la seng pa mnyam 'go byed mi nya re ya ming zer ba zhig yod pa yin/ kho bod nas ja1 ru slebs nas/ ma hā rā ju yis 'di tsug dris pa/ bod la yang skyare dmag 'khyer na/ nyan bya 'dug gagami 'dug dris pas/ mi nya re ya sing gis lan du/ bod la dmag 'khyer ba nyan bya mi 'dug ci 'dug zer na/ nged cag gi dmag mi ci tsam yod de tsam zhig bod pa'i bla ma tshang ma 'dug seng pas zla ba gcig la khar ji ci tsalabaza' 81da de tsam zhig bod pas zhag gcig la za 'dug sing pa mi bcus gon mkhan gyi gon chas/ bod pa mi gcig gis gon 'dug yang kho kun la sgyu ma (ja du )mang po 'dug nam mkha' nas char pa mang po 'bebs 'jug bya dang / rang bzhin gyis me 'bar bcug bya dang / sa dang gnaga'agul bcug bya dang / mthu gtong shes 'dug mi kha cig nam mkha' ru 'phur bya dang / mi kha cig gis mi su la mthong ma bcug par ral sgra khur te mi gsod mkhan dang / mi 'dra lamang po 'dug zer pas/ ma hā rā ju la khro mang po 'ongs/ kho rang

147gis bod pa'i phyogs bcos sne gtam rtsog po zer/ kho rang no ka ri la mi bor zer nas/ phyung ste gzhan yul zhig la lam bcug btangs/sngon la la dwags pa bod la bzung ste khyer yod pa'i rigs ni/ dbon po tshe dbang rab brtan/ chu shod ga jo go lam khyan/ ba sgo'i bka' blon/zletshon po sa phi/ lte ba 'ol chags pa'i phyag rdor/ khong mi lnga bod nas log ste ma bslebs/ de ci yin zer na/ kho tshang gas bod pa'i phyogs ma byas pas/ bod pa la khro 'ongs te/ khong tshang ka shi shi bar bod la bzhag pa yin no//(lo rgyus 'di ni mkhar la rtse pa me me tshe bstan gyis ji ltar cos pa dang mthong yo da pa lhad med du bris pa yin no//

148(ched brjod khag)rdo rje gcod gabris ba'i ched brjod/bla'i swa sdi sidha/ bla ma dang 'jim pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal 'tsho/ /dgongs pa chos dbyings nam mkha' yangs pa la brtse bas thugs rje nyi zla rab 'phros nas/ /'gro kun blo yi mun pa sel mdzad pa'i / /bla ma dam pa rnams phyag 'tshal lo//e ma ho/ mtshan dper rab brgyan gzi brjid 'bar ba'i sku//yan lag du ma'i chos rnams ston pa'i gsung / /molus shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i thugs/ shākya'i gtso bo de la gus phyag 'tshal//kye lags/ rgya gar rgya mtsho chen por bzhugs pa yi/ /gsung rab yid bzhin nor bu blangs byas nas/ /bod yul chos kyi dbul ba sel mdzad pa'i/ /sgra sgyur lo paṇa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//e ma ho/ zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sku brnyes kyang // gdul bya'i don du tha mal tshul mdzad pa/ /gangs can bstan pa'i bdag

149po sa skya pa/ /kun dga' snying po'i zhabs la pyag 'tshal lo/ /kye lags/ tshangs spyod dge bsnyen mchog gi brtul zhugs can//mtha' yas yon tan du ma'i mthar son cing / /ma lus skye dgu kun gyi skyabs gyur pa/ /rje btsun rtse mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang sprul pa'i zlos gar la/ /sngags chang dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ /sa gsugakun tu snyan pa'i grags pa can/ /gragasapa rgyal mtshan zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'arngam dbyangs gzhon nu dus mthar gangs can 'dir/ /ngur sgrig 'dzin pa'i gzugs kyis rnam rol pa/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i gtsug rgyan sa skya pa/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs la phyag 'tshal chen//gang gi zhabs sen nor bu'i cod pan ni/ /shar phyogs sa skyong gtsug gis nyer bsten pa'i/ /gangs can 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gyur pa/ /chos rgya'adi'aphags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po mchogades dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung /ཿ /dkon mchog gsugadangos sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dpal/ /thar 'dod bdul bya 'dren pa chos kyi

150rje/ /'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gyur khyod gcig pu/ /dkon mchog dpal gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal 'e1//rgyud sde'i snying po rim gnyis zab mo'i don/ /thugs su chud nas na bza' brag phug tu/ /rtse gcig sgrub palhur mdzad grubapa'i gtso/ /bsod nams dpal gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal 'i(/ /chos dbyings pho brang gzhal yas su/ /bla( rgyan sprul sku'i zhang khams na//brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /stag tshang ras chen spyi bos mchod//gnas (rnal)'byor kun gyi mchog gyur pa/ /chos rnams kun gyi de nyid rtogs/ /srid bzhi (zhi )kun gyi pha rol phyin/ /tā ra nā tha'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mdo rgyud kun la mkhas pa'i blob (〈snab)dpon dpaldan chos grags 'di/ /sku tshe ring zhing 'phrin las rgyas gyur cig/kye/ 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas kun dga' ches gros zhabs pad bstan (brtan)gyur cig/ e ma ho/ gling gi mchog gyur sgo'i 'dzagabu'i gling / /'phags pa yul nas byang gi phyogs su byon/ /chu shel phung po kun nas spungs pa bzhin/ /rtse mo lta bas mi ngoms ti se'i

151gangs/ /beeḍūrya sngon 'khyel 'dra maphagamatsho/ /chu chen seṅge kha 'bab 'brug pa'i g.yas/ /'dod dgu 'byung gnas mar yul gzhung gi cha//mi rnams dga' bder (spyod pa )skyed pa'i yul/ /chos rgyal pho brang ble (gli )chen dpal khang na/ /kye lags/ chos rgyal chen po sde (bde )ldan rnam rgyal bzhugs/ /da lta'i sa skyong chen po'i grags pa'i sgra/ /che zhing snyan pa'i gad rgyang sa steng khyab/ /mi mthun phyogs la rnam par rgyal gyur cig/ e ma ho/ mi dbang gong ma'i rjed (bzhed) don sgrub pa la//klu dbang gtsug rgyan yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /mchog gsugal gus dge ba'i las la brtson/ /kun 'dzoms rgyal mos spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsten// kye lags/ phas rgol dgra la nam mkha'i thog dang 'dra//nang 'khor rnams ni byams pas bu bzhin skyong / /nang blon chen po 'byor ra rgya mtsho de/ /skye bo kun gyi gtsug tu bsten par shog/ kye lagarme/ chos rgyal pho brang dbyi khu (dbyi gu )khri khang 'dir/ /skyes pa pho la snyan pa'i grags pa can/ /gdung rus che ba mdog dbyung dpon chen rgyud//sbyin pa'i bdag po no (no )dga' 'od kyis/ /thugs la brtse ba'i a

/32co 'od lde rgya mtsho'i dgongs rdzogs la// e 4ho/ zugs kyi rten du thub pa'i sku khru gang lhag sa paṇa zhal thang gcig slob dpon stag tshang gi zhal thang gcig gsung gi rten du rdo rje gcod gobadun tshar/ sdig bshags/ byang chub ltung bshags/ e ma ho/ gun man rdo la maṇi gsumostong dang thugs kyai rten du byang chub mchod rten bzhengs/gangs ṣka se man nas dbyu ru (g.yung drung )yan gyi dgon pa rnams la / thugs rig dad pas mang rnga/ bsngo rten slon lam gyi rgyas 'debs bsam gyis mi khyab par byas/kyai/ sbyon pa'i bdag po a ce skyed rgyan gyis/ grogs sku drin 'khor med kyi dgongs rdzogs la// bsags pa chos phyir gtong ba ngo mtshar che/ /tshabo'i mchog gyur no no dga' 'dzin dang / no no tshe ring bsagagrub rnams dar zhi rgyas par shog a zhe kha lhug dang / a ce shes rab dang / gce no 'dren dang / mna' ma'i mchog gyur nu mo tshe ring dang / tsha mo'i mchog gyur nu mo legs 'dzoms dang / nu mo kun dga' bu khrid dang / nu mo bkra shis bsod nams dang / tshomo'i mchog gyur kun dga' chos 'dzoms dang / rten bzhengs 'di la zhabs rtog

153zhus pa ngo mtshar che/ kye lags/ dge ba 'di nyid bsgo ru srong ba la/zhi(ce gangs skyed ka drug gdu mo legs 'dzoms/ mkhar pa/ khang sar ra ngang chung / 'byor ra bu/ ngang rgya mtsho/ ka ru skyed/ lde lde/me tog gar skyes/ bsod nams bkrashis/ 'gang nga /gnas chen bzang po gangs ri ti se ru/ khra ma'i gdan sa dgon pa rgyang grags su/ /'jig rten kun la khyab pa 'jim pa'i dbyangs/ /bla ma lha btsun 'od lde'i dgongs rdzogs la/ /tshogs pa rnams la nyin thub stsal/ /cho ga rgya chen mdzad par bka' drin che//dkar tum gyi a gu nor bu dang a ma g.yung drung gnyis kyis gangs sta se man chad/ kha 'char yan chad kyai dgon parnams la nu bo 'od lde'i dgongs rdzogs la mang ja/ bsdo rten/ 'bul ba dang bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs mdzad/ gro'u zhag ma chag par stung nga'i 'od/ dpon kun la 'bul ba gser zho gsum/ cab dar gcig sman rtse gcigabasod nams mas gser 'bo gsum/ lags 'byor gyis gser 'bo gsum/ bsam 'phel gyis gser 'bo gsum/ tshe ring bsam grub kyis ji po re bzhi/ brnya na pas gser zho phyed/ dge slong dpal sbyin
