154gyis 'bo gnyis/ jo mo nor bu 'dzoms mas gser 'bo gnyis/ cab dar gcig 'di kun rin po che'i zhabags tog gi mthud mal phul pa yin/ dge'o// rdor gcod kyai ched brjod 'di gus 'tharmi dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis 11—11 07nyin bzhus/gtog ga ra gsu gyi ched brjod/ skyo'i swa sto sisgru/ bla ma dang 'jim pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/dgongs pa chos dbyings nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje nyi zla raga'aphros nas/ /'gro kun blo yi mun pa sel mdzad pa'i// bla yodagapa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ho/ mtshan dpes rab brgyan gzi brjid 'bar ba'i sku//yan lag du ma'i chos rnams ston pa'i gsung / /ji snyed ji bzhin ma lus mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /shākya'i bstan pa'i gtsol phyag 'tshal bstod//

155e garto/ zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sku brnyes kyang //gdul bya'i don du tha mal tshul mdzad pa/ /gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa/ /kun dga' snying po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//kye lags/ tshangs spyod dge bsnyen mchog gi brtul zhugs rkun/ /mtha' yas yon tan du ma'i mthar son cing / /ma lus skye dgu kun gyi skyabs gyur pa/ /rje btsun rtse mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang sprul pa'i zlos gar la/ /sngags 'chang dbang po grags pargyal mtshan zhes/ /sa gsumakun tu snyan pa'i grags pa can//grags pa rgyal mtshan zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jim dbyangs gzhon nu dus mthar gangs can 'dir/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gzugs kyi rnam rol pa/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i gtsug rgyan sa skya pa/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi zhabs sen nor bu'i cod pan ni/ /shar phyogs sa skyong gtsug gis nyer bsten pas/ /gangs can 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs 'gyur pa/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po mchog des dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung //dkon mchog gsumadangos sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dpal/ /thar 'dod

156gdul bya 'dren pa chos kyi rje/ /dkon mchog dpal gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo kyi/ rgyud sde'i snying po rim gnyis zab mo'i don/ /thugs su chud nas na bza' brag phug tu/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa lhur mdzad grub pa'i gtso/ /bsod nams dpal gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal 'etsho/ /dpal ldan chos dbyings pho brang gzhal yas su/ /bstan pa'i khur 'dzin lung dang rigs brgyan pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje dpal la 'dud//kyi/ bla( rgyan sprul sku'i zhing khams su/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnam 'byor pa/ /'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gcig ngu / /stag tshang ras chen spyi bos mchod//e ma ho/ 'phags pa'i yul nas byang gi phyogs su byon/ /chu shel phung po kun nas spungs pa bzhin / /rtse mo lta bas mi ngoms sta se gangs / /bi ḍūrya sdon 'khyil 'dra ma tham mtsho/ /'gro bsgol med pa seṅge kha 'bab g.yas/ /gangs can rab tu bstan pa mar yul gzhung //chos rgyal pho brang lhe (gle )chen dpal mkhar rtser/ /chos rgyal gdung rgyud sdon phebs mang ba las/ /da lta'i sa skyong chen po grags pa'i sgra//

157che zhing snyan pa'i rgya bod sa steng khyab/ /chos rgyal chen po seṅge rnabargyal de/ /mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal gyur cig/kye lags/ mi dbang gong ma'i rjed (bzhed )don sgrub pa la//klu dbang gtsug gi yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /dkon mchog la gus dge ba'i las la brtson/ /bdag mo skal bzang spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsten//kyi/ phas rgol dgra la nam mkha'i thog dang 'dra/ /nang 'khor srid rnams byams pas bu bzhin skyong / /nang blon chen po a khu mgar mo de/ /skye bo kun gyis gtsug tu bsten par shog/kye lags/ de 'dra'i mnga' zhabs yangs pa'i nang shed na//chos rgyal pho brang dbyig khu (dbyi gu)khri khang 'dir// skyes pa pho la grags pa'i snyan pa can/ /gdung rus che ba mdog dbyung dpon chen rgyud/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po nor bu rgya mtsho dang / /'od lde dang ni dga' 'od rnam gsum gyis/ /drung pa rnam gshegs a ba rgya dang ni/ /a khu dpal lde (a co )kun dga' rgya mtsho dang / /kun dga' chos legs (la sogs gnyen 'brel )rnams/ /dashesangs pa chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs phyir du/ /rin chen tsandan las grub sku ('dra )bzhi dang / zhal

158thang lnga tshar/ gsung gi rten du rgya (sgra )tog gser gsugan rag dong dkrugs/ ngan song sbyong rgyud dang / rdor gcod ma bu/ gur man rdo la maṇi khri tsho las lhag tshang ba bzhengs/ thugs rten byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhi tshar bzhengs/ /bsags pa don can mdzad pa ngo mtshar che/ yum chen a ma tshe ring rgyal mo yis/ mi zas lha yi bdud rtsi rab sbyar nas/ dpon rnams zhal gyi padmo rgyas par mdzad/ tshabo'i mchog gyur dga' 'dzin rgya mtsho/ shākya rgya mtsho/ nu mo rgyal skyed/ dkar ma/ mtsho mo/ lhag 'dzoms bu khrid/ kun dga' bu khrid/ a ce no 'dren/ a'ice bsod nams sgrol garnams kyis ni/ rten bzhengs 'di la mthun rkyen yang dag mdzad//kye lags/ dge ba 'di la bzo ru srong ba la/ khang gsar ra dang rmi ru'i khang pa/ nu mo ka ru/ rgya ras rgya mtsho/ a tshigadma dang /dpon po spyis ldog zho pha mgar mo dang / mang la'i dpon po/ lcem 'dre gong ma dang / 'byor ra rgya mtsho/ a ba pa ni dang / ro garnam rgyal/ sha ba/ lde lde/ pha bu rnam dang ni/ gzhan yang yul mi khyem mtshes/ gnyer las byed/ las sner gtogs parnams dang ni/ byan

159ma/ chang ma/ phye 'thags rnams kyis ni/ skyo ngal med par zhabs tog legs par bsgrubs/e ma ho/ rgya shog dkar 'dzoms spu ris med pa la/ /'phrul yig gsal byed nor bu'i phreng ba 'di/ /sngon gyi mkhas pa khyung po'i rgyud 'dzin pa'i/ /sor mo'i 'du byed 'byor ra bdag gis bris// rnam dkar dge ba gangs ri ltar dkar des/ /lus can 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams yar po'i zla ba ltar/ /'phel zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis smon lam 'debs/ /dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ maṅgalam/11—11—༷7 nyin gus 'jim dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis bzhus pa'o//dbyi gu gur mgon lha khang du bzhugs yod pa'i'agugabris ma'i ched brjod/e su siddhi/ dgongs pa chos nyid nam mkha' yangs pa la /brtse ba'i thugs rje nyi zla'i 'od 'phros nas/ /'gro kun blo yi mun pa sengar mdzad pa'i/ /rtsabargyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser mdog

160mtshan dpes rab brgyan brjid pa'i sku/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re ba che(nga ba'i gsung / /ma lus shes bya ji snyed gzigs pa'i thugs //shāka thub bstan pa'i gtsol phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /rtsab rab brtan zab mo stong pa nyid/ /lta ba mtha' gnyis spangs pa dbu ma'i lam/ /sde sdod rgya mtsho'i klong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen mthing sngon lta bur gsal ba'i sku/ /mtshan dpe gzi ldan 'od stong dra ba can/ /mthong thos dran pas ngan song gnas sbyong ba'i/ /mi 'khrugs lha yi sna'ogs la phyag 'tshal 'tsho/ /rigs kun khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /gang des byin brdubs sta pradzña'i mtshan//lnga rig grub pa mchog brnyes nā ro'i zhabs/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal gyur chos glo gros/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa gsal mdzad mi la rje//rab mchog rim par brgyud pa'i bka' brgyud par/ /mi phyed dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal 'e1//rnam mkhyen rgya mtsho yangs pa'i klong dkyil na/ /rnamadag pad sdong ze'u 'bru nyer lnga'i steng / /rnam mang rgyal ba rgya mtsho ji snyed pa'i//rnam sprul gu ru padma 'byung gnas bstod/ /skye dgu'i dbus na bsod

161nams du mas brdzid/ /dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa phyogs kun tu/ /lhag pa'i khur 'dzin lhag bsam bzang po can/ /mtshungs med bka' brgyud rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun gyi gzugs/ /mtshan bzang sirnyi thara'i me tog gis/ /kun dga' skyed byed lha dang mi'i bla ma/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kun skyed byed yum/ /nyes pa'i dgra tshogs kun tu 'joms pa'i yab/ /lhag bsam khuchog gis kun nas bskrun pa'i sras/ /dge legs kun gyi gtso bo gsumal 'dud/ /la wartu la sogs yi ge'i rigs/ /'bri dang klog dang phul du phyin pa yi//rmongs pa mkhas par gyur pa'i lo tsā ba/ /thon mi sasnoṭa la gus pas 'dud/ /kun dga' bo sogs dgra bcom brgya phrag lnga / /grags pa la sogs 'phags pa bdun brgya dang / /gnas mi 'i bu sogs bka' bsdu mdzang pa yi/ /bsdu ba rnalagasumamadzad pa rnams la 'dud/ /'od srungs la sogs bstan pa'i gtad rabs dang / /klu sgrub la sogs rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / /mang pos bkur sogs chos rgyal rgyud pa sde/ /'phags yul bstan 'dzin rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /lha klu

162mi yi bsam 'phel rin chen dbang / /rgyal mtshan rtser mchod 'dod pa'i don ster bzhin/ /phun tshogs dge legs yid kyi re sgong ba'i//nor bdag 'thamabha la la gus pas 'dud/ /gzungs sngags rtog pa (gtogs pa)bya rgyud spyod rgyud dang / /rnal 'byor rgyud dang rnal 'byor bla med kyi/ /dbang lung bshad pa lag len man ngag gi/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal pho/bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal sad mi bdun/ /skyed lde nyi ma mgon las legs brgyud de/ /chos rgyal chen po stod kyi mgon gsum ni/ /sa la dbang sgyur rgyal po'i tshul bzung nas/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan dam pa'i khrir bzhugs te/ /sa gsum bde la bkod pa'i mes dbon rgyal//kye lags/ snang med 'od gsal nagamakha' stong pa las//rgyal ba'i smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyor mthus/ /bskal bzang zhing grub 'og gzhi rlung gis btegs/ /'bar byed b.lang gnas dang 'dzin mo'i dbus/ /lhun po gser gyi ri dang rol mtsho bdun/ /gling bzhi gling phran brgyad dang bye brag tu/ /'dzam gling yul drug rgya gar rgya

163nag dang / /gangs can shas la dang li'i yul/ /de ltar grub pa'i stong gsum 'jig rten 'di/ nya/mi marjed 'jig rten khams zhes ming chags so/ /de ltar stod kyi 'jig rten khams de na/ /bcud kyi sems can rim gyis 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /zhe snang tshidang 'dod chags ma gnyis las//ma rig 'du byed gnyis kyis sa bon btab/ /dge dang mi dge gnyis kyis las byas pas/ /'gro ba rigs drug 'bras bu so sor smin//sdod kyi 'jig rten de ltar chags pa la/ /gling gi dbus ma bcom dang ldan pa'i gling / /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla gnyis kyis brgyan/ /gser dngul zangs lcags 'khor los sgyur rgyal bzhi/ /so so dbang sgyur mthu stobs che chung mchis/ /gling rnams kun las 'dzam gling khyad du 'phags/ /dbyibs mchog mdzes pa la selags (sermeg pa)shing rta'i dbyibs/ /sra brtan mi 'gyur rdo rje ra bas bskor/ 'dzam gling gser gyi lte ba rdo rje gdan/ /brjid mdzes dbyibs legs bya rgod phung po'i ri/ nyams dga' bkrashis gser gyi grong khyer na/ /mi yi bdag po rgyal po zas gtsang sras/ /skulan tan kun ldan rgyal sras don grub 'khrungs/ /stong gsum 'di la dbang byed rgyal po dang / /stong gsum

164sa 'dzin rgyal po gnyis kyis bsgyur/ /gling bzhi'i rgyal po 'khor pho sgyur rgyal yin/ /de la spyi phud rgyal po zas gtsang sras/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs la zer/ /rgya gar rgyal po sngon sbyangs las 'phro can/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi stod du rung bas na/ rgyal goshākyathub pas ston par mdzad//rgya nag gtsug lag rtsis kyis 'dul gzigs nas/ /mkhyen rab bdagapo 'phags pa 'angayodapal gyis/ /gab rtsegasum brgya drug cu ston par mdzod/ /ta zig nor gyi sbyin pas 'dul gzigs nas//rgyal po rnalamang thos pa la sogs kyis/ /'phags gnor sbyin sku sprul ston par mdzad/ /ge sar dmag gis 'dul bar gzigs pas na//lha mo pa mika yi bu lnga brgya/ /de 'dra dmag tu sgral nas ston par mdzod/ ri /rgya gar chos rgyal garig mun pa sel/ sno/rgya nag rgyal posalegs nyes mi long ston/ /ta zig rgyal pos nor gyis dbul gsel//ge sar rgyal pos dmag gis dgra dpung 'dul/ /de ltar mtha' bzhi'i rgyal po dpe med kyang / /mi rje mis byas ya mtshan khyad par med/ /rje'i mnga' ris bod gyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /ri mtho sa gtsang lha gnas

165gzhan las 'phags/ /dwangs ma bsil ba chu bo bzhi yi ca/tredze/ /'bru sna lnga 'khrungs spang spos rim gyis bsgor/ /gser la sogs te rin chen dgos 'dod tshang / /sta se gangs ri mchod rten brtsigs pa 'dra//mtsho mo ma phagagayu yi maṇḍal can/ /81na tan mang ldan bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ ༈ /seṅge kha 'bab 'brug pa'i g.yas phyogs na//dpung tshogs drag po'i ngar skad 'u ru ru/ /dge bcu 'dzoms pa'i smon bya 'di ri ri/ /dar rgyas skyed pa'i glu len ru ru/ /yul la g.yang chags phu la 'bur du mtho/ /chos rgyal pho brang dbyi gu khri khang 'di//cirgyab ri rin chen rdo rje brag gis bskor/ /mdun lde'u gsing g.yu yi maṇḍal 'dra/ /phu stod gangs ri dar dkar yol ba 'dra/ /mdo na nor 'dzin bu mo g.yu gos gyon/ /bar na 'bru bcud skyi da pa'i ngang mo 'khrungs/ /nam mkha'i mthongs la 'khor 'e1 rtsibs brgyad tshang / /bar gyi ri la bkra shis rtags brgyad tshang / /dog mo'i sa la padma 'dab brgyad tshang / /mthong bas mdzes pa sku mkhar mtho la btsan/ /de 'dra'i srid la dbang sgyur mi dbang ni/ /mang bkur 'khor los sgyur rgyal bu ram shing / 'ika rigs mes dbon gsum las khri srong sprul/ /phyi nang bal

/66bod gnyis kyi sa mtshams na/ /garung gdug pa 'dul ba'i khro rgyal bzhin/ /sa bdag mi dbang bde ldan rnam rgyal dang / /rnam sras rnam sprul bde legs rnamargyal gnyis/ /mkhyen pa rab rdzogs rogapa'i sungs dang mtshungs/ /mkha' mnyam skyong la thugs rje chen po 'dra//thub bstan skyong la gsang ba'i bdag po bzhin/ /rgyal khrims pad tshal skyong ba'i mozer ༅/ /mi mthun phyogs la rnam par rgyal bar shog/e ma ho/ lha mo'i mdangs ldan klu mo'i garsā sbra can/ mtshan ldan lha mo gzugs ༅ yid 'ong ma/ bu ༅ yongs la brtse zhing byams pa dang / /sungs ༅ lha mo nyid dang mtshungs pa yi/ /sgrol ma'i rnam sprul bu khrid dpal mdzes gnyis/ /sras nor dpag bsam shing ltar rgyas par shoga.e ma rto/ de sras dpa' brtul snying stobs ldan pa'i gzi// che/rte 〈sna)sdo 0ri /// /thergazugatheb /sdipas la kun mas nya ma rnamargyal / /sku ra ba na du brtan pa dang / /chab srid yar po'i zla ltar rgyas par shog /yul la g.yang chags dbyi gu khri khang gi /dgos 'dod kun 'dzoms ka drug gzims khang 'dir/ /bstan pa 'degs pa'i ka chen rgya khrang zhing / /gtong phod

167lugs brgya ldan pa'i sgo 'phar can/ /bsod nams stobs kyis gzhan sde zil gyis gardon/ lhag bsam dag pas rang sde khrims kyis 'tsho//dang po che ba lha chen shed bu'i gdung / /lho phyogs 'dzam bu'i gling gi mes po yin/ /bar du che bsku rje phug pa'i gdung / /khyad 'phags lha sdong dkar po'i mes po yin/ /tha mar che ba lha ljong dkar po'i gdung //khyad par mi dbang chen po'i 'khor gyi gtso/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag shākya rgya mtsho 'di/ /pha rol dgra la bskal pa'i me bas 'jigs/ /bu bran skyong la drin mā 〈bas lhag /rigs pa'i khrims kyi mnga' gnon mdzad pa'i dpal/ /gnam lcags thog 'bebs seṅge'i rtsal dang mtshungs//sku ni ri bo bzhin du brtan par shog /tshe rabs sngon nas las kyai 'phro mthud pa'i/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho 'khyel ba'i longs spyod ma/ /phabazang sras mo rigs bzang khungs btsun ma/ /'dod dgu mi mdzod rin chen gter mdzod ma/ /dad gus ldan pas dkon mchogagasugal mos/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mtshan ldan sbyin bdag mo/ /byams sems ldan pa'i rnamargyal chos 'dzoms kyis/ /'di phyir dad pa'i pad dkar kha phye nas /dad brtson snying rje'i me rtog pad dkar can/ /yag

168yum 'di gnyis dge ba'i bka' bgros nas/ /sgyu pa'i nor la snying po med dgongs nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa phyog bcur rgyas pa dang / /rje yi chab srid mnga' thang mtho phyir dang / /par gyur 'gro ba sangs rgyas thob phyir dang / /thog med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag phyir dang //yab yum sras bcas sku tshe brtan phyir du/ /lo yi thogam shing pho byi lo (1744)la/ thar nub gnyis nas hor sog gnyis yongs skabs//zugapa'i bstan pa'ajig la khad pa'i dus/ /sku gsung thugs kyai rten rnams phyogs phyogs thor/ /dus kyi snyigs ma slebs 'dug datre(ngas nas kyang / chos phung brgyad khri'i nang nas zab mo'i mdo/ /yongs su grags pa'i stong phrag brgya pa 'di/ /phyogs su thor ba gcig tu bsgrigs byas nas/ /mgo nas mjug tu zhig gso yang dag mdzad/ /e mami mchog 'di 'dra skal ba bzang / /mdzangs grung ldan zhing 'khor 'dabs brtse bas skyong / /dad gus ldan pa'i gces ma tshe ring gis/ /rdza chang sogs kyis dpon rnams tshims par mdza/ /zas kyi snying po longs spyod rgyas par shog/

/69yab yum thugs la brtse ba'i sras mo ni/ /zla bzhin ri dwags mig can pispa'i mchu/ yid zhung 'chi med mdzes ma'i ngang tshul can//bzhin mdzos 'dzum ldan lha yi sras mo 'dra/ /rab dkar lang tshos brgyan pa'i byang sems ma/ /rab dkar lha mo bzhin du yid 'ong ma//mtshan ldan sras mo tshe ring dpal 'dzoms dang / /bkra shis dpal 'dzoms ba na 'dzin sgrol yodang / /legs mdzes bu khrid 'dzam gling sgrol spudang / /don grub rgyal 'dzoms la sogs sras mo rnams//yab yugagong ma'i srol ka 'dzin par shog/e ha mo/ dpal 'byor pho 'dagadapag med rgyas pyocan/ /rnamadapyod ldan paganyen 'brel kun dang mthun/ /liṃkhro'i mchog tu gyur pa rgyal dang ni/ /lhugaskyes ('dagaskyes)ha lo 'dra ba'i tshabo ni/ /tshe ring rababastan kun dga' phun tshogs dang / /mtshar sdug 'od dkar can de bris 'dra ba'i/ /bu mo'i mchog gyur 'byor (pa)bu khrid dang //mo btsun kun gyi nang nas gzhung bzang mo/ /srid dang dpal 'dzin zas kyi g.yang mo che/ /a ce'i mchog gyur kun dga' bu khrid dang / /tshobo bkrashis 'brug rgyas 'od zer dang / /mon mo dang ni chos 'byor dang //

170chos tshe ring dang sdugabu dang / /tshamo rin chen ngag dbang sgrol ma dang / khye phrug dang ni tsha mo bsam grub dang / /gong ma'i bka' sgrub skyabus gsum gus pas bsten/ /lag pa'i mchotha/gyur rgya mtsho ma leg dang / /rin chen dang ni lhun grub la sogs pa'i/ /dge 'di'i phyogs su mthun rkyen yang dag mdzod/ /mdo rgyud shes bya galus kun mkhyen cing / /bslab gsum rnam dag ngur sgrig rgyan gyis mdzes/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' chos 'phel dang / /lung rtogs dbang phyug gsang sngags bde legs dang / /thugs dam rang bzhin la sku gas mchod gnas gsumapo yis/ /rten mchog khyad par can rnams 'di dag la//me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis rab gnas mdzad/ /gzhan yang sku gnyen phyag phyi drung 'khenar jo gas/ /bcu phrag bdun gyis dge si ka ru bzang //gzhan yang las dang slon lam phyogs mthun pa'i/ /tshe 'dir bde ldan lhan du 'dzoms pa'i mthus/ /dri zhiga'adab brgya'i tshal la mi gnod par/ /bcud chen blangs nas sbrang rtsi'i dpal bskyed ltar/ /spya (dpya )dang lo ma'i thabs kyis ṇḍalan po yi/ /bang mdzod 'gengs mkhas bsod nams rin chen dang / /skyed bkrashis ngag dbang ldo re

171dang / /mgon po dar rgyas gsol dpon don grubadang / /sbyin bdag sku tshe sa ltar bstan padang / /dpal 'byor chu ltar rgyas pa'i ba dan 'phyar/— /bsod nams me chen rtag tu 'bar ba da( / /snyan grags rlung ltar khyagapa'i bkrashis skeg/ wa 'gang nga rgya mtsho dang / sha li bkra shis don grub/ chang mongag dbang mas/ skyo ngal med par yab yum gyi zhabs tog dang / ja chang sdug 'dzugs skabs chang la sogs pa/ mthun rkyen yang dag byed pa kun kyang rje yi rang /zas kyi snying po yongs spyod rgyas par shog/yangs pa'i sa chen 'dir yang dus kun tu//lo legs char chu dus su 'bab padang //nad dang 'thab rtsod 'khrugalong kun zhi nas//'gro kun bde zhing dge la spyod par shog/maṅga la/gas 'angam dbyangs rgyal ma ni gyis smon 114༷ nyinabazhus/

/72mdo sne ba phab4 gi ched brjod/༈ skyo'i swa misgru/ dgongs pa chos nyid nam mkha' yangs pal /brtse ba'i thugs rje nyi zla'i 'od 'phros nas/ 'gro kun yorig mun pa sel mdzad pa'i/ /rtsabargyud bla garnams la phyaga'atshal pho/ /bskal pa grangs med bsod nams dpag med bsags/ /'jig rten 'gro ba 'dren pa'i gnyen gcigasu/ /gser gyi mchod sdong ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ /mtshan dpes spras pa'i thugapa'i dbang por 'dud/ /zab zhi spyos bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /rtag chad mtshan ma rabagrol dbu ma'i lam/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas ye shes 'byor ba'i mdzod/ /yum chen 〈rol phyin la gus phyag 'tshal//skyon med chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus na longs spyod rdzogs/ /sna tshogs sprul skus 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal pho/ /rin chen mthing sngon lta bur gsal ba'i snu/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi ldan 'od stong dra ba can/ /mthong thos dran pas ngan song gnas sbyong ba'i/ /mi 'khrugs lha

173yi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs kun khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'dzin/ /gang de'i byin rlabs stasnyi pra dzñā'i mtshan/ /lnga rig grub pa cha/chog brnyes nā ro'i zhabs/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal gyur mar pa rje/ /bsgrub brgyud bstan pa gsal mdzod mi la rje/ /rab mchog rim par brgyud pa'i bka' brgyud la/ /mi ched (phyed)dang bas yid kyis phyaga'atshal pho//gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum/ /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gar stabs las/ /brtse ba'i spyi gzugs ngur sgrig zol 'chang ba/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba padma dkar por 'dud/ /sgrub brgyud kun gyi gtsug rgyan rin po che/ khyung sems dbang thob bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /sems can yongs kyi garig mun pa sel/ /ngag dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'idapal la legs sbyangs pas/ /dri med yon tan yar po'i zla bzhin rgyas/ /'gro ba'i dpal du shar pa'i 'od dkar can/ /kun dga'i mtshan can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'od srung la sogs bstan pa'i gtad rabs dang // klu sgrubal sogs rgyan drugamachog gnyis dang / /mang pos bkur sogs

174chos rgyal rgyud pa ste/ /'phags yul bstan 'dzin rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /nya khri (gnya' khri )btsan po tho tho ri snyan dang / /srong btsan sgamapo khri sgong lde btsan dang / /bo dhi satwa ka gzhi la dang / /ku sa ra dang sgon mi ska cog zhang / /bstan pa snga rabs bstan 'dzin rnam la 'dud/ /bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal sad mi bdun/ /skyed lde nyi ma mgon nas legs brgyud pa'i/ /chos rgyal chen po stod kyi mgon gsugani/ /sa la dbang sgyur rgyal po'i tshul bzung nas/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan dmapa'i khrir bzhugs te/ /sa gsum bde la bkod pa'i mes dpon rgyal//kyai lags/ phyi stod 'jig rten rgya gragarlung gis btegs//nang bcud sems can 'od gsal lha nas chad/ /gling bzhi'i mchog gyur glo yi 'dzagabu'i gling / /dkar po gling gi lte ba rdo rje gdan/ /rgya gar yul gyi mchog ni gag dzña/ /nyan yod grong khyer chen po'i byang phyogs su/ /sa 'dzin mig sman mdog can dgu 'das mtshams/ /chu bo dkar po'i mdangs 'phrog dpal gyi ri/ /dag pa shel gyi cod pan 'chang ba 'di/ /nang ltar rtsarlung khams kyi rten 'brel las/ /gsang

175ltar rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ris med shar/ /phyi ltar dgra bcomabazhugs gnas ti se gangs/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu klung 'du ba'i gzhi/ /'dzam bu tri shi (bri )shing gis mdzes pa'i mtsho/ /klu rgyal ma dros gnas pa'i pho brang nas/ /gaṅga sī tā sisnyi pakṣu rnams/ kha nas rin chen bye ma 'dren zhing 'bab/ /'dod dgugaribyung gnas mar yul gzhung gi chu/ /mi rnams dga' bde skyed la spyod pa'i yul/ /seṅge'i kha 'bala'abrug pa'i g.yas phyogs na/ /81ngas spyod sbyin pa'i 'brug sgra ldi ri ri/ /skye dgu phan bde'i sbrang char sil li li/ /rang sde dga' ba'i lo tog so sor smin/ /snyan pa'i rnga chen nam mkha'i stongs nas brdungs/ /grags pa'i ba dan ri bo'i rtse na g.yo/ /dpung tshogs drag po'i ngar skad 'u ru ru/ /dge bcu nadzoms pa'i smon bya thi ri ri/ /dar rgyas skyed pa'i glu len kyu ru ru/ /mi mthun snang ba'i dgra bo chems se chems/ /yul la g.yang chags sa la 'bur du mtho/ /chos rgyal pho brang gle chen dpal khang dang / /rgyal sa gting sgang rab brtan lha rtse dang / /shel dkar pho brang dbyi gu'i khri khang sogs/ /de 'dra'i srid la dbang sgyur mi dbang ni/ /'jigs med seṅges btegs pa'i khri steng

176du/ /legs byas 'khor lo shugs kyis dbang sgyur ba'i/ /brgya byin mi la 'phos 'dra'i rgyal po ni/ /bu ram zhing pa'i gdung rgyud dri momed//skyon lam dbang gis gangs mā byon pani/ /nya khri ba' po zhes bya'i sa bdag byung / /de las rim bzhin rgyud pa'i rgyal po ni/ /spel legs mu tig phreng bar bsgrigs pa bzhin/ /sa bdag chen po rbha ra'i bar du byon//kyi lags/ nee las rigabazhin rgyud pa'i rgyal po ni/ /rin chen indar nī la'i ri bo nas/ /rnayomang rgyu skar khri dzee legs 'gying ba'i//ri 1)/sha 30du //rdo //rdo //rdo 1rdo tsho 'azigarta bdun bdag lha lam la da mkhan/ / sa rgyal na bad ldan rnam rgyal bzhugs//e ma ho/ bkrashis gser gyi khang ba4 mthon po na/ /nam yang grags pa'i khri la 'khod gyur pa/ /bzhin legs dpal 'byor rgyas ༅ lha sras ni/ /brgya byin rnama'aphrul bde legs rnamargyal dang / /lha btsun ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde/ /logs tsho rnamorgyal hai yonagargyal rnams/ /sku tshe brtan zhing chab srid rgyas par shog/

177e mkhaho/ yab sras thugs la dga' bskyed yid 'phrog ma/gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i rnaga'aphrul lha mo'i rigs/ nags kyi lha mo padma'i 'dzum mdangs can/ /gnam sa'i bdag mo bu khrid dpal mdzes gnyis/ /sras nor dpag bsam shing ltar rgyas par shog/tshangs pa'i sras mo yid kyis sprul 'dra ba'i/ /sras mo gces ma bsod nams dbang mo dang / /skal bzang bstan 'dzin sgrol ma sku mched kyis/ /yab yumagong ma'i srol ka 'dzin par shog /rje'i chab srid bzang po'i mnga' 'og na/ /yul la g.yang chags skyed pa'i sa bu (sa phud )'di/ /phu stod gangs ri dar dkar yol ba 'dra/ /mdo na nor 'dzin bu mo g.yu gos gyon/ /bar na 'bru bcud skyed pa'i ngang mo 'khrungs/ /de'i nang nas gzims khang khang gsar 'di/ /nor bdag 'dzam lha lha yi bang mdzed (dra/ /de 'dra'i srid la dbang sgyur sbyin bdag ni/ /cho rigs khungs btsun lha ldong dkar po'i gdung / /chos blon chen po shākyagyi mtsho 'di/ /pharol dgra la bskal pa'i me bas 'jigs// bu bran skyong la drin can thabs lhag /rigs pa'i khrims kyis mnga'

178gnon mdzad pa'i dpal/ /gnam lcags thog 'bebs seṅge'i rtsal dang mtshungs/ /sku tshe ri rgyal lta bur brtan par shog/ e ma ho/ khyad par mi dbang chen po 'khor du ni/ /rigs rus cho 'brang 'khenar rnams phun sum tshogs/ /chen por 'os pa dpa' mdzangs phun sumatshogs/ /no yi mchog gyur tshe ring bsam grub bzhugs/ /tshe rabs sngon nas las kyai 'phro mthun pa'i/ /mtshar sdug 'od dkar zla zhal 'dzum mdangs ma/ /bzhin bzang snying rje ldan pa'i skal bzang ma/ /srid 'dir bde me sbyor ba'i byams ldan ma/ /sku lus ma ku ta yi ndhe ldan ma/ /dkon mchog mchod la brtson pa'o dad can ma//sbyin pa'i bdag mo rno mo chos 'dzoms dang / /steng zhal 'di rnams dge ba'i bka' bgros nas/ /phyogs 'dir thub bstan parlo rgyas pa dang //bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / /rje yi chab srid mnga' thang mtho phyir dang / /drin can yab yum sku drin 'angal ba dang / /rang rang tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa sbyang ba dang / /snying po med pa'i sgyu ma'i nor rdzas rnams/ /gzhal du med pa'i bsod nams snying po ni/ /bgyid slad gtong ba'i sgo 'phar brgya phye nas/ /grangs med ngo mtshar ldan pa'i rten

179mchog ni/ /sku yi rten du bka' brgyud pho grom (gser phreng )dang //tshe khrid brgyud paganas brtan bcu drug dang / /lam 'bras brgyud pa gser thang bdun tshar bzhengs/ /grub pa'i dbang po'i lung chos khyad 'phags las/ /bslab gzhi 'dul ba chos kyai rgya mtsho ni/ /mthing sngon nasamakha' lta bu'i ngos yangs la/ /rin chen gser dngul gzi gim (zi khyim)la sogs ni/ /zhal skud ragadang shog bu la sogs la//zho grangs brgya phrag lnga dang bcu phrag gnyis/ /rgyu rnams phun sum tshogs la legs par bzhengs/ /e gami mchog 'di 'dra skal ba bzang //sku tshe ri dbang lta bur brtan par thog /dpal 'byor malus bu dpal du mas brgyan/ /yum chen a ma jo jo 'dzom ma yis/ /dge 'di'i phyogs la zhal bkod yang dag mdzad/ /ldam ('dam)skyes ha lo 'dra ba'i sras mo ni/ /bzhin mdzes 'dzum ldan ya rabs rgyan gyis mdzes//me tog zla mdzes tshe ring dpal 'dzoms dang / /bkra shis dpal 'dzoms bstan 'dzin sgrol ma dang / /legs rma dzes sgrol ma 'dzam gling bu khrid rnams/ /yab yum bzhin du chos la dkar bar shog/

180e ma ho/ sngon tshe bsod nams stobs las legs 'khrungs zhing / /dpal 'byor lo 'dab dpag med rgyas pa can/ /no bo legs po sangs rgyas lhun grub bzhugs/ /stag ltar mthangs la seng ltar dpa' brjid che/ /dpa' mdzangs 'phrul ldan mag pa'i mchog gyur ni//bsod nams lhun grub 'brug grags dbang po yis/ /gong ma'i zhabs tog rtag tu brtson par shog /rnam dpyod ldan pas gnyen 'brel kun dang mthun/ /tshabo'i mchog gyur no no bkra shis dang / /mdzangs grung ldan zhing gnyen 'brel mtha' nas rgyas/ /tshomo ngag dbang sgrol ma a ce kun dga' bu khrid dang / /tsha bo kun dgang bu mo 'byor dang ni/ /tshamo rin chen a ce bu khrid dang / /tshul khrims rnam dag bslab pa gsum dang ldan/ 'ikya'i dge slong rnamapar grol ba dang / gsang sngags bde legs chos 'phel rnamagasum gyis/ /dam chos 'di phyogs zhabs tog yang dag mdzad/ /dbon pos gtsobyas phyag mchi thams cad dang //la dwags phu mdo'i lha sde mi sde dang / /drag zhan rgan gzhon rnams kyis dge 'di bzang / /ḍā gros zhi ma (gzhi ma)lding ba'i gros mkhas po//dga' rgya mtsho dang ngag dbang ldo re gnyis/ /ngal dub skyo ngal spangs

181nas mthun rkyen ni/ /yang dag byas pas kun kyang rje yi rang / /mu stag phreng ba'i mdangs 'phrog yi ge'i gzugs/ /mtshar du dngar 'di la dwags mkhas pa che/ /nam mkha' tshe ring pha bu'i gtso byas pa'i//dpon chen bcu phrag gsum gyi sor rtses grub//sbyinabadagasu tshe sa hūṃ ra brtan pa dang //dpal 'byor chu ltar rgyas pa'i ba dan 'phyar//bsod nams me chen rtag tu 'bar ba yis//snyan grags rlung ltar khyab pa'i bkrashis shog/ched brjod 'di nyid gas lngogasungs rgyal mtshan gyis 12—11—༷7 nyenagasapa'o//mdo sde bskal ba4 bris pa 'di dbyi gu'i gur mgon lha khung du bzhugs yod/'dul ba'i ched brjod/oṃ swa sdi sisgru/ dgongs pa chos nyid nam mkha' yangs pa la ///) :ri 1ji05 :rirtse'os 'tsho ༷༷ ring /skub ba thugs nya zla da 'phras nas/ /'a kun bla mun pa sel mdzadapa'i/ /rtsabargyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser

182mdog mtshan dpes rab brgyan brdzid pa'i sku/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re ba sgong ba'i gsung / /ma lus shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i thugs//shāka thub bstan pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas spyo bral chos rnams kun gyi gzhis/ /dri ma kun bral smra bsam brjod las 'das//gnyis zad mnyamabazhag ye shes nam mkha'i 〈(nga / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zabazhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /rtsab rab brtan zab mo stong pa nyid/ /lta ba mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i dbu ma'i lam/ /sde snod rgya mtsho'i klong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /bshes gnyen tshul gyis kha ba can 'dir byon/ /skal ba can rnams smin grol lam la bkod//'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal pho /kun dga' bo sogs dgra bcom brgya phrag lnga / /grags pa la sogs 'phags pa bdun brgya dang / /gnas pa'i bu sogs bka' bsdu mdzad pa yis/ /bsdu ba rnamagasum mdzad pa rnams la 'dud// 'od srung la sogs bsnan pa'i gtad rabs dang / /klu sgrub la sogs rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / /mang pos bkur sogs chos rgyal rgyud

183pa sde/ /'phags yul bstan 'dzin rnams la gus phyag 'tshal// gnya' khri btsarna po tho sgo ri snyan dang / /srong bsto sgam po khri srong lde btsan dang / /bo dhi satwa ka ma shi la dang / /ku sa ra dang thon mi ka cog zhang / /bstan pa sngar dar bstan 'dzin rnams la 'dud/ /bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal sad mi bdun/ /skyed lde nyi ma mgon las legs rgyud pa'i/ /chos rgyal chen po stod kyi mgon gsum ni/ /sa la dbang sgyur rgyal po'i tshul bzung nas/ /dbang phyug brgyang ldan dam pa'i khrir bzhugs te/ /sa gsum bde la bkod pa'i mes dpon rgyal/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa dang / /'dul ba mngon pa mdo sde rin po che/ /legs par gsungs dang de'i dgongs 'grel gyi//(ba)rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal 'o1//kye lags/ snang med 'od gsal nam mkha' sprerdzang pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po dang / /sems can rnam sa kyi spyi mthun las 'phro dang / /'jig rten stongs pa'i mchog ldan rnam gsum las/ khyung gi dkyil 'khor mthing nag zla gam chags/ /de'i steng gser gyi sa gzhi gru bzhi chags/ /'byung ba rim brtsegs dkyil

184gsor de ltar chags/ /de las 'jig rten stong gsum grangs med chags/ /'byung chen bzhi po 'o ma'i rgya masna'o las/ /spyi mthun las kyi byed pa pos byas nas/ /thur zug gyen mtho rlung gi srub shing byas//bsrubs pa'i 'bras bus mar gong lta bu ni/ rin chen las grub ri rab ther 'bugabyung / /gser gyi ri bdun rim gyis bskor pa la/ /g.yu yi chu mig ral mtsho so sor byung / 'thungs na mngar zhing nad rnams kun la phan/ /gling bzhi gling phran rnams kyang so sor grub/ /snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa de ltar lags/ de ltar grub pa'i stong gsum 'jig rten 'di/ mi marjed 'jig rten khams zhes ming btags so//stod kyi 'jig rten ji ltar chags pa la/ 'dzam bu'i gling ni bye ba phrag brgya nas/ /sprul sku bye ba phrag brgyas ston pa mdzad/ /de ltar sprul sku grangs med don mdzad kyang / /nam mkha'i khyon yangs phyogs mtha' bral ba ru/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams rab 'byams dpag med na// 'gro drug 'dren mdzad sprul sku mtha' yas bzhugs/ /sprul sku'i mchog gyur gangs chen mtsho rgyal nyid/ /phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag steng lhung bzed ni/ /rin chen las grub 'od ldan 'phro ba'i lam//

185stong chen nyi shu rtsalnga brtsegs pa yi/ /bcu gnyis yar mar bzhag pa'i bcu gsum pa / /rdzogs ldan dus su sangs rgyas mtshan dpes spras//sum khri drug stong rim par chos gsor bsgor/ /gnyis ldan du yang sumastong drug brgya byon/ /theg pa che chung mdo yi chos 'khor bsgor//gcig ldan nas brtsams rtsod dus rnams su ni/ /sangs rgyas stong byon lho phyogs 'dzom gling 'dir/ /drug khri'i dus su 'khor ba 'jig nyid byon/ /bzhi khri'i dus su rgyal ba gser thub byon/ /nyi khri'i dus su sangs rgyas 'od srung byon/ /brgya pa'i dus 'dir shāka thub bsnan pa yi//snyigs dus bstan pa dar ba yul gyi mchog /gling rnams kun las 'dzam gling khyad du 'phags// dbyibs mchog mdzes pa sogs kyi shing rta'i dbyibs/ /sra brtan mi 'gyur rdo rje ra bas bskor/ /'dzam gling gser gyi lte ba rdo rje gdan/ /brjid mdzes dbyibs legs bya rgod phung po'i ri/ /nyams dga' bkrashis ser skya'i grong khyer na/ /mi yi bdag po rgyal po zas gtsang ma/ /yon tan kun ldan rgyal sras don grub 'khrungs/ /de las rgyud pa'i shāka rigs lnga brgya 'khrungs/ /bod kyi spu rgyal glo bur rgyal po

186grags/ /de ltar mtha' bzhi rgyal po dpe med kyang / /mi rje mis byas ya mtshan khyad par med/ /rje'i mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams 'di//ri mtho sa gtsang lha gnas gzhan las 'phags/ /dwangs pa bsil ba chu bo bzhi yi mgo/ /'bru sna lnga 'khrungs spang spos rim gyis bskor//gser la sogs te rin chen dgos 'dod tshang / /sta se gangs ri mchod rten brtsigs pa 'dra/ /mtsho mo ma phagagayu yi maṇḍal can//yon tan mang ldan bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /gnya' khri btsan po man chad mes dpon rgyal/ /gnamagyi lha las mi yi rjer gshegs te/ /de nas khri srong sde btsan yan chad du/ /rje yi bsod nams 'phrul gyi byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyal phran gnyis thetshogs thabs kyis legs par btul//bod 'bangs de nas bde skyed 'dzoms pa lags/ /de'i 'gram gnas mnga' ris skor gsum 'dir/ /longs spyod sbyin pa'i 'brug sgra sdi ri ri/ /skye dgu phan bde sbrang char sil li li/ /snyan pa'i rnga chen nam mkha'i stong na bdungs/ /grags pa'i ba dan ri bo'i rtse na g.yo//dpung tshogs drag po'i ngar skad 'u ru ru/ /dge bcu 'dzoms pa'i smon bya thi ri ri/ /dar rgyas skyed pa'i glu len kyu ru ru/ /yul la g.yang

/87chags sa la 'bur du mtho/ /chos rgyal pho brang zle (gle /chen dpal khang 'di/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang nyid dang mtshungs/ /de 'dra'i srid la mnga' sgyur mi dbang ni/ /lha chen rigs 'khrungs mi dbang chu gter can/ /ngo mtshar lugs gnyis nor bu'i dpal yon can//grags pa'i rba rlabs phyogs bcur 'bebs mkhas pa'i/ /mi dbang chos rgyal bde ldan rnamargyal 'di/ /mkhyen pa rab rdzogs 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mtshungs/ /mkha' mnyam skyong la thugs rje chen po 'dra/ /thub bstan skyong la gsang ba'i bdag po bzhin/ /rgyal khrims pad tshal skyong ba'i mazer can/ /mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar shog/e maho/ lha sras mi la 'phos 'dra'i bzhin legs po/ /rnamathos bu dang 'dra ba'i 'byor pacan/ /rnam mang rgyu skar khri la legs 'gyings ba'i/ /rta bdun bdag po lha lamarol rtsed mkhan/ /pha rol dgral bskal pa'i me bas 'jigs/ /bu bran skyong la drin can lhabs lhag /rig(sa)pa'i khrims kyi mnga' gnon mdzad pa'i dpal//gnam lcags thog 'bebs seṅge rtsal dang mtshungs/ /mi dbang lha sras bde legs rnam rgyal dang / /lha btsun ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i

188sde/ /'jigs bral rnamargyal nyi ma rnam rgyal rnams/ /sku tshe bstan cing chab srid rgyas par shog/e ma ho/ yab sras thugs la dga' bskyed yid 'khye1ga ma//gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i rnam 'phrul lha mo'i rigs/ /nags kyai lha mo padra'i 'dzum mdangs can/ci /gnam sa'i bdag mo bu khrid dpal mdzes gnyis/ /sras nor dpag bsam shing ltar rgya/sa par shog /tshangs pa'i sras 31 yid kyis sprul 'dra ba'i/ /sras mo gces ma bsod nams dbang mo dang / /skal bzang bstan 'dzin sgrol ma sku mched kyi/ /yab yum gong ma'i srol ka 'dzin par shog /rje'i chab srid bzang po'i mnga' 'og na/ /yul la g.yang chags skyed pa'i sa bu 'di/ /phu stod gangs ri dar dkar yol ba 'dra/ /mdo na nor 'dzin bu mo g.yu gos gyon//bar na 'bru bcud skyed pa'i ngang mo 'khrungs/ /de'i nang nas gzim khang khang gsar 'di/ /nor bdag 'dzam bha lha yi pho brang 'dra/ /de'i dra'i srid la dbang sgyur sbyin bdag ni/ /dang por che ba lha chen shed bu'i gdung / /bar du che ba sku rje phug pa'i gdung / /tha mar che galha ldong dkar po'i gdung / /mi dbang chen po'i bka' lung sgyur dbang po/ /

189phun tshogs dpal gyi rigs las mngon par mtho/ /stobs chen dpung gis pharol zil gyis gnon/ /khrims gnyis chos bzhin skyong ba'i rnamadapyod wo/ /chos blon chen po shākya rgya mtsho 'di/ /pas rgol brag ri 'joms pa'i gnam lcags 'dra/ /chab srid 'dab stong skyong ba'i nyin byed 'dra/ /'bangs rnams bu bzhin skyong ba'i yab gci ga yin/ /sku tshe ri rgyalaltaburabartanaparashog wa e ma ho/ khyad par mi dbang chen po'i 'khor du ni/ /rigs rus cho 'brang 'khor rnams phun sum tshogs/ /chen po 'os pa'i dpa' mdzangs 'phrul dang ldan/ /no'i mchog gyur tshe ring bsam grub bzhugs/ /tshe rabs sngon nas las kyi 'phro mthun pa'i/ /tshar (mtshar)sdug 'od dkar zla zhal 'dzum mdangs ma/ /bzhin bzang snying rje'i zhon pa'i skal ldan ma/ /srid pa'i phre la sbyor ba'i byams ldan ma/ /sku lus mgu ra rme dri ldan ma/ /zhal ras uspril yi pad ldan rme/ /dkon(mchog)mchod la rshartson pa'i dad ldan ma/ /sbyin :riwa :tho spreladapaces tshanarjerdo /gra spe—— /gri thegapa bdag zhe ma sa mas dang / / nga zhal gnyas sa da ba'i bka' gros nas/ /phyogs 'dir thub bstan gas rgyas pa dang //

/90(ba)snan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / /rje yi chab srid mnga' thang mtho phyir dang / /drin can yab yum su drin 'jal gdang / /rang rang tshogs rdzogs sgrigapa sbyang ba dang / /snying po med pa'i sgyu ma'i nor rdzas rnams/ /gzhal du med pa'i bsod nams snying po ni/ /bgyid slad gtong ba'i sgo 'phar brgya tshe (phye)nas/ /grangs med ngo mtshar ldan pa'i rten mchog 'di/ /sku yi rten du thub pa'i dbang po dang / /byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' ba gnyis/ /dngul srang bco lnga re la ljang gdung (brngungs)yin/ /gsung gi rten du mdo sde bskal bzang gi//(ba)stod kyi rgya skad rin chen dngul gyi grangs/ /dngul srang sumacu'i rgyud gdung (bdungs)legs par grub/ /mthing shog nagamakha' lta bu'i ngos yangs la/ /rin chen gser dngul zi gim (zi khyem)la selags pa/ /klad lha rgya skad sogs la ljang gdung (bdungs)yin//zhal skud rin dang shog bu la sogs pa/ /zho grangs bdun bcu dang ni zho gsum 31/ /rgyu rnams phun sum snardogs pa'i legs par zhengs/ /6sgo ma mi mchog 'di 'dra skal babazang / /5 tshe ring la mnga' thangargyas par smon/ /dpal 'byor ma lus bu dpal du ma'i rgyan/ /yum

19/chen a ma jo jo 'dzom me yis/ /dge 'di'i phyogs su zhal bkod yang dag mdzad/ /ldam ('dam)skyes nyi lo 'dra ba'i sras mo ni/ /bzhin mdzes 'dzum ldan ya rabs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /me tog zla mdzes tshe ring dpal 'dzoms dang / /bkrashis dpal 'dzoms bstan 'dzin sgrol ma dang / /legs mdzes sgrol ma 'dzam gling bu khrid rnams/ /yab yum bzhin du chos la dkar bar shog/e maho/ sngon tshe bsod nams stobs las legs 'khrungs shing / /dpal 'byor lo 'dab dpag med rgyas pa can/ /no bo legs so sangs rgyas lhun grub bzhugs/ /snag ltar mdzangs la gser ltar dpa' brjid che/ /dpa' mdzangs 'phrul ldan mag pa'i mchog gyur ni//bseld nams lhun grub 'brug grags dbang po yi/ /be|nga ma'i zhabs tog rtag tu brtson par shog /rnam dpyod ldan pas gnyen 'brel kun dang mthun/ /tshobo'i mchog gyur no no bkrashis dang / /mdzangs grung ldan zhing gnyen 'brel mtha' nas rgyas/ /tsha mo ngag dbang sgrol ma a ce bu khrid dang / /tshabo kun dga' bu mo 'byor dang ni/ /tshomo rin chen asmyoce bu khrid dang / /gzhan yang phyogs kyi sbyin gtong dpa' mo che//

192dge si ka ru byung ba'i rnam grangs la/ /tshul khrims rnam dag bslab gsumargyan gyis mdzes/ shākya'i dge cherang gsang sngags bde legs kyis/ /dge 'di phyogs su zhabs tog yang dag mdzad/ /gzhan yang sa bu dbyi gu gnyis po nas/ /nam mkha' rdo rje gtso bcas phyag mchi (phyi )thams cad kyis/ /dge mai ka ru dbyar ma3me bzhin du 'khyel (bskyel)/ /so so'i ming nas brjod na 'di ltar te/ /blo gros gzhi ma sding ba'i gros mkhas po/ /las 'bras 'byed par mkhas pas dge la brtson/ /blang dor mkhas pas steng zhal thugs mnyes byed/ /gros 'debs mkhas pas 'khor 'dab 'jim gyis skyong / /gnyer pa'i mchog gyur (kun)dga' rgya mtsho dang / ngag dbang ldo re gnyis po blo mthun nas/ /ngal btub(dub)skyo ngal spangs nas mthun rkyen ni/ /yang dag byas pas kun kyang rjes yi rang / dbang phyug bu khrid dang ni chos 'phel dang / /rin chen dang ni chibs dpon lhang gan dang / /'gang nga phel le blo bzang rgyal mtshan dang / /snum ldor dang ni chibs dpon nag po dang / /'gang nga 'phel le tsar pa dzee lu dang / /gam rin chen dang ni tshe ring dang / /lhar na dang ni 'dzom ni tshe ring dang / /a ma

193bsod nams dang yon bdag dang / /gser khri mgu ru ngag dbang lhun grub dang / /dga' skyed dang ni khrig se 'dzom don grub/ /dpe thub tshe ring rgya mtsho lo lo dang / /dbyi gu'i skyed sgrol ma dang dga' sa 'bi//chibs dpon dbang phyugs dang ni mchog skyed dang / /dpal wom dang ni chos skyabs ma dang ni/ /phyag phyi drung 'khor rnams kyis dge si bzang / /yangs pa'i sa chen 'dir yang dus kun tu/ /lo legs char chu dus su 'bab pa dang / /nad dang 'thab rtsod stig long (slong )kun zhi nas/ /'gro kun bde zhing dge la spyod par shog /rgyal ba gong ma'i thugs dgongs rab rdzogs nas/ /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin sku tshe brtan gyur te/ /rgyal khams kun tu bde skyed ldan pa dang / /rgyal ba'i sdong la la tsho //// ————bstan pa phyags bcur rgyas gyur nas/ /rgyal ba gdul bya mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams kyis/ /rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob shog/maṅga yaṃ/ gegus rsām dbyangs rgyal mas gyis 1da 11 07 nyin mis pa'o// hphu gu'i gur mgon lha khang du blon chen shāspyargya mtshos sbyin bdag mdzad nas 'bri ru bcug yaṃ 'dul 0pod bcu gsum ṅka las la ngo mtshar ba bzhugs yod pa'i che brjod yin no//

/94 mang zlor yod po'i rdo rje gcod pa snang pa ga gi ched brjod/skyo'iswa sto selha/ rab mdzes sku yis mig la dga' ston 'gyed//rab snyan gsung gis rnang ba'i dpal rab 'phrog (du shar)//rab gsal thugs kyis sems la bde chen skyed//rab dad gus pas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud//tre/ 'khrib/sa/shes bya'i mkha' la mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khenar rgyas//rab mdzes padma'i dbus na gser gyi mdog/mdangs gsal 'od dkar phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad pa'i//shāka thub bstan pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal 'etsho /kye lags/thub pa'i dbang pos phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams su//gsung rab ji snyed gsungs pa'i rin chen gser//phul byung 'od zer 'phro ba'i 'bri ba kun//'dod dgu dam pa ster mdzad de la 'dud//

195rgya gar lto phyogs bram ze chen po nas// bka' dang bstan bcos sgra bsgyur gtan la phab//bod yul chos kyi dbul ba sel mdzad pa'i//thon mi sasgo ṭal phyag 'tshal pho//gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me kun snying dang //bsod nams rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan dang //sa skya paṇḍita chos rgyal 'phags pa sogs//rtsabargyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//kye lags/khyad par 'phags pa'i yul chen lnga po ni//dam chos dar ba rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul//snang srid gtan 'bebs rgya nag rtsis kyi yu la//dgos 'dod kun 'byung stag zig nor gyi yul//〈rol dpung 'joms ge sar dmag gi yul//ri mtho sa gtsang spu rgyal bod kyi yul//

196phyi snod 'jig rten rgya gram rlung gis btegs//nang bcud sems can 'od gsal lha nas chad//gling gi mchog gyur lho yi 'dzam bu'i gling //sangs rgyas gnas chen badzra6ni sa na//nyan yod grong khyer chen po'i byang phyogs su//'jig rten dbang po'i (mgon po'i)thugs rje'i 'od zer ni//gang du lhung ba mtha' khob mun pa'i gling //phan bde ku mud rab bzhad thub bstan gyi//gos dkar ldan pa kha ba can 'di na//'dzam gling sa yi lte bar gyur pa ni//dgra bcom chen po bzhugs gnas sta se'i gangs/ /klu rgyal ma dros gnas pa'i pho brang nas//chu chen seṅge kha 'bab 'brug pa'i phyogs//'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas mar yul gzhung gi cha//mi rnams dga' bde skyed la spyod pa'i yul//chos rgyal pho brang gle chen dpal mkhar dang //

/97rgyal sa ga nga sgang rab brtan lha rtse dang //rtse mo shel dkar gangs kyi cod pan mtho//de 'dra'i gzhal yas chen po'i pho brang na//mi 'jigs seṅges btegs pa'i khri steng du//legs byas 'khor lo'i shugs kyis dbang sgyur ba'i//brgya byin mi la 'phos 'dra'i rgyal po ni//rin chenayinadra dī la'i ri bo nas//rnam mang rgyu skar khri la legs 'gying ba'i//rta bdun rgyal po (bdag po)lha lam rol rtsed mkhan//dzirol dgral bskal pa'i me bas 'jigs//bu bran skyong la drin can hobs lhag/rigs pa'i khrims kyis mnga' gnon mdzad pa'i dpal//gnagalcags thoga'abebs seṅge'i rtsal dang mtshungs//chos kyai rgyal po nyi ma rnam rgyal bstod/ /gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i rnama'aphrul mo'i rigs//dgos 'dod ra 'beb nor rgyun lha mo 'dra//

198gnam sa'i bdag mo bsod nams mtsho mo ni//rnam mang rgyal phran yongs kyai gtsug na mdzes//e ma ho/ dka' brgyudakun gyi gtsug rgyan rin po che//rlung sems dbang thob chos gos ngur rtseg bsnams//bod yul mun pasel ba'i sgron me mchog/tshe ring dpal bzang ngag dbang zhabs la 'dud//e ma ho/ mar yul mar gyi snying po lta bu 'di//seṅge kha 'bab 'brug pa'i g.yon phyogs na//zhing khams zhinadra nī la'i mdangs can la//rgyal ba sangs rgyas mgus byon pa'i gling //gling rnams kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa'i gnas//yul mchog dam pa skyed pa'i mang spro 'dir//phu na lha gnyan chos bdag rong btsan gnyis//mdo na mtsho smanaphyugamosmanabazhibazhugs// — pa

199shar ri brjid ldan rgyal po'i tshul du bzhugs //mdzes pa'i gangs ri'iphrengabasastonasabasne ṭwā/'brug pa'ichu'ostonasasharala'abab ——dri ldan ljon shing nags tshal lgo nas rgyas//bkrag gsal me matog sna tshogasamadzesapa'imadangs wadage bcu 'dzoms pa'i pho brang mang spyo na//chos sgra chen po snyan pa'i grags pa can//dpal 'byor rgya mtsho kun nas bskyel pa 'dra//dge 'dun rgya mtsho kun nas 'dus pa'i gnas//mkhas pa rgya mtsho legs bshad sgrog pa'i gsung //bla ma'i gdan sa chos 'khor shwa gling na//rig pa'i gnas lnga yon tan thugs su chud//kun mkhyen legs bshad grub pa'i paṇḍita//mkhas grub lam 'bras mdo sngags kun gyi mdzod//'angam dbyangs rnamasprul dpal ldan 'phrin las la/ /lus ngag yid gsumagus pas phyag 'tshal 'e1//

200ye gaho/grwa pabu slob chos sgra di ri ri//mi sde (dar rgyas)skyed pa'i rna len kyu ru ru//longs spyod sbyin pa'i 'byug sgro di ri ri//skye dgu phan bde'i sbrang char li li//(yul la)dge bcu 'dzoms pa'i zhon bya di ri ri //rang rang dga' ba'i pho tog so sor smin//tshe sngon bsod nams chen po'i shugs las grub//rnam sras nor la dbang 'ogablon chenani//bsod nams gun grub su tshe brtan par shog/7gong ma'i bka' bzhen sgrub pa'iblonachenani//no no phun tshogs zhabs pad brtan par shog/de yi zugs la dga' skyed yid 'phrog ma//nu mo legs so ba na 'dzin sgrol ma bzhugs//77 rkorka —— spyo dku sne tshe dbang dang //gces ma legs so dpal snan bu khrid ni//

201sku tshe ri bo bzhin du brtan gyur cig/dkon mchog mchod la dga' ba'i dung sems can//rgyud ske glu 7 7 spyo ṣka dku 'dzin can//mi rigs khungs btsun bu ragargya shing rgyud//yon gyi bdag po zhi(zhang gang sug dang //tshe rabs sngon nas las kyi 'phro mthun pa'i//bzhin bzang bu mo mdzongs grung gnyis dang ldan//g.yo sgyu'i gos phud ser sna'i mdud pa bkrol// dkon mchog mchod la dga' ba'i dung sems ma /sbyin pa'i bdag mo bzang mo bu khrid kyis//drin can tshima'i drin lan 'khor phyir dang //khyad par rang re'i sdig sgrib byang phyir dang //'gro ba rigs drug ngan song nas thar phyir//sku yi rten du thub dzigatso'akhor gsum//sa skya paṇḍata gong yolnga yis bsgor//o rgyan padma gu ru mtshan brgyad bsgor//

202spyan ras gzigs dang tshe dpag med pa dang //'dzagaser 'dzam nag sogs kyi sku thang bzhings//gsung gi rten du dam chos khyad 'phags can//mchog tu gyur pa mdo sna zab mo ni//dgos 'dod kun 'byung lnga bcu nga gcig bzhengs//e ma mi mchog 'di 'dra skal ba bzang //bsags pa chos phyir gtong ba ngo mtshar che//de'i rjes kyai shog lhe rnams med rkyen cha tshang 'bri ma thub/ yon bdag a zhang gang sugagis 5 thang mang po zhig dang rdo rje gcod pasogs mdo tshan mang po zhig 'bri ru bcugayod par mngon kyang / da lta gang du yod su la'ang rgyus med/'on kyang ched brjod 'di snyan ngag gi lam nas rta yo snyan la don che bar mthong nas gas 'angagadabyangs rgyal mtshan gyis 2༷༷na spyi zla 2 tshes 13 nyin bzhusapa'o//

203thamago'i yul du yod ba'i ma gdang 'ga'i mched rjod/ —kan/ skyo'isuste sgru/ mtshan dpes rab brgyan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /thar lam ston mdzad gsung rab dam pa'i chos/ /slab gsumornam dag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsumal phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgo'i 'dzam gling dam chos dar ba'i sa//pho brang chen po rab brtan lha rtse'i steng / /chos rgyal chen po bde skyong rnam rgyal bstod/ /yul la g.yang chags rgyal sa ba sgo 'dir/ /blon chen ngag dbang rgya mtsho bsod namasaphun tshogs bstod/ /yon gyi bdag po bkris tshe ring gis/ khreng yos (gzhin mo)gna' ma gang 'dzom//bu mo dpala'ardzo 7 bkris g.yang 'dzomadang tshe dbang g.yang 'dzom gnyis kyai don du aṇi brgya dang drug cu bzhengs/ /bu khrid kyi don du maṇi bzhi bcu zhe lnga bzhings/ spyo ske 7 me 'brubakazla ba 6 tshes la khan/ skyodasu misgru/ dgongs pa chos nyid nam mkha' yangs pal//brtse ba'i thugs rje'i nyi zla'i 'od phros nas/ /'gro kun blo'i mun pyo

204selamadzad pa'i/ /rtsabargyud bla ma rnams la phyaga'atshalapho/ /gser mdog mtshan dpes rab brgyan brjid pa'i sku/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re gabaskong ba'i gsung / /galus shes bya ji bzhin gzigasapa'i zugs//shākya'i rtso (gtso )bo de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /kye lags/ phyi sdod 'jig rten rgya bkram snying gis btegs/ /nang bcud sems ༅ 'od gsal lha nas chad/ /pho brang chen po rab brtan lha rtse 'dir/ /de 'dra'i rin chen gser gyi khri steng du/ /chos rgyal chen po nyi ma rnam rgyal dang //lha'i mas po bde skyong rnamargyal bzhugs/ /e ma ho/ las 'bras chos la dkar ba'i rsāg rten dang / /mi rtag rgyu mar shes pa'i dad pag//khyegapa'i lus la skye ba'i byang chub sems/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po 6ltalha (pha)bkrashis dang / /bu bkris don gruba'abyor don grubaganyis kyis//sku drin 'khor med agargyal mtshan la thar lam thob phyir du sku'i rten du blo bzang grags pa'i 'dra sku bzhengs/ /thugs rje chen po'i gsung gi thogam/ /rdo la 'bur bkod maṇi stong dang lnga brgya bzhings/ /bsags pa chos phyir gtong ba ngo mtshar che/ /gzhan yang gnyen drung rnams gis dge si ka ru bzang / /yon mchod rtso (gtso)bcas 'gro

205drug sems ga rnams/ /phyi gzugs rje chen po'i zhabs drung skye bar shog sarba ma lam//ga) o swa / mtshan dpesarab brgyan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /thar lagaston mdzad gsung rab dam pa'i chos/ /bslabagasum rnamadag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gangs can sa yi mchog gyur lho yi ljongs/ /lha gnas bdag po ni/ /mi dbang chen po bde skyong rnam rgyal bstod/ /srid pa gsum la 'gran zla dpe ma lags/ /yul la g.yang chags rgyal sa bamasgo 'dir/ /rje blon chen po dbang rgyal rgya 3/tsho dang / /bsod nams phun tshogs gnyis la bstod/ /blo gros 'dab yangs dkar po dge la mod(bkod/ /mi rigs khungs btsun rgya /spri/ 'tsho /// 1sgo /thergazug 17 /// /lhanacud khyad rgyud/ /yan bdag rang bsam 'a pha sa nga yos lo dran yab su me rtog sad khyer 'dra/ /bu tshe la 'das pa rgya mtsho tshe ring gang 'byor dang mna' ma kun dga' chon 'tshom(chos 'dzoms)/ /tsha bo bsod nams phun tshogs/ /lo (blo)bzang phun

2slotshogs dang tshomo kun dga' bu khrid dang kun woms bdun la thar lam 1tho /// 1///rto ྅/sgo /lnga/re rdo //rdo lag ba ra du/ gsung na du ga brgya ga ga dang bdun stang drug cu dang / rdo la 'bur bkod maṇi bdun brgya dang thugs kyai rten du dngul gyi gdung gnyis rnams bzhengs/ stog pa tshe 'das bu tshe ring phe le dang mna' gablo bzang chos woms/ tshomo bkris gang skyed/ tshe /rdorsha 1rdordo :sgo /du 1rngo she///sdu/1do/ /ngedabang sa 'a mas dang tsha ba sa da sa grub dang na du ma brgya dang nyi shu bzhengs/ bu mo tshe ring ma'i don du maṇi nyer lnga zhengs/tshe 'das rnams ni tho ris skye bar shog e ma ho//ched brjod 'di dge tshe ring chos 'phel gyi spyi lo 1984 8687lor mis pa'o/ yi ge'i dag cha la bsgyur ba yo yang btang med/

207rtogayul gyi no rgyus che brjod kun gyis go bde zhes bya ba bzhugs sa//༄mi༅/ /tshung swa ste/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /rig grol gnyis ldan skyabs gsum gus btud nas/ /mar yul la dwags tog zhes bya ba'i yul/ /che brjod ratna'i do shal 'dir dgod bya/ /de yang gu ru chen po'i gsung rnam las/ /mnga' ris skor gsum dmar yul pu rangs su/ /gdung rgyud rgyal po mgon gsum bya ga'abyung / /zhes pas lung bstan skyed lde nyi ma mgon/ /gang de'i sras gsum che ba dpal gyi mgon/ /la sogs chos rgyal lo paṇa rim byon gnas/ /yul cig skyed pa mar yul la dwags stod/ /phun tshogs sa la g.yang chags bkrashis tog /phu na gangs dkar dgung la reg payis/ /bdud rtsi chu rgyun bzang pos yul rdzongs khyab/ /g.yas na rdza chu lhung lhung brdab khrol ri/ /yul phyogs 'di la yol bas bcad pa 'dra/ /g.yon na lha mi'i mchod yul gur phub dgon/ /bslab gsum khrims ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis mdzes/ /dbus na lugs gnyis skyong mdzad chos kyi rgyal/ /thog mar 'phags yul mang bkur rgyal po'i rgyud/ /bar du lubor sgyur nga la nu yi gdung / /mtha' mar

208chos rgyal mes dpon rnamogasumorus/ /'khrul bral mar yul sa skyong yum sras zhabs/ /bzhugasapa'i sku mkhar lha yi khang bzang bzhin//mda' na o rgyan gu rus byin badzrabs pa'i/ /yan lag brgyad ldan khron chur klu sman gnas/ /lha ri rten dar 'dzugs pa'i lha rten zhes//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gnas bdag yul mgor bzhugs/ /mdun na seng chen gnamakhal mchongs 'dra'i ri/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags/ /lhag par sngon dus 'bru yi phung po'i bcud//phug ngon gzugs dod gcig dang rin chen g.yu/ /che chung lug sog 'dra ba'i khyad nor zhig /gser gi tog 'dra'i ga'u zhig tu bzhugs//phyogs 'dir pa'i gter mchod rten zhig la gnas/ /des rkyen yul gyi ming yang tog zhes grags/ /phun tshogs 'dod dgu 'dzoms pa'i yul phyogs 'dir/ /dbu ru chos rgyal ya rabs lugs bzang bzhes//dkon mchog mchod dang dbul phongs sbyin gtong brtson/ /rang zhabs 'bangs 'khor rim bzhin skyong bar mdzad/ /chos bzhin spyod pas rgyal po'i chab srid dar/ /de'i 'og chaga'abangs skya ser pho mo'i tshogs//chos la dkar zhing dpon labakur ba dang / /dkon mchog mchod cing dge 'dun bsnyen bkur bsten/ khro gtum nga rgyal rang 'dod phyogs

209zhen med/ /ngan blong sbyin gtor phamar bas zhumakhas/ /las 'bras rtsi zhing skyed pa'i glu gar rtse/ /der brten yul khams bde zhing lo phyugs legs/ /nad mug thig rtsod ming med bde skyedas//mtha' bzhi'i yul phyogs gzhan rnams rang la sgon// khungs ldan lo gyi theg de di gi11 che yido zhergyus kun sa ba 'a / /da nga dka' na na sa pas bris/ /mchog gsum sgru ba med pa'i byin rlabs dang / /rten byung bden tshig 0li mas nus kyis/ /yul phyogs 'dis mtshon yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun/ /bkrashis bde legs chen tsho khyagagyur cig/ bkris//shes 2( /) /ri /rdo /skuthen therdo /) stuspro bri /dra ga ma ga ga pa da'akhor na sa na grub sa 1958 ra sa pa /

210khuga'i g.yas phyogs yogaba'icagathang ring tshad gur smosmon yod pa'i ched brjod/sgyu sgrong las khyad 'phags lto phyogs 'dzam bu'i dbus//kha ba mā rdzongs dam chos dar ba'i sa 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas 'khor lo sdogapa yi//bzhugs pa'i gnas chen gangs dkar sta se 'o/ /mtsho mo ma phamagayu yi maṇḍal dang //gser gyi ri bdun rol pa'i mtsho yongs kyis//seṅge kha 'bab 'brug pa'i g.yas rol na//mar yul gzhung gi lte ba rdo rje gdan/ /pho brang mchog de gle chen dpal mkhar dang //rgyal sa gting sgang rab brtan lha rtse ngu // shel mkhar pho brang dbyi dgu khri — — 4sgyu'i ri/de ga'i srid la dbang bsgyur mi yi bdag/bu ram shing pa'i gdung rgyud nyi ma'i gnyen//sa la dbang ba rgyal po'i tshul bzung nas//

2//legs byas 'khor le'i stobs kyis dbang bsgyur ba//gnamasa'i bdag mo bsod nams mtsho mo bzhugs//lha sras mi la 'phos pa'i rgyal bu ni wa wachos rgyal gdung 'dzin sa skyong rnam rgyal dang //gces ma bde legs nor 'dzin dbang mo rnams//sku tshe dpal 'byor mnga' thang rgyas par shog/me tog sad khyer mi pham rgyal 'dzom ni// srid pa'i mtsho las bskal pa'i rlung shugs kyis//bde chen thar pa'i lam phyogs bgrod phyir du//sku rten gser dang li khri'i rgyur grub pa'i//thub dbang nyi ma shākya'i rgyal po la//rgyab yol gnas brtan bcu drug 'dod lha dang //'phags mchog thugs rje chen po mi tshad ni//byin rlabs bzhengs pa'adi la ngo mtshar dang //gsung rten rdo la 'bur 'god ma ṇi'i grangs// co khri phrag gcig dang bzhi stong drug brgya bzhengs//

212bsod nams me chen rtag tu 'thar ba yis/lhan gragapa chung ltar khyab pa'i bkrashis shog/ga 'kho mo'i ring mo 'di shobasdoms yijug sapa 4767brkos 'dugastod cha chos sa rtswa ma rnamorgyal dang byu skyong rnamos/thad cha bde nas rnags dusal bzhengs sa//ched shod 'di ma na nga ga zha gabakod namigasun tshogasakyidzi stonazla tshes 15nyin bzhusapa'o//༷ gu ga lo ga' gaglod/rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas dam chos kun//skyes mchog lo paṇa rnams kyis bod du bsgyur//khyad par gdong lnga kha 'basamatsho 'gram du//seng ge kha 'baga'abrug pa'i g.yas phyogasan//pho sa chen po gli chen dpal mkhar du//mi 'jigs seṅge btegs pa'i khri steng du//legs byas 'khor lo'i stobs kyis dbang bsgyur ba//chos rgyal chen po bde ldan rnamargyal bzhugs//

213dga' bde skyed pa'i gru len kyu ru ru//chos rgyal chen po de yi bka' drin yin//mnga' 'bangs skyong la drin can phabs lhag/bgrod pa'i rta mgyogs 'dzengs spyod lha dang mnyam/ / sras po sras mo ya rabs spyod ldan gnyis//dkon mchog chos la mos pa'i dad can gnyis//sbyin pa'i bdag po dad ldan 'di gnyis kyis//zas kyi snying po longs spyod rgyas pa'i mchog/gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i pho brang na//srid bzhi'i bdag po sgyu ma'i rol rtsed mkhan//ngag dbang bsnan pa'i nyi ma chos kyi rje/‘/dka' brgyud rgya mtsho'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo / /yul la g.yang chags dbyi gu khri khang na//stong nyid snying rje'i rba rlabs rab g.yo ba//byang sems ldan pa zhig ma 'dzom me bzhugs//chos rdelan chen po 'byor ra rgya mtsho bzhugs//

214ta ru zagasnar rdo su lnga dang byams tsā byu sus ra bdun yod gabazheng bas sku bdugagasagomago'i rgya po 'ba' 'gan rnagargyal rgyas bzhings pa'i gas 'debs ngo ma'i 'dra bdus/stobyams pa'i sku gzugs phul byung bzhengs pa la//mthun rkyen sgrub par byed pa'i lus can rnams//rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i zhabs drung du//theg mchog chos kyi dpal la spyod par shog/nam zhig rdo rje gdan gyi ri 'i spor//byams mgon nyin byed dbang po shar ba'i tshe//bdag gi blo gros pazlo kha phye nas//skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs rnams tshim byed shog/de tshe rgyal ba byams pa rab tu dgyes//phyag g.yas bdag gi mashes la bzhag bzhin du//bla med byang chub mchog tu lung bstan nas//'gro kun don du sangs rgyas bstan thob shog/

215byang chub sgrub pa'i tshe rabs kun tu yang //dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi//rlabs chen skyong ba ji snyed mchis pa kun //gcig tu bstan nas tshul bzhin 'doms par shog/legs bzhad ri mo bkraba'i lung gi gos//rnam spyod gser gyi yul ba la brten cing //bslab gsum nor bu'i tog gis rab mdzes pa'i//bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur tshugs par shog/phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas//bstan 'dzin skyes bu thams cad sku khams bzang //lus can kun la bde skyed 'byung ba'i gnas//sangs rgyas bstan pa rtag tu rgyas gyur cig/rtag tu byams pa rnam gsum sgom pa'i mthus//bdud sde byams pa'i dpung gis 'joms pa dang //'gro kun byams pa'i stobs kyis skyong mdzad pa'i//rgyal ba byams pa mase(na po'i bkrashis shog/

216'di ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams dpag med las//dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro lha mi yis//las ngan byas len rtag tu spong byas nas//rgyal ba byams pa'i drung du skye bar shog/ched brjod 'di yang sku zhabs bsod nams phun tshogs kyis naX8lor bzhus pa'o//ba mgo mkhar du bzhugagayod pa'i bka' 'gyur gser yig ma'i ched brjod/gling bzhi'i mchog 'gyur lho'i 'dzom bu gling //la ba can rdzongs dam chos dar ba'i sa /yul la g.yang chags mar yul rgyas pa'i dbus//dpal 'byor bzang po'i na bun ches cher g.yo// longs spyod 'byin pa'i 'brug sgra ldi ri ri //skye dgu phan bde'i sbrang char mi smre li//

2/7rang re dga' ba'i lo tog so sor smon//snyan pa'i rnga chen nam kha'i stong nas brdungs//grags pa'i ba dan ri bo'i rtse nas g.yo//dpung tshogs drag po'i ngar skad 'u ru ru// dge bcu 'dzoms pa'i sgon bya di ri ri//dar rgyas skyed pa'i glu len kyu ru ru//dga' ldan lha yul gnas 'dir bkod pa 'dra//rtse mo gangs ri'i cod pan dari ldan zhing //rulab padma 'dab ma legs par bkra//de'i dbus na rgyal po'i pho brang mchog/rgyal chen rnam thos bu yi khang bzang la//'gran par bzod pa'i gle chen dpal mkhar dang //rgyal sa gastang sgang rab brtan lha rtse 'dir//chab srid skulangs la dbang bsgyur lha chen ni//mtho ris dpal 'byor skyed tshal legs 'ongs pa'i//pad dkar bye ba'i dbus na 'dab stong can//

218'dod yon bdud rtsi chags pa'i ze'u 'bru la//snyan grags dri ngad ldan pa'i mi dbang ni//stod kyi mgon gsumamang yul rje ru gyur//chos rgyal chen po seṅge rnam rgyal dang //sgrol ma'i rnamasprul skal bzang sgrol ma yis//rin chen gser las bka' 'gyur khyad 'phags bzhings//sku zhabs bsod nams phun tshogs kyis 2007 lor bzhus pa'o//khri rtsi dgon ba'i 'og baṇi'i ched brjod/rabya/ /tse(su se dha/ bla med ston pa sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /legs gsung dam pa gsung rab kun gyi mdzod/ /nyid kyi mchog rgyur dge 'dun kun gyi rtso/ /skyabs gsum ngo po bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ mo༈/ gartsig lhun grub rdo rje brag gi mkhar/ /dbyibs la ltas nas tshorol snags snang skyes/ /dgupon tho la reg pa'i ngo tshar can//bla ma'i gdan sa dpal ldan khre rtse 'dir/ /phu na chos skyong mgon po

2/9stag gzhon bzhugs/ /bar na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bzang po dang / /rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul mang byon la/ /bka' drin che ba'i byang sems phun sum la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pa'i phyag 'tshal lo// ga(/ chos 'khor dpal gyi dpal ldan khri rtse 'dir/ /byang sems thugs kyi sprul pa mkhan chen blo bzang dpal 'byor dang / /mkhan zur ngag dbang shel bzang gnyis snying gus yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshul khrims rnam dag blo dpon blo bzang mi rgyur dang / /blo dpon blo bzang thogs med gnyis la gus pas steng / /nor bu mdzod 'dzin phyag mdzod blo bzang bkris dang / /nang gnyer blo bzang tshul khriman/ stod// mee mos/ bī slob chos 'dzin thon mi rgyud 'dzin 'di/ /dge sgrong blo bzang dpal ldan dang / /dpon po ngag dbang tshe ring gnyis gyi sten//'di la zhal dke sku'ilag par grub//ma mo// bsags pa chos phyir stong ba ngo tshar che mi yi bze la lha'i dud rtsi sbyar/ /sten rnams 'di la dge si na khe sa chu'o zhin//lam 'gre chos la dga' bī chos tsho ma ma/ /byo mo zletsho bzang chos 'dzom/byo mo ngang rol ma/ byo mo/ byo mo blo bzang chos 'dzom/ byo mo ngang

220rjes dresadapa ces rjes dre(da )blo rjes dresari chesal/ ma rang sa 'a ma ma bzang la ma ma bzang dbang mo/ byo mo blo bzang kun 'dzom/ byo mo blo bzang chos 'dzom yang byo mo blo bzang chos 'dzom/ byo mo spra lug rnams g.yis sten 'di la zhab stog legs par grub/ yi ge 'du byed byil pa pon cung bsod rnams chos 'phel gyi lags bkratsaskashatsadapalatsa'abar sa 'jitsasgalatsargyan 'ju yan/ dge'o/ dge'o/ ge riched cirjod 'di khri rtser bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi g.yas phyogs ma ṇi /ma po zhig bzhugs yod la de'i steng na yod/ yi ge'i dag cha la bsgyur bcos byas med/dge byams gaphun tshogs kyis 2008 lor bzhus pa'o// khri rtse jo mo lha khang snang pa'i ldebs ris sku bris pa'i ched brjod/ran༅/ /oswa snyi sidha/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ khra ma'i gdan sa dpal ldan khrig rtse 'dir/ snyas bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa mdzes pa de/ /chos rje 'jim dbyangs rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rgyal po chen po gnya' khri btsan po nas/ /legs par rgyud pa'i rgyal rgyud dri ma med/ /chos rgyal chen po bkra shis (rnam rgyal )mgon la stod/ /mi

221rigs 'khungs tsun sams spon bzang rgyud/ /yon gyi bdag po nang ka rwardordo //// /sdirdo //bye/ lag tsho /༷/ ///na grub sa/ /sku na mā gnas stan sa nam la/ /sku na du rigs gsumamagon po dang / gsung gi sten du ma ṇi brgya rtsadang / /thugs kyi rten du byang chub mchod rten bzhengs/ /sags pa chos phyir gtong bar ro tshar che//dge byams pa phun tshogs kyis daX5 lor skus /tshe )rjod rtanaspe /rdo /rdo ba /du 111 ri bcomachan da ba da nga 'a nang du sa rgyal na pa ba sa ma na la bsnad sa bris 'dug de ltar na 1225 1350 bar yin dgos/ de dus rje tshong kha pa pod la stongs te med/ des na bkra shis rnam rgyal yin par nges/ khong 15༷༷ 15saX tsaganang dbang bsgyur pas jo mo lha khang yang de dus bzhengs pa tan tan du gyur pas/ bkra shis rnalargyal la bkramagon zhes bris par nges so// jo mo lha khang gi ldebs ris rnams ha yo gi spus dag dang ngo ma' babazhugs yo da/ sku kha shas kyi mas dang lha 'bri ba'i ming yang bris te'adug

222dngula'akhrig bragagi ched brjod/༄rsā༅/ /bla ma khyen no/ /rgyal 'bum lde yis tshe phi ma'i las 'de pas thong nas ni/ mul be pa la phyug tsher/ thog phud ra phyug ster pas pho chun pas phud tangs sa bab la bkrashis/ha nu kugar yung ba'i rgyal phag nga brag gi ched brjod/ra༅༅/ /o swa sdi/ chos rgyal chen po nyi ma rnam rgyal gyi sku dus su sa mo bya lo'i zla ba 4 pa'i tshes 1 la/ dge slong kun dga' tshe ring / mkhar dpon dkon chog tshe ring / bkra shis tshe ring / chos rgyam mtsho/ dga' 'phel/ 'gang 'byor/ 'di rnams kyis lam 'di bcos pa yin/ dge ba 'di yis mar gyur sems can kun rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur thob smon lam 'debs/ gakrashis/sa mo bya lo 1789sku zhabs bsod nams phun tshogs kyai da76 lor bzhus pa'o/ /

224bla'i swa sdi selha/ dgongs pa chos nyid nam kha' dbyangs pa la/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje nyi zla'i 'od 'phros nas/ /'gro kun blo'i ma rig mun pa sel/ /mdzod pa'i dkon mchog phrin las 'grub pyothams cad mkhyen ldan dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul gus phyags 'tshal/ nya khri btsan po'i gdung rgyud ma nyams pa'i lha sras phun tshogs rnamyal dbu yog sgo/ chabazhus )srid rgyas par shog 'angam zhing skyong ba'i bka' blon chen po tshul khrims rdo rje 1stod/ 'bu mthu 'dzom pa'i rgyal sa skyed bu bcan/ drag shos kun dga' blo gros/ drag shos tshe ring don ldan gnyis bstod/ bla ma ldan dang 'grol ma gnyis kyis/ a ma tshe ring khro le'i don la/ rigs gsum mgon po'i sku cig dang spuṇi rgya/ kun dga' 'byor skyed kyi don la ma ṇi rgya/ rgyal mtshan mjom pa'i don la ma ṇi rgya/ rgyal bskyed don la ma ṇi lnga bcu/ bstan pa 'byor gyi don la spyan ras gzig gi sku thang cig yang bskyed don la 'jim yang sku thang cig1 tshul khrims rdo rje su zhabs bkrashis rab rgyas kyis sngon rabs kun gsal me long nang mi dkyus ma zhig yin par bris te 'dug 'on kyang ched brjod 'di nas khong bka' thob yin par ra phrod 'dug khong chos rgyal phun tshogs rnam rgyal (175༷ 1760)skabs su'ang su'ang blon po yin par gsal/

225bu dkon mchog gis a ma mchog 'dzom gyi don la ma ṇi rgya bzhengs/tshe 'das 'di rnams kyi don la bzhings/ chog ldan rol ma'i don la ma ṇi lnga cu lnga brgyad zhengs/ bkris/'aXnisbyi('askyod swa sdi si bhrūṃ/ dgongs pa chos nyid nam mkha' yangs pa la// brtse ba'i thugs rje nyi zla'i 'o 'phros nas/ /'gro kun ma rig mun pa sel mdzad pa'i/ /dkon mchog phrin las don 'grub / dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul gus phyag 'tshal/ /nya khri btsan po'i gdung rgyud ma nyams pa'i/ /lha sras phun tshogs rnam rgyal dbu rmog tho/ /chabs srid rgyas par shog 'jagazhing skyong ba'i bka' blon chen po kun skyabs stod/dbyar rgun 'dzom pa'i rgyal sa skyed bu can/ /drag shos kun dga' blo gros drag shos tshe ring don ldan gnyis stod/ mkhar dpon gang phel stod/ a po mom thar dang khye pal mo gnyis la ma ṇi lnga bcu/ a po skyed phe le gnyis la ma ṇi lnga cu/ a ta phe le skyab dang a ta 'gang 'byor dang liṃmo dga' ra gsuyol maṇi rgya/ 'byor phe le dang phe le

tsho 226rgyam tsho dang sug ngar kham ba don grub dang / gang nga skyed tshe dang 'di rnams la ma ṇi rgya/ tshe ldan gang don grub dang tshang skyed dang / gar skyed/ 'dzogadang / gang nga rtan 'phel dang / 'bu lnga cho dang / tsha mo ngar/ tshe ring yang dzom/ 'di rnams kyi do na la ma ṇi rgya dang zhi bcu zhengs/ gang nga phe les 'di rnams kyi don la yin/ rang nge don la ma ṇi gnyis rgya zhengs/ 'di lag len gang brtan phel dang gang 'grub gnyis yin/ bkris/23niḥ('a skyed swa sdi si dha/ dgongs pa chos nyid nam mkha' dbyangs pa la/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje nyi zla'i 'od phros 'bri gung zho bstong pho brang dbyangs tse na/lha sras mu khri tsan po'i gdung rgyud ma nyams pa chos sku 'e1ngas sku sprul sku gsum/ 'jim yang phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/ /thugs rje kun la zigs pa'i thugs rje can/ /'jig rten gsum gon chos rje dzwa gling rgyan/ /thub pa khams gsuma'izil non bzhugs/ /chos dra chen po yang sa 'di sgar mchog /skyes bu stan pa dzin pa'i dgag bstan 'dzin

227phrin las rnamyal gus phyag 'tshal/ /gangs ri phyog si yang phyogs seng ge kha babs chu/ /la 'dags zhung gsum sa chen 81ngas la khyab/ dge :sproponab/ phe05/gle chen dpal mkhar pho brang rtse na/ /nya khri btsan po'i gdung rgyud gnyis pa lha sras tshe rtan rnamyal dbu rmog tho zhing chab srid sgyas par shoga'adza gling skyong ba'i bka' blon chen po nga dbang stod/ /'bru cud mdzom pa'i sa cha skyed bu can/ /yon gyi bdag po rab blob pa'i phag pa sdigs drin can pha ma rtso byas/ a po mes po/ a pi tsha bo tsha mo mi nor khor byas dang / 'gro ba rigs drug sems can thams cad dang / yang sgos bdag gis nyes pa sdig pa srang 'i1ga bre 'tshog las ngan nyes pa ci byas thad kyang 'dag phyir du/ /bdo la bur ton yi ge drug ma stong bzhi dang drug cu bzhings ma ṇi 'di la zhabs stogs 'phul mi dang / 'bri tsog byed mi thams cad phyi ma spyan ras zigs dang mjal bar shog/ bkris dge legs/gong gi ched brjod 'di skyur bu can nub byang phyogs kha che thang gi yar 'go'i ltag par phred zheg ((sdong rdo rong )na yod pa'i ma ṇi'i khar bris 'dug ched brjod gsum 'dug/ rdo la ji ltar brkos yod pa ltar dag cha sogs gang yang ma bcos par bsod nams phun tshogs kyis zhi da da008 nyin bzhus pa'o/ ༈

228bye 4 ga 'i ched brjod/ti se ma pang mtsho las nub kyi sa/ /ma yul gzhung gi lte ba rdo rje gdan/ /chu chen seṅge kha 'bab 'brug pa'i g.yas phyogs na/ /chos rgyal mar yul dbus gzhung rnams 'dir/ /e ma ho/ zas gtsang sras kyai gdung rgyud legs 'dzin pa'i/ /'khor 'dzis bsgyur rgyal mtshungs med mi dbang mchog /chos rgyal chen po bde ldan rnams rgyal bstod/ /rgyal sras sde legs rnamyal bstod/ /sgrol ma'i rnam sprul kun 'dzom rgyal 31 bzhugs//e ma ho/ gling chen bzhi yis bteg pa'i pho bung du/ /khyed kyi chab srid bzang po'i mnga' 'og tu/ /bde skyed 'dzom pa'i skyed yul skyur bu can/ /de 'dra'i chab srid bzang po'i mnga' 'og na/ /las 'bras chos la dkar ba'i btad pa can/ /yon gyi bdag po kun dga' don grub kyi a ma mgar mo/ yi ton du ma ḍo stong tshar gnyis zhangs/ a ta gang dga' phel gyi don du tshe dpag med kyai phyi med rdzas dkris rtsagasum dang ton mang du bzhangs/ brtan pa don grub kyai don du rdo rje mchod pa

229bzhangs/ /thugs kyi rten du dung brten bzhangs/ bu'i ma chog 'gyur dga' don grub kun ga brtan lapen don grub no mo nor 'dzom skyed kyi yon gyi bdag mo tshe ring bu 'khrid rnams gnyis kyi mi'i zas la lha'i bdud rtsis skyabs mchi gnas zhal du drang ba ngo mtshar che/ yon mchod rtso bcas 'gro drug sems can rnams bde ba can du skye bar shog/blosagrwa'i mdun thang la yod pa'i maṇi'i ched brjod/ sā snyi si dha/ ston pa mnyam med kun mkhyen shākya'i gtso/ /dran pas tshe yi mchog stsol tshe dpag med/ /dug gsum nad sel sman pa'i rgyal po ste/ /sku gsum lhun grub rnams la phyag 'tshal pho/ /ngag la dbang ba'i legs bshad bdud rtsi ster/ /bskal pa bzang po'i bum pa glusapa las/ /gdul bya rgya mtsho'i dpal du lhun chags pa'i/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug zhabs pad brtan gyur cig

230kye lags/ gling bzhi'i mchog gyur sgo'i 'dzam bu gling / /seng ge kha 'bab 'brug pa'i g.yas phyogs su/ /mthong ngagamadzes pa'i skumakhar mtho la rtsan/ /chos rgyal pho brang rgyal sa gting sgang 'dir/ /yulal dge bcu 'dzom pa'i rgyal sa skyur bu can 'dir/ /nya khri btsano po zhes bya'i sa bdag byung / /de las rim bzhin rgyud pa'i rgyal po ni/ /chos rgyal chen po seṅge rnagargyal bzhugs/ /dar zhing chab srid rgyas par shog/lha sras bde ldan rnam rgyal/ in gra bo lha/ sras mo nor 'dzin rgyal mo bzhugs/ gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i rnam sprul rab tu mdzes/ sgrol ma'i rnam 'phrul bskal bzang rgyal mo gnyis/ sras dang longs spyod chab srid rgyas par shog/kye lags/ rje'i bka' bzhin 'grub pa'i blon chen ni/ /bstan 'dra (dgra)'dul zhing sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrungs/ /chos blon chen po gagu mgar mo bstod//

231kye lags/ de 'dra'i chab srid bzang po'i mnga' 'og na/ /las 'bras chos la dkar ba'i dad pa can/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po dpal 'bor bskyab pa dang / /sbyin pa'i bdag mo lu lu yis/ /dro gsal dgo snang che bas snying rtse 'bral mi phod/ /snying lartse ba'i mi dga' dgu 'dzomade bsam zhing yid la bdud kyis dran/ /dran pa'i rten du gsung mchog khyad par can/ /mchog tu gyur ba ma ṇi stong tshar bzhangs/ /ri po ta lar skye bar shog bu mo'i mchog gyur mi 'ga' 'dzom dang / dpal 'byor skyed dang / 'dzom skyed dang / /pham bzhin du chos la dkar bar shog zho co no bkrashis dang / khye gu bkrashis dang / yul mi gnyen drung rnams kyis maṇi 'di la zhabags tog byed pa rnams bde ba can du mjal bar shelag bkra shis/(bsod nams phun tshog a phyi na thang pas daXn spyi zla 2 tshes 6 nyin bzhus/ gong gi ched brjod rnams ji ltar rdo ba la brkos yod/ de nyid la dag cha sogs nor bcos gang yang ma byas par rang sor ba'ag skuld pas/ mkhas pa rnams kyis brtags nas 'tsho ba len par mdzod/)

232rtsa/the' ba sri /spro'i 1(rga bka' 'gyur ga ra sa da ba da/rin chen rdul brtsegs ri rab lhun po dang //rnam pa kun tu mtshungs ldan ba sgo bde chen rtse//tshogs gnyis la stings rgyal po 'ba' 'gan 'di////glo /// /// ————gas ba bu bran rnams dpal du 'khrungs//'ba' 'gan phyogs las rnam rgyal rtag tu rgyal gyur cig/rgyal po de sras srid grub rgyal po bzhin//dpal rtsal kun la yongs su grags pa 'di//lha dbang rnam rgyal rtag tu rgyal gyur cig/bkra shis dpal gyi 'byung ga nas rgya mtsho gter//nor bu'i dpung ( ltar )pharol sde las rgyal//bkra shis rnam rgyal rtag tu rgyal gyur cig/bdud bzhi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba dang //

233mthu stobs nu bo phyag na rdo rje bzhin// rnam rgyal grags partag tu rgyal gyur cig/(rab mdzes rgyal mo/ blo gros rgyal po/)ba mgor gser yig bka' 'gyur pod 86 dang / gzhan gser yig pod 51 bsdoms pod/ 1 za bzhugs 'dug 39 mu 2005 nin bka' 'gyur sogs phyogs sgrig byed skabs lta bar 'gro dus gus 'arngagadabyangs rgyal mtshan gyis ched brjod rgyas pa'adug pas bdag gis rgyal po 'ba' 'gan dang khong gi sras gsum gyi mtshan yodapa'i tshigs bcad kun zur du phyung nas bzhus pa yin/ ba yu mkhar gyi brag la brkos yod pa'i ched brjod ni/mthing brang gzhung las 'khrungs pa'i mdo gcod khyung gi rtse//'bri shor 'bum dugs khyung sras stag gi tshang //rlabs can nyid kyis bzo bgyis dper legs te//yun du mi gyur g.yung drung brtan pa'i mkhar 'di rgyal bar stsog pa'o//(ched brjod 'di brda rnying yin pas ṅka go rgyu khag po 'dug bstag par 'tshal )dge thub bstan dpal ldan gyis bzhus pa yin no//

234shel rdo rje chena'abe lhatang gi mdun du rdo'ikhar sgri yodaba'i ched brjod/shelagrihāsanapomakharadaponagrongadaponabacasarganapagazhonapabaramagasumarnamasalaspringasapa/ shelaphobrangagirgyastaga'abumasteracan/ lhakhangachenamo/bongazematshunagyimatshamasanangabazhugasasungangapangurapachubyalasogasasrogachagasazhogathogasakyirigasarnamasatharapaglingadumatharalaganangabayinacing/khyadaparadungangapa'aditshogacigagirtagasagazhibazangangan(ba)rtagatukhagacheyina'aduganas/ chosarbadangapo sa'adinasabazungasunasamirtsiba'ilasabyasapabyungatshe/thubachenadurgyamachodadangadarachen/grongadugaserasrangagangarertsisathogasamedagatsanga'abulanusanasaslarayangabaka'agogagisabartanatshiga'adidonalajisridabaskalapa'ibaraganasadagosayin/ shingabyi bdangapo'itshesanamagangalabris/mchan sheng snyi no me na yin/dge ngag dbang sbyin pa shel gyis rdo la ji ltar brkos yod paltar gzhir bzhag nas bzhus pa yin/ched brjod 'di la tsheg gcig kyang mi 'dug pas zab zab mthad nas klog dgos pa yin no//

235/pabaka' shog khagan/sa rgyasatshedaporadon gug gargyal gyi tog pa'o gag cigaba'i mas po bcad namamabagan 'dzin pha gnang ba'i bka' shog gi 'dra bzhus/rtoga'o gagacig pa'ijiga' shog 'bring po/༈ yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi khyon la stobs shugs gser gyi 'khor los sgyur ba mi dbang chos kyi rgyal po rdo rje tshe dpal mi 'gyur don grub rnam par rgyal (197041838 )ba'i sde'i bka'//rang zhabs su gtogs pa'i skye rgu mchog dman bar gsum spyi dang / bye brag tog gi mkhar dpon/ blon po/ gnyer pa/ grong dpon/do ga che/ chibs dpon/ mdor na bya ba zhi drag gi don la mngags slebs kyi sku tshab las kyi sne mor gtogs so cog la springs pa/ ga ga rgyal po tshe bstan rnam rgyal rdo rje mi 'gyur dbang gi sde zhes pa de nyid mtshan gyi snyan pa snelang khams su grags pa des/ thulas bskyed smon lam

236gyis mtshams sbyor bzang po'i mkhyen sgo yangs por phye ste/ rang cag mtha' mtshams kla kle'i yul dang nye 'dabs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang / de 'dzin gyi skyes chabu dam pa rnams sku tshe ring zhing 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'od 'phreng phyogs brgyar spyo zhing 'phags tshogs 'dus sde ris su ma chad pa rnams kyi mdzad pa mdo bsngags lung dang mthun par spyod cing / rdzongs 'dir mi'i dbang po rim byon sku ngo steng zhal rim byon sku 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku yi nyer 'tshes bral nas sku bsod mnga' thang gdung 'dzin sogs zla ba yar ngo ltar 'phel zhing mdzad pa chos ldan gyi skye 'gro rnams bde ldan du skyong ba dang / gnas skabs su'ang 'dzam gling ya ngas pa'i ljongs 'dir phyi nang khrug rtsod ngan pa'i bskal pa zlog cing / bde skyed dge mtshan phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal la longs spyod pa dang / mar gyur nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rigs drug sems can thams cad mthong thos reg rnams rnam pa thams bcad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i ched du/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rten rnam gnyis dang / rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus pa'i thugs rje'i phung po gcig tu 'dus pa'i bod kha ba can pa'i

237lha skal 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i yang snying 'bum ther rtse mo'i grangs ldan gyi man thang ring mo gsar bzhengs mdzad skabs/ 'o ma gcig pa g.yul rgyal bsod nams bstan 'dzin 'di pas 'phags yul gyi la 'i yig drug phul du phyin pa bri ba dang yig bris pa dang / rdor brkos pa rnams kyi zhus dag 'go par bsgos bzhag mdzod 'dug pa/ kho pas mi dbang dam pa'i bka' spyi bor bcings te 'phags yul gyi lanyatsha'i yig legs ngo mtshar phul byung bris pa dang / bris rkos zhu dasgo sogs skyon gyis ma gos pa 'gran zla bral ba byung 'dug pa 'di bzhin bskal pa'i bar la dwags sa dbang dam pa rnams kyi mtshan don la sman pa'i zhabs 'digs go chod don 'pher byung 'dug pa'i bdag rkyen du tog nas zhing khang stsal pa'i bka' shog dgongs don la gnas 'jags dgos pa'i ched du/ mi'i dbang po bdag nyid chen pos kyang bka' thog rgyab snon bka' drin bskyangs pa yin pas/ rgyal thabs kyai 'bas 'degs zhi drag che phra grub pa spyi dang mi 'dra bas/ 'di ni bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i thabs lam zab mo'i zhabs 'degs khungs ldan grub 'dug pa mig can yongs kyi mthong lam du bstar ba ltar grub pa'i 'khyud la

238brten/ gur phug na bstan 'dzin phun tshogs la yod shulagyi mkhar gyi zhing gnyis dang / khang sa/ rdzing gog 'og gi zhing ma bu gnyis/bstan 'dzin phun tshogs shul gyi khang sa/ tog gzham nas ril mang kra 'u grelang 'og gnyis/ thang khob na tho 'dzig ye shes kyi spyas (shas )mal the ba son khal sugacu'i sa bcas dang / rum 'bag nas lo ltar rong shing bong sgal bcu 'khyong chog pa bcas 'o ma gcig pa bsod nams bstan 'dzin gyi bu rgyud bcas bskal pa ji srid kyi bar tu gnas 'jigs su bka' drin bskyangs shing / khong rang rgyud bcas tog mkhar gyi gnyer pa gtso po byed pa gagatogs khral rigs/ dbus mon kha che khral bsos sdud/ rtsaglongs/ shing stongs/ rtswa bangs gdung 'dren/ mkhar las/bong phad/ sha lhas ring thung / dmag 'gro/ bang chen sogs mdor na khrul rigs su gyur pa spu tsam yang skal ('gel )mi chog pa/ khyedad gong khod kyi sne mo ba nas char pa chu grogs kyis phan grogs byed pa ma gtogs nod 'tshe bsam sbyor ngan pa su'i thad na byas kyang khrims kyi rjes gnon lus srog longs spyod kyi sgog gtong bar ma zad/ 7rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang ba na pa rin po che'i srung ma'i gtso bo dpal mgon phyag
byeshe /tsha/— ——

240mi dbang gaskyong tshe dbang rnabargya gyi ma: mkhar gzhung gabakod nams g.yang 'byor la sulapa'i bka' yig gos chen khar bris yod pa'i 'dra bdus ngo ma/ra༅༅/ /mtha' bzhis rnam par gnon pa sa skyong mi'i dbang po tshe dbang rnam par rgyal ba'i bka'/rang zhabs su gtogs pa'i ser skya spyi dang bye brag ba mgo dang /khyad par a lci gsal po la bcas kyi mkhar dpon / blon po/ grong dpon/ do ga che/ zhal skyin/ chibs dpon bcas la springs pa/ a lha rgyal mo/ chos gyi rgyal po'i gdung dri ma med pa'i gsung las/bka' blon kun dga' phun tshogs/ bka' blon tshul khrims rdo rje'i skabs snyanalamaduyodapa dngosakyirshatswarngo pa bsodanams g.yang 'byor mkhar gzhung du zhabs tog rgya cher yod pa thugs la bcag ste/bka' blon gnyis nas sgo (mgo )gus phyag phul byung ba/ gnyer pa bsod nam sa g.yang 'byor mes po'i zhabs sdegs ('degs )tshad bral du gyur pa de sngon mes chen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal skar rdor phebs skabs su/ bsod nams g.yang 'byor gyis mes po rgya rgyar gyi lus
