241srog la ma bltos par mawo nyin g.yel med du zhabs tog phul nas gdung khye srung zhing khyad par sku gzugs la gnod pa med par la dwags su phebs pyodang / mes chen lngom dbyang rnam rgyal mchog gi khyed rgya rgyar gi rgyud 'dzin la/ a lci 'dog bur thugs la brtags pa yin/de min rang gi mnga' 'og nas blon po che gras kyai sa zhing / sa khang de yang mi dgos zhus nas/ sa gzhi che ba khral med 0da med cig gar med stsal ba yin gsungs nas bka' nan cher mdzad nas/ bka' ma bcags par/ mang rgyu nas brag rong sa gzhi/ sa khang sogs bsal (stsal)spu'adi thog khral spu tsam mi 'bab pa'i a lci mkhar smad pa'i sa gzhi'i thog tu sa bsnan ma bka' drin bskyangs/ phyi ru 'gro ba'i dud pa/nang du zhugs pa'i rlung po ma gtogs khral rigs skad cig i yang mi phog pa dang / de rjes bde ldan rnalargyal gyi skuthogal gnyer the thores //glo //// //rdo /gri////// 1re/ mu rib da nams dpal 'a ra la dmag ngas la yang 'a da sa pa' phyag rgya sdon rjes mang du gnang 'dug cing / de skabs sgo stsal gyi thog nas zhabs tog ched gong nas bka' phebs mdzad kyang / zhabs bsdegs ('degs)la dmag spyad gra grig byas/ de dus rgyal blon sku

242bsod la rang phyogs la rgyal kha thob padang dbyi dgu'i mkhar du gnyer las la yod pa'i skabs/ sog dmag mkhar la sgor dus/ dbyi dgu mkhar dpon shor bros byas kyang / dbyi dgu'i dmag gnyer bsod nams g.yang 'byor pas kha 'og tu 'khril nas/ sog dmag rnams la phar rgol bas mkhar ma bcag phyag rdzas gsang 'bru gcig thu shor med par gong zhabs kyi phyag tu phul/ bde ldan rnam rgyal yab sras nas/zhabs gtogs byung bas mig gang 'dod gtang chog pas/ sems 'dod ltar zhu dgos phebs kyang / sngon yasames 7gong mas stsal pa'i zhing khang gang yod las de 'phros thob mi dgos zhus shing / sngar yod rnams la dmag khrul 'thud ci yang med pa/ gong ltar bzhin da lta yang thugs rje gzigs yod/ zhabs 'og nas mi 'dor ba mag nyis thebs sum thebs dang / nyi lde chu thung sgo re bzhi btags tshad 'gro yang / de yang rgyud 'dzin rnams nas 'gro mi dgos pa thugs la btags pa yin/a lci mkhar smad gnyer pa las byed pa tsho nas zhabs gtogs phul pa'i lag rtags gcig kyang mi 'dug pa/ sa khyad rnams kyang rka gdang / sa stong tha rengs phyi rgyar la 'gro nges yod pal/ lha lcagabu khrid dbang mo

243mchog gi gnyer pabasod nams g.yang 'byor la/ 6rtolci gnyer las kyi bka' stsal mdzad pas/ gnyer rnying nags bon bre gang dang / zhib zan sgye cig sprod pa byung ba/ lha lcam chos kyi rgyal mo'i sku'i 'od zer la brten nas spyir rgyal khams su chad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi zhing / bde skyed dpal la spyod pa'i lo phyugs legs pas/ 'bad med lhun du grusapar asmyolci mkhar du 'bru lcags ('bo )khal snelang phrag lnga bzhag pa dang /la mdo dang / gser khung yur ba gsar bton las grub cing / 'tshem grub gos thang rnams gsar bzhengs gnang skabs/ dgos che'i mthun rkyen bka' gnang mthag 'bul du byung ba dang / 7'brug pa rin po che phebs skabs/ 7skyabs mgon 'khor bcas chibs dre dang bcas par 'don thang mkhar gzhung gsong ba'i stabs/ a lci gnyer pa bsod nams g.yang 'byor nas/ gdan bzhugs ring chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' la brten/ dpon 'khor stos bcas rnams la gsol phogs 'don thang tshang ma rgyas par phul ba'i thugs mnyes pa'i zhabs tog grub/ gzhan yang yigabī rgyal mo nas tog gzima'ichung bzhengs skabs tog mkhar zhig gsos rgya cher dgos par ston khul a lci nas zhib zan bsgrigs/ri

244tog mkhar sngar las sra thang bzos/ gzhan yang u rgyan nas (gyis ) phyag rdzas mang po stong bcug pas/ gsol ja sku chas gang ci thu ba'i skabs/ bsod nams g.yang 'byor nas 'bru khal stong phrag gsum phyag mdzod la phan pa'i zhabs tog dang / a lci ru gser zangs kyi byams pa'i sku legs par grub 'dug pas/ tshapo sa skyong bdag nyid la a lha rgyal mos ji ltar snyan lam du yang yang gsungs nas bka' drin 'khor med chos kyai rje btsun a sgo dang mes chen nyi ma'i mdzad bzang dus kyi bskal pa ya 'og ltar gyur pa kun gyi shes gsal ltar/ zhabs 'og pa bsod nams g.yang 'byor phabu nas lhag bsam rnam par dag pa mkhar gzhung thams cad la/ phyi nang gi byed sgo zhabs gtogs (tog ) 'khyud can gong sgos ji bzhin mig mthong gzugs su grub yod cing /kho'i rgyud 'dis rim 'byung rnams la/ a lci dmag rnams nas skyed sdug byed mtshams su kha 'dri byed sar lag stong du min pa yong dgos/gzhung gral gyi nang du dkar chol skyems/ sdod gas chag med pa'i phud thob dgos gtsobo yin/ gsal po (sa spro )la nas 'chun phun bu gcig dpal ldan bkris ma stong pa kho rang skabs mkhar gyi tshal srung ba
—byeg tham/
phyaganya/

247rgyal po tshe brtan rnagargyasagyis 'o gcigabasad nams ba na 'dzin dzeesnal ba'i bkang shog/༄༄/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon la stobs shugs gser gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba bstan 'dzin chos kyai rgyal po tshe brtan rnalargyal rdo rje mi 'gyur dbang gi sde'i bka'/ rang zhabs su gtogs pa'i skye rgu ser skya mchog dman spyi dang /bye brag tog gi mkhar dpon/ blon po/ gnyer pa/ grong dpon/ do ga che/ chibs dpon/ bya ba zhi drag gi don la mngags pa'i sku tshab/las kyi sne mor rtogs (gtogs )so cog la springs pa/ mi'i dbang por 'bod pa bdag gi lhag bsam kun nas blangs te/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi mchod sdong phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i thugs rten rnam gnyis dang / 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi yang snying yi ge drug ma 'bum ther rtse mo'i grangs ldan sgrub pa'i skabs su 'o ma gcig pa bse da nams bstan 'dzin 'di pas 'phags yu la gyi yi ge lañtsa'i yig drug bri ba dang / yig bris pa dang / rdo bsgos pa bcas kyi

248zhus dag bsgo bzhag byas par/ kho pas kyang 7mi dbang gi bka' spyi bor bcings te/ rgya gar gyi yi ge bri ba dang / zhus dag sogs 'gran zla bral ba 'di gar dgongs par 'byor ba'i bstan don gyi zhabs 'degs khungs ldan grubapa'i khyud la brten tog gzham nas rin mang zer ba sa stongs mkhar gyi sa khungs yin pa'i 'phros pa'i rin mang zer ba'i kra ku gong 'og gnyis bsod nams bstan 'dzin gyi bu brgyud bcas par khang sar bka' drin bskyangs pa yin pa'i gong 'khod kyi las sder rtogs (gtogs )rigs drag zhan mtha' dag nas char pa chu grogs kyi phan grogs byed pa las/ gnod 'tshe bsam snreXr ngan pa'i khral rigs 'gel ba dang / sargyud du snyan pa'i gling ngan su'i thad byas pa shar tshe byed pa po'i lus steng du khrims kyi rjes gnon gtong nges yin pas / de ltar mi dgos pa'i phya rgya'i 'bru don tshad mar bzung ba'i bskal pa ji srid bar khral rigs su gyur pa spu tsarma yang med pa bde bar gnas bcug pa gal che che/ lcags sprel zla 6 yar tshes mchog tu dge bar/ pho brang srel mkhar rtse nas bris/ chu gang khel sa mtha' son

250tog pa 'o ma cig pa ma ṇi bris sgrub sogs kyi zhabs legs lhag bsacas bsgrubs pa'i gnang sbyin 'bar lig tu tog mkhar gyi thab kha'i zhing thog na son khal bco lnga'i sa dang / 'thor zhing son khal gsumagyi sa/yang ril mang gi stongs zhing thog na khang sa zhig dang / tha khob na 'ol btagargyur sa yan zhig bcas thugs la btags yod kyang da cha 7mi rje rgyal blon lhan rgyas nas mkhar don yul don du dgongs nas rgan gsum tshang 'gril rnams nas gsung gros byed dgos kyai bka' gnang bzhin/yul khag so se'i 'go yod las 'dzin dang / la dwags stod gzham gyi rgan dmangs rnams gsung gros gcig bsdun thog sngar phan stong zhing so rigs rnams gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa'i skabs 'dir tog mkhar thab kha'i thog na 'o ma cig pa la gnang ba'i zhing dang 'thor zhing de phyir log tu bsnams nas/ gong gsal ril mang gi khang sa dang / 'ol btab rgyu'i sa yan steng du ma he'i stong zhing tshang ba sa bsnan byas 'o gcig pa rang gi bu tshodon grub tshe ring nas tog gnyer g.yog gi zhabs gtogs 'i gcig po phul dgos pa dang / gzhan gnyer g.yog rnams dang mtshungs pa'i khrul rigs ci yang skad mi mchog pa yin pa'i
phyag4/

253blon po/ nang so/ gnyer pa/ grong dpon/ do ga che/ zhal skyinasku tshab sogs las kyi sne 31ra gtogs pa thams cad la springs pa/ gnyer pa bsod nams g.yang 'byor nas/ lar mdo dang / gser khungs su dpya zhing gsar 'dzugs byas pa'i zhabs tog khungs ldan gyi khyud la/sa spo la sa chun chung bkris dpal byor stongs pa'i mal/ sa spo la dang lar mdo gnyis nas gang sku1da kyi sa gzhi gnas khang / nyos zhing rigs tshang ma dang / rta 'ul phyed kha/ hor khral/ sgal mo che'i 'dza' ra bcas thugs rje gtsang gzigs su a bi rgyal mo'i bka' shog nang don bzhin dang / de rjes ngos rang khrir 'khod skabs kyi bka' shog de rjes bag rin bu lon skor la gser srang bzhi'i 'ba' chad yod don/ de rjes blon drag sde mangs lag bskor gyi chod rgya song don la ji srid par me 'gyur ba'i phyag tham gnang grub pa bzhin/ da phan kyang bsod nams g.yang 'byor rgyud bcas la ji srid bskal pa'i bar 'gyur med gnas 'jigs da'adzis rgyur mtho dman phyogs gtogs su nas kyang brjod gleng snyad btags spu tsarma yang byed sa med pa'i rgyab gnon 'di bzhin byin pa yin pas 'dzol med bde bar gnas bcug pa gal che che/ nges med
snyeg tham/

255(gan rgya/)1949 sa glang zla tshes la/༄2༅/ /phan bde 'byung gnas lugs gnyis gong ma 7khrims bdag rin po che zhabs drung du/nub/ming rtags gzham gsal rnams nas :( slang mi 'gyur ba'i gan rgya mtha' gtsang 'bul snying / don rtsamanga' ris bskor gsumanang tshan la dwags su/ rgyal po mgon gsum las nye bar chad pa'i chos rgyal gdung rigs dri ma med pa byung tshun/ sa dge (bka')rnying gsum gyi (bzhi'i)dgon khagaso sor mchod gzhi rang dbang gi bka' shog rgya non bcas yod bzhin/ bar skabs gser dkar mnga' khongs su song yang / gzhung zhabs gser dkar chen po'i thugs gzigs ma pham sogs gang spyir tshad med gnang na'ang / da lam lnga bdo'i las dbang tshab po che'i rkyen gyis dmag zing che ba dang gzad/ gser dkar gyi las khungs su gtogs pa'i phyi nang gi mi ngan kha shas nas don med

256khrims 'gal gyi phyi'i sa gzhi dang / dge 'dun rgan gzhon su la'ang don med kha chos bshad 'dod kyis nyes bcod (brnyas bcos )mang tsarma byed mus/ da skabs 7skyabs rje rgyal sras ba ku la mchog nas hin bstan zas skyong (paṇḍata zhed ru)chen por bka' mol thog bstan spyi dbu 'dren mdzad mus dang / rjes su yang ci srid par dgon khag su yi sprul sku bstan spyi lhag bsam 'tsho skyong 'pher ba'i rgan rabs bzhugs nas dbu 'dren mdzad rgyu dang / da nas phyin dgon khag thams cad nas bstan spyi don du thugs sems gcig 'dril gyis dgon che chung su la za 'dod snyad 'tsher byed nas 'os min byid tshe gzhung du snyan zhu 'bul dgos 'byung phyin grwa tshang thams cadalhan 'dzoms thog 'bul rgyu dang grwa tshang so sor lab gleng 'byung tshe rang dgon gyi bla mdzod/ dbu chos nas nang khrims mdzod nas 'grig min 'byung tshe lhan 'dzoms na/ ris med kyai thugs shags mdzad rgyu dang / da nas phyin zla ngo re bzhin tshogs 'dus mdzad nas bstan spyi ris med las don mdzad rgyu yin pa'i/ 'di las mi 'gal/ gal srid de dus de min/ ma sel ma mthong / nga min/kho min/ ri bskul/ mtsho skyogadapon ltag khur sngar med gsar ba zo/

258no tshogachen po rin chen bang po'i rnamathar dgaldan dge 'a zhes gagabazhugags//rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos rnams//legs sbyar skad nas gangs ljongs chos skad du//rab tu sgyur mkhas ma hā lo sgo ba//rin chen bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal pho//zhes bsngags pa ltar lo tswa chen po rin chen bzang po ni/ sa pho rta'i lo la yab gzhon nu dbang phyug dang yum cog ro kun bzang shes brtan ma bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs/ rigs g.yu ri g.yu sgra/ de'i tshe yab yum gnyis rab tu dga' zhing / dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams yid mgu nas me tog gi sbrang char phab cing / bstan pa'i nyin byed dbang po shar ro/ /zhes phyogs kun tu sgra dbyangs kyi bsngags brjod bgyid cing shis pa legs par brjod do/ /dgung lo bcu pa'i skabs lha bla g.ye shes 'od kyi bka' bzhin 'dzin sbyor gyi 'gran sdur dang /

259dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa'i tshe mkhan po ye shes bzang po las rab tu byung / de'i mod la 'dul ba rgya cher 'grel thugs su chud/de yang lapagadab rtsa da las gangs can du ni rgyal po'i rigs//ye shes 'od ces bya ba 'byung / /zhes lung bstan pa ltar gyi lha bla g.ye shes 'od ces bya ba byung /rgyal po des dam pa'i chos kyai theg pa'i rimapa mtha' dag gzigs pas/sngags dang 〈rol tu phyin pa gnyis ches 'gal bar gzigs shing /lag len yang gsang sngags la brten na 'dul ba dang 'gal/ 'dul ba la brten na gsang sngags dang 'gal ba lta bur gzigs nas/ the tshom skyes te 'di gnyis gang rung chos yang dag pa yin la gcig ma yin dgongs/ gal te tshig 'gal yang don mi 'gal ba yin nam snyam nas/ the tshom bsal ba'i phyir mnga' ris skor gsum nas blo 'bring yan chad bos te/ de dag gi nang nas blo rab tu rno ba/ de yang lo bcu lon pa rnams bsags nas chos kyi tshig 'di tsam/ dus 'di tsam tshun la zungs shig ces bya ba la sogs pas blo brtags pas/ blo

260rab 'bring dgu'i yang rab bdun rnyed nas de rnams kyi tshigal blu ba byin te yi ge bslabs/ rab tu byung nas byis pa bdun po de la g.yog po re re dang / yang g.yog re re ste dpon g.yoganyer gcig byas nas kha che'i yul (bzhir)du chos 'tshol du btang / de rnams la yang rgyal pos kun dga' snying po'i chos 'tshol la shog ces dang / dgapa'i chos 'dul ba mtha' dag 'tshol la shog ces dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rnam pa gnyis kyai chos skor 'tshol la shog cig ces pa gsum bslabs/rgya gar shar phyogs kyi dzña rmā pā la spyan 'dren na gser la gartsegs shig gsungs/ rin bzang rgya gar du bskyod de panḍi ta yod dam med dris pas rnyed par ma gyur nas/ bi kram shī la'i gtsug lag khang du phyin nas paṇḍi ta rnams la bod la phan thogs pa'i paṇḍi ta yod dam zhes dris pas jo po yiltasta sha'i mtshan nas phyung ste 'di ni rgyal rigs las rab tu byung /nang pa sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa/ paṇḍi ta lnga brgya rnams kyi nang nas thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis par gyur pa zhig sku1da de/ khyed kyis spyan mi 'grongs/ de las gzhan bod la phan pa'i paṇḍi ta med gsungs/ der jo sgo rtsad chod nas bod du spyan 'dren pa'i zhu ba phul

261par rngo mthog sne/ slar bod du phoganasapho gab 'dis rgya gar gyi mkhas pa rnams kyai mdzad spyod dang bzhed pa rgyal po'i snyan du gsol/gang zag gi sbyangs pa'i khyad par dang / dbang po raba'abring gi bye brag dang / bsod nams che chung gi khyad par dang / sdod kyi gdul bya'i lagalen la dathe|ngas nas theg pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs payin/ don la ni 'gal rgagang yang med ces snyan du gsol/ bod la 3 thogs pa'i panḍi ta rgya gar shar nub gang nas kyang garnyed/ 'on kyang bi kram shrī la'i gtsug lag khang na rgyal rigs las rab tu byung ba/nang pa sangs rgyas pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa dpal mar me mdzad ye shes zhes bya ba dpal rdo rje gdan nas rgyal po mohā pā la zhes bya bas spyan drangs pa'i panḍi ta chen po zhig 'dug de spyan drang na bod la phan thogs par bi kram shī la'i pa'i ta rnams kyis lung bstan zhes rgyal po'i snyan du gsol pas/ rgyal po'i gsung rab kyi don la the tshom yang chod/ jo bo rje la yang dad pa skyes nas thugs shin du dgyes par gyur to/ /lo tstsha ba 'di nyid mkhyen pa shin tu che bas mdo sngags kyi chos mang po bod skad du bsgyur/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang rgyud kyi phyogs

262gnyis da'i gus pa rgya cher mdzad/ dbang bskur rjes gnang dang sgrubapa'i lag len mang du bstan te/ bsnan pa snga dar las phyi dar rgyas pabyung / sngags kyi bstan pa bod du dar ba yang phos ba 'di kho na'i bka' drin yin/ lo sab rin chen bzang pos panḍi ta bdun cu rtsalnga bsten nas dgapa'i chos mang du gsan/ sha chen po rgyal po lha sde btsan gyi dbu'i mchod gnas dang rdo rje slob dpon du bskur/ pu hrangs zherazhu gnas gzhi phul/ 'dzi rdzabs der gtsug lag khang yang bzhengs/ kha che'i yul gyi gtsug lag khang dang / rong dang lhar ma'i gtsug lag khang dang /cagalci'i gtsug lag khang la 31gas pa gnas gzhi dang gtsug lag khang mchod rten sogs mang du bzhengs/ khri rtsi'i lharaca' gtsugalag khang /'i (ba 'di dgung lo nga lnga'i skabs la dwags su phebs/ khri rtse'i nyar mar gtsug lag khang bzhengs par lha khang che chung brgyad/ lha khang che ba'i dkyus bzhengs gnyis la gom khru nyer lnga re/ lha khang gi

263rtsig bzhengs la lag khru gsum/ rtsig pa'i tho tshad la lag khru bcu gsum/ phyi lcags ri'i phyogs re la gom pa nyi brgya lnga bcu re/lcags ri'i rtsig zheng la lag khru phyed gnyis/ mtho tshad la lag khru brgyad lhag tsalayod/ mchod rten che chung bsdoms pa brgya phrag lhag tsam dang / de rnams kyi nang bzhugs su bde gshegs lnga pa dang / bde gshegs brgyad pyocan gyi satstsha dang / lañtsa'i sngags kyi yi ge can gyi sagro'i par sogs mang du bzhugs/ gnas der lo globa'i srung modapal ldan lha mo rdo rje chen mo bzhugs pas nyar ma'i rdo rje chen mo zhes kyang grags/ rjes su la dwags rgyal pos rdo rje chen mo shel du spyan drangs nas rgyal po'i srung gamadzad/ gnas de'i lho nub gnyis su rdo la 'bur du brkos pa'i rdo sku byin can mang du bzhugs/ skyed nar bla ma lo blo'i lha khang che chung lnga / de'i dus pho tstsha bas khri rtse'i mkhar yul dgon g.yod pa'i ri la gzigs nas/ gnas der tshul khrims dag pa'i lugs bzang dar bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ nyar ma'i dgon pa'i 'du khang chen po'i nang du dge 'dun stong phrag gcig dus gcig la tshogs tshogs thusapa yod pa dang / nang rten du/ ngan song sbyong ba kun rig

264rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs dang / rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sogs ha las pa yod kyang rkyen ngan zhigabyung nas med par gyur/ rgyal rabs dang lo rgyus sogs nas gang yang mi gsal/ gnas dang rdo sku de rnams la khri rtse'i dge 'dun rnams kyi zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i 'bum sgor skabs pho snar khrus gsol dang rab gnas zhis brjod mdzad bzhin mchis/ rjes su chu phogadang dmag 'khrug sogs rkyen ngan pa'i dbang gis lha khang gi sku dang 'tshogs bris kun zhig gral gdung sogs phal cher zhig brkugate khyer/ lhagalus phran tsam yod g.yang gzhan gyis 'khyer nas srung dka' bar gyur pa de rnams don med chud thos su gyur bar mthong nas/ la dwags rgyal po blo gros mchog ldan ( 144༷ 1470)gyi skabs/ chos rje 'jiyodabyangs rin chen gyis khri tshogs tshul khrims rnam dag gling gi gtsug lag khang ka ring drug dang ka thung zhe bzhi bcas bsdoms ka salnga bcu'i rgya khyon can dang / rung khang ka ba bzhi'i khyedan can bzhings skabs gral gdung lhag lus rnams bzhesapar mdzod/ 'du khang der zangs dkar sogs phyogs kun gyi dge 'dun rnams 'dus nas dbyar chos dang dgun chos chags med mdzod/ nyar

265thabazhengs nas lo bcu tsalasong ba'i rjes su lo tstsha bas zhing:'i gtsugalagakhang dang / rten gyi gtsobo kun rig mopar snang mthad phu du byung zhing ba bas ngoms pa med gzhig bzhengs par mdzod/ de nang bzhin gsumomada' 'og yodang mang rgyu ru'ang rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha khang ha lasal ngo mtshar gabazhengs par mdzod/ a lci rnam par snang mdzod lha khang gi 'khris su lo tstsha bas khong rang bsnams te phebs pa'i phyag bar de btsugs par mdzad pas tshugs/ da lta las lo bco lnga tsagasdon du rgyagaber btsugs yod pa de nyid lcang rgyal chen por gyur nas 'gyel/ de'i rjes gnasade nyid du shing sdong de'i rkang nas slar yang skyes de/ deng sang lcang sdong chen por gyur yod/ de lta bu'i lcang sdong la dwags kyai gzhan sa gnas gang du'ang med/ de'i rjes yul gzhan dang gzhan du yang gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa bcas mang du bzhengs te/ la dwags phyogs la lo (spu'adi nyid shin tu bka' drin che g.yin no/ /lo (ba 'di la gur shing brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i che(ba gomakhas grub mang po dang / zhu chen 'pher ba'i 'tsho tswayang bcu phrag lhatha/tsalathon/ 'phral gyi mdzad pa yang sku gzugs

266bzhings bdang / 'gyur mdzad pal sogs re re'i rjes kyang gzhal gyis mi dpog cing blor shong dka' ba dang / 'phags pa'angagadapalagyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa yang sa skṛta'i skad du 'bum phrag gcigabod skad du 'bugaphrag gcig gzhan la yon byin te 'bugaphragagacig rnams bton bcug par mdzad/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsalnga bzhes pa chu sta 1042 lo la jo bo dpal ldan liṃsta sha bod du phebs pyodang / pho tsā ba'i dgos pa la paṇḍi ta yon tan kho bo las che gdaka' med kyi lha bla mospyan drangs pas zhabs tog cig bya dgos snyam nas/ lo tsā b.rang gis bzhengs pa'i gnas mtho sding gi gtsug lag khang gsum brtsegs can du spyan drangs/ de na rgyud sde gong 'og gi lha rnams thog gi rigapa byas nas bris yod gde rnams la so sor bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa re mdzad yod cing / jo bo stan la bzhugs pa na rin bzang la pho sgo ba bstod pa de rnams sus mdzad ces dris pas/ jo bo de rnams kho po rang gis 'phral du bgyis ba lags gsungs pas/ 'e1 sab thugs 'jigs zhugagyis song / jo pos lo glo ba la khyed kyis chos ci 'dra mkhyen gsungs pas/ lo sgo garang gis mkhyen pa rags rim zhig zhus

267pas jo bo'i zhal nas/ khyed lta bu mkhas grub gnyis ldan bod na bzhugs nas snang bas/ kho bo bod du 'ong mi dgos par 'dugapa zhes gsungs nas thugs gar thal mo sbyar/ los lamakhyen pache bar gda' yi/ stan thog gcig tu rang gi rgyud thog nyams su len na ji ltar gyis gsungs pa la/ lo tsā bas rgyud sde so so nas byung ba bzhin lha so so'i sgrub thabs byed pa lags mod zhus pas/ dpe cha 'ga' zhig tu 'etsho tswa bas de ltar zhus pa la/ der jo bos lo tsā ba rul kho bo bod du 'ong dgos par 'dug gsungs nas gamanyes skad ces zer/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis tshul de ltar yin na/ lo sab ma rul jo bo rul zhes zer ro/ /de nas lo sabs gser srang bdun phul nas bde mchog rim pa gcig pa dang / rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs sogs gsang sngags kyi chos kyai gdams pa mang du zhus/ byin rlabs thob pa dang rtogs pa nyams bzang po skyes/ dpe cha dang mchod gnas ma gtogs pa ci yod jo bo la phul/ jo bo'i bde mchog dang rje btsun ma la thugs dam gyi mthil mdzad/ sngar bsgyur ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos mang po la nus dag mdzad/ jo bo nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dam tshig bsdus pa bsgyur pas 'gyur

268bzung ba cig byung / de la jo bo dgyes nas pho (byed dgos pa'i bka' ga nga bas/ pho (bas rang gi dbu bstan te/ mgo bo dkar po 'di bzhin du song bas kho bo sgrub pa rnam dag cig byed par nu ba phul pas/jo pos rin chen bzang po khyed sgrub pagazhang gcig byed na/ skye ba snga mophan chad kyai dge ba'i chos dpag tu med pa'i mthu ni yod/ dala'abyor gyi mi lus rin po che thogapar dka' gni thob/ sangs rgyas kyi ba na pa dang ni phrad/ de ston pa'i dge ba'ibazhis gnyen dang ni mjal/ sring pa'i nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me dang phrad pa'i skabs 'dir/ sems bya gangan pa mas kyis ma'igayengs par mdzod cig gsungs/ chen (bas de thugs la bzhag nas sgrub khang gi che la lcags gzer btab nas zhal zas skar khung lta bu zhig nas tshur blangs/phyi rol na sgo gsum rigadu yod pa la/ ༈ sgo'i ya thems phyi gal sgo 'di'i nang du tshe 'di'i rnam par rtog pa skad cig ma gcig skyes na ba na sgrung rnams kyis mgo bo khos bya ba dang / bar pa la rang don yid byed kyai tā( skad cig ma gcig skyes na bstan srung rnams kyi mgrel bo khos bya ba dang / nang ma la sgo 'di'i nang du tha mal gyi rnam rtog skad cig ma gcig

269skyes na bstan srung rnams kyis mgo po khos shig bya garnams bris nas jo pos ji ltar bstan pa ltar lo bcu'i bar du rtse gcig tu thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i sgrub pa mdzad pas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du gzigs shing / nyams rtogs khyad par can brnyes nas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ dgung lo dgu bcu rtsabargyad pa shing mo lug 1055 gi dgun zla tha chung gi tshes bcu bdun la mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan padang / de'i tshe nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyis rol mo rgya cher sgrog pa dang / me tog gi char 'bebs pa sogs skye bo thams cad kyi mngon sugadu gyur/ gdung rten ma byung bas mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du gzhegs par grags/ ring bsrel 'o ma se'i mdog lta bu gsum byung ba/ ji zhig na 'brug skad lta bu'i sgra dang bcas te nam mkhar song ngo / lo tsā ba 'di'i thugs dam gyi rten gsang ba 'dus pa gser zangs las grub pa khyud gang tsagadang / rgyun du gso sbyong sogs kyi skabs sku la bsnams pa'i rnam sbyar sogs nang rten byin can mtho lding du bzhugs pa rnams/ bod rgya dmar gyis btsan 'og tu byas rjes/ mtho

270lding gi dge 'dun rnams kyis spyan drangs nas/ da lta rgya gar rtso phyogs mon ko ṭi'i bod khyem lnga par gnas pa'i mtho sding gi dgon par mjal rgyu yod do//chen po'i rnam thar sa 'og chu yi gter//mngon gyur min yang dam galag 'gro yi// mthu las thigs pa tsuni/zhig bte|da pa yis//'gro rnams bla med dpal la myur gnas shog//ces pho sab rin chen bzang po'i rnamathar dad ldan dge 'phel zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ja pan pa go ya pa tha ga bogs lon ba chen po'i rnam thar zhig dgos zhes nan gyis bskul por khri dgon dka' chen blo bzang bzod pas/ sngon chad 'di'i rnam thar rgyas pa yomathong yang bka' gdams chos byung nang gi rnamathar la gzhi byas/ jo bo a'iti sha'i rnam thar gsum dang / bka' gdams glegs bama'isogs nas byung ba rnams bsdebs nas khri dgon gzims chung dpal yon kun 'khyel du rab 'byung bcu drug pa'i me 'brug 1976 lo'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin sug bris bgyis pa'i/ /dge legs 'phel/

27/mang spro'i rgyal rabs murtagagi chun po/mang spro'i yul dang mkhar/skyesasu / mang pos bkur ba'i gdung rgyud dri ma med//gnya' khri btsan se gas sto ṭa'i sa skyong gi/ /gdung rgyud skyed lde nyi ma mgon la sogs/ /byung ba'i chos rgyal mu stag phreng ltar mdzes/ /sa skyong chen po tshe dbang rab brtan gyis/ /rigs sras bstan srung g.yu la rgyal gang de yis//thog ma mang spyor pho brang legs par btab/ /de nas bzung ste gnyis stong bzhi bar gyi/ /rgyal rabs gsar pa mu tig chun po 'di/ /spel la spro 'o rin chen rnam gsumagyis/ / rtag tu bdag la rgyab dpung mgon mdzad de/ /bgyi ba mtha' ru 'khyol ba'i stong grogs mdzod/ /

272mang du tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i 'bras bu la//mang spro dga' ba'i skyed tshal yid 'ong du/ /mang mang rtagatu dga' bder rol payi/ /chos rgyal rigabyon lo rgyus spel la spros/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing brtsams pa dgabacari ba'i ngag sdon du btang nas gang gleng bar bya sa / la dwags kyi lte ba gli nas sgo'i phyogs su ska lo mi ṭar nyi shu rtsalnga bgrod pa na sngon mang yul la dwags kyai rgyal sa'i cha shas su gtogs pamang spyo zhes bya ba'i grong gseb nee nyid chags yod cing / de yang phu ru ragadakar gangs ri 'bras dkar spungs pa lta bu dang / mda' na seng chen kha 'bab dal 'gro mas rtag tu zhabs 'khrud pa dang / bar na 'bru sna sna tshogs 'dzoms pa'i zhing sa mang spyo bya ba yod la/ der dgon pa'i 'gragagyi ri gseb lam mo bya ba'i mgo ru sngar me tog mkhar zhes pa zhigayod kyang da lta ni sngon gyi mkhar gyi lha khang gi steng du yod pa'i lha rten tsam ma gtogs zhig ral tu gyur nas med pa dang / de nang bzhin mkhar de'i 'og tu mang spro'i grong rnams chags yod pani/ sngon gyi mkhar dang grong gi zhig shul dag

273nas gsal por rtogs zubabo/ /mkhar 'di dang brel ba'i sdon gyi gzhung glu zhing kyang sbal rta'i yul du yod par thos/nya mkhar de dang thag mi ring ba na mang spro'i dgon pa thub bstan sha gling chos 'khor zhes pa cadan chos 495 grags pa 'bucasalde'i (14༷༷ 1440)sku dus su bzhengs pa de bzhugs skuld/ de ni mkhas grulaganyis ldan bla ma drung pa rdo rje dpal bzang gis phyagabatab pa yin/ dgon pa'adir nang rten sku gsung thugs rten dang rong btsan dkar dmar zhes srung ma khyad par can gnyis bzhugs yod/ de gnyis kyang bla ma drung pa rdo rje dpal bzang gis khams kha ba dkar po nas gdan zhus/ de nas bzung da bar srung yode gnyis mang spro dgon gyi dus mchod nag rang skabs dngos su phebs sgol yod/mang zlo zhes pa'i sgra don sna/ spyir btang yul gyi ming mang spyo zhes pa ni mang ni mang po'i don dang spro zes pa ni dga' ba dang bde ba'i don yin/des na banas 'dir gnas pa'i mi rnams ni gzhan dang mi 'dra ba bsam pa bzang zhing rtag du dga' spro'i ngang gnas kyi yod pas/ ming de ltar zur rgyan dang por gzigs/

274'ogs/ de lta bu'i mang spro zhes pa'i yu'akha'adi ni yul stod phra la yul smad rgyas paphur pa'i dbyibs su chags yod/ yul de'i dkyil du sngar bzhings pa'i rgyal po'i pho brang mkhar chen po yod kyang nang du sdod mi sogs med pas nang stong gog por 'gyur bzhin yod/ 'on kyang mang spyo ru byung ba'i rgyal rabasa'achad bzhin yod/ zhing gshegs dam posaku la rin po che mchog gis la dwags pa kun nyam thag 'u thug nor dang shes sku1na med pa'i dus su ji ltar bskyabs/ la dwags su 1949nas daXd bar yon tan gyi sgron me ji ltar spar/ der ma zad sog yul dang rgya nag tu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji ltar spel par mdzad/ de bzhin du byang rtse chos rje 7skyabs rje sras rin po che thub bstan nyi ma ji ltar mang spro ru sku 'khrungs/ gzhon dus gang mdzod/ da lta byang rtse'i chos rje mdzad bzhin pa dang / ring min dga' ldan khri la ji ltar bzhengs rgyu yin/ de kun mkhar po che rang gis 'chad bzhin skuld/ de lta bu'i mkhar thog mar chos rgyal sus bzhings/ rgyal po ji lta bu byung sku1da/de dag gi sgor mdor bsdus shig gling na/

275de yang la dwags kyi rgyal po dang po ni chos rgyal skyed lde nyi ma mgon (975 1000)yin/ khong bod nas phebs te gu ge/ spu rang / la dwags bcas kyi rgyal por gyur te/ bkrashis rab rgyas kyis ((nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' ris skor gsum la dbang bsgyur nyidakhong la sras lha chen dpal gyi mgon/ bar pa bkrashis mgon/ chung ba lde gtsug mgon dang gsum byung / de gsumal bod kyi rgyal rabs rnams su ((stod kyi mgon gsum gnyi zhes grags/ phyis su skyed lde nyi ma mabe|na gyis sras gsum po la rgyal srid bcesas te stsal/ che ba dpal gyi mabe|na la mar yul la dwags gzhung 'khor/ bar pa bkrashis ma——na la gu ge dang spu rang / chung ba lde gtsug mgon la zangs dkar dang spyi sta bcas stsal nas bod nub phyogs su mgon gsum gyis dbang bsgyur to// lha chen dpal gyi mase|na gyis 1༷༷༷ nas 1025 bar dbang bsgyur/ de nas bzung rgyal rabs sum cu so gnyis pa ni/ rgyal po tshe dbang rab brtan nam mchog sprul yin/ khong gis 1830 nas 1834 bar dbang bsgyur/ yab tshe dpal don grub rnam rgyal dang yum na

276gnyis la mas tshe dbang ragabartan gcig dzigatogs gzhan sgras sras mo gang yang gabaltams/ 'on kyang sras tshe dbang rab bstan de nyid 'brug g.yongs 'dzin ye shes grusapas / snag tshang ras pa'i yang srid yin dzipos 'dzin mdzad nas chung dus su he mi dgon par rab tu byung /'don chos spyod sogs lablogasang mdzad/ dgung pho bco brgyad tsam phon dus yab yum dang blon po sku drag tshang mas thugs grabs mdzad pa ni/ gal te rgyal sras grwa phab ste btsun mo bzhes su mo'ajug na/ la dwags su chos rgyal gnya' khri btsan po'i gdung rgyud stong bar nges/desan grwa thab ste btsun mo bsu thabs bya rgyu thag bcad/ gnasatshul de nyid zhib gsal bris nas 'brug payongs 'dzin rin po cher phul pas/rin po che mchog gis kyang rgyal sras la gra phab ste btsun mo bzhes chog pa'i gnang ba stsal yang rgyal sras kyis de ltar ma mdzad/ de nas chos rgyal yab yum gyis 'brug chen sku phreng brgyad pa 7kun gzigs chos kyi snang ba mchog la dwags su gdan zhus te/ nā ro rgyan drug lo rgyus las (rngul dwags nas mnga' ris chos rgyal yab sras kyi gdan zhus te phebs/he mi dang lce bde sogs dgon sde khag la zhabs bcag mchod 'bul/

277mang 'gyed/ thugs sgon dang dbang / chos rgyal blon 'bangs bcas la chos 'brel re sgong mdzad spyod gsungs pa ltar phebs te rgyal sras la btsun mo bzhes dgos pa'i bka' slob nan tan stsal/ der brten a yum bka' blon tshe dbang don grub kyi sras mo skal bzang sgrol ma btsun mor bsnams/ de tsam ma zad lo gcig gi nang du dpa' bkums (pa skyum )jo'i sras mo bsod rnams dpal skyed dang / zla rā kha tun gnyis ga'ang btsun mor bzhes/ gces ma skal bzang sgrol ma la sras 'jigs med chos kyi seṅge kun dga' rnam rgyal dang / gces ma bsod nams dpal skyed la rgyal sras bstan srung g.yul rgyal bltams/ 'on ceX dres ra :sgo (pe thos kyang zu rā kha tun la sras sras 'a ra yad da ma sa/ nga du zhus pa ltar yab tshe dbang rab brtan 1830 lor rgyal po'i khrir mnga' gsol mdzad/ de nas khong gis sras chung ba bstan srung g.yul rgyal la mang spro'i yul phyed gzhis ka byas nas stsal/ de nas bzung mang spyo ru gnya' khri btsan po'i gdung rgyud spyi lo 2004 bar bar mchad par byung ngo //

278chogargyasab na sung g.yul la/chos rgyal bstan srung g.yul rgyal gyis mang spro ru ma khar chung chung zhig 184 lor bzhengs/ de'i mal ni da ltar rgyal mo rnam rgyal dbang mo dang ka ga tshe dbang don grub sras sras mo kun bzhugs yod pa'i gzims khang so ma de yin/ de nyid nyams gso gamadzad gong du der zhing gshegs dam pa 7skyabs rje rgyal sras ba ku la thub bstan mchog nor sku 'khrungs pa yin no/ /spyi pho 1835 lor la dwags kyi rang dbang sing pas 'phrogs/ rgyal po tshe dbang rab brtan khri nas phab/ gle'i blon po dngos grub bstan 'dzin rgyal por bsgos/ mes po tshe dpal don grub rnam rgyal dang tshapo 'jigs med chos kyi seṅge kun dga' rnam rgyal gnyis la tog gzhis ka ru btangs/ yab rgyal po tshe dbang rab brtan la dwags nas bros/ spyi sta brgyud shim la ru phebs dgos byung / der lo ha lam kha cig bzhugs rjes 1837 lor grongs/ khong gi gdung rus bsnams te rgyal mo snyi sgyu kha tun la dwags su bskyod/ rgyal sras 'jigs med kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis yab kyi

279gdung rus bsnams te yum zli snyi kha tun bskyod pas thugs/ mnyes te mang spro'i yul phyed khong la gsol ras su stsal/ phyis su zi snyi grong rjes mang spro cha tshung mang spro'i rgyal po bstan srung g.yul rgyal la thob bo//chos rgyal bstan srung g.yul rgyal la sras bkra shis lha dbang dang / ngag dbang rnam rgyal gnyis yod pa las sras chung ba ngag dbang rnam rgyal he mi ru grwa pa mdzad/ rgyal po bkrashis lha dbang la sras lnga dang sras mo gcig bcas ming sring drug 'byor/ 1 snang ba mtha' yas dmathu stobs rnam rgyal/ da 'chi med rdo rje rnam rgyal/ 4 phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ 5 tshe dbang rnam rgyal dang / 6 yi shes lha sgrol bcas yin no/ khong gi sku dus la da lta mang spro'i yul gyi dkyil du rjid rngam chags pa'i mkhar 189 tsamanang bzhengs/ sku mkhar 'di nyid kyi nang du byang rtse'i chos rje 7skyabs rje sras rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog sku 'khrungs/ khong sku 'khrungs pa'i gzims chung da lta'ang yod/rgyal sras che ba snang ba mtha' yas la zangs dkar bzang la'i mkhar nas rgyal mo ye shes dbang mo sku bag tu zhus/ chos rgyal snang ba rma tha' yas dang yum ye shes dbang mo gnyis la sras sras mo bzhi 'byor/

294su gsung lcags kyi rten sgog bzhengs sgo dkar chagached brjod/(chos blon shākyagyi mtshos 'dul spupod 1da dang / mdo sde bskal bzang sogs ji ltar bzhingasapar mdzad pa'i sgor gyi tho ngo mtshar bang mdzod 'di bzhin spel ba la spyo ba brtas/ de dus kyai rtsom pa po mkhas pa'i rtsom gyi nyams la gzigs/ brjod bya dang rjod byed phun sum tshogs pa'i ltad mo ci yang 'dug)༄༄/ /oṃ swasdi pra dza lhayaḥ sku gsum lhun grub ngo bo rdo rje 'chang //gsang sngags rdo rje theg pagle don rtogs te/ /bde chen thar pa'i lagamachog bgrod (bsgrod )mdzad pa'i/ /rtsabargyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser mdog mtshan dpes rab brgyan brjid pa'i sku//mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re ba skong ba'i gsung / /ma lus shes bya ji snyed gzigs pa'i thugs/ shāka thub bstan pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal 'tsha /skyon med chos sku'i ngang las ma ga'adzis kyang / /bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus na longs spyod rdzogs/ /sna tshogs sprul skus 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal pho/ /rin chen mthing sdon lta bur gsal ba'i sku/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi ldan 'od stong dra ba can //mthong thos dran pas ngan song gnas sbyong ba'i/ /mi 'khrugs lha yi

295tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs kun khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'dzin//gang des('i)byin brlabs ti slo pradzña'i mtshan/ /lnga rigs grub pa mchog brnyes na ro'i zhabs/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal gyur chos blo gros/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa gsal mdzad mi la rje/ /rab mchog rigapar brgyud pa'i bka' brgyud la/ /mi phyed dad pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal 'e1/ /gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum/ /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gar stabs las/ /brtse ba'i spyi gzugs ngur sprig zol 'chang ba/ /kun mkhyen sa paṇa zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /rtsab rab brtan zab mo stong pa nyid/ /lta ba mtha' gnyis spangs pa dbu ma'i lam/ /sde sdod rgya mtsho'i klong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam mkhyen rgya mtsho yangs pa'i glong dkyil na//rnam dag pad sdong ze'u 'bru nyer lnga'i steng / /rnam mang rgyal ba rgya mtsho ji snyed pa'i/ /rnam sprul gu ru padma 'byung gnas bstod/ /'byung lnga'i mdog can 'byung chen bzhi la dbang / /kun tu sgyur byed rdo rje 'dab shog can/ /ku yi dpal 'phrog lha mi'i dpal du gyur/ /rdo rje nam mkha' lding la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dpag med bskal pa'i sngon rol

296nas/ /tshogs gsags legs par sbyangs pa'i mthu mnga' zhing //'phrin las 'jig rten gsuman mtshungs med pa/ /'angam dbyangs kun dga' bkra shis grags pa'i dpal/ /bzang po'i zhabs lagarme 69) phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya gar rtso phyogs bram ze chen po nas/ /sgra dang tshad mosdeb sbyor gtan la phab/ /bod yul chos kyai dbul ba sel mdzad pa'i/ /thon mi sasnoṭal phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun dga' bo sogs dgra bcom brgya phrag lnga / /grags pa la sogs 'phags pa bdun brgya dang //gnas ma'i bu sogs bka' bsdu mdzad pa yi/ /bsdu ba rnam gsumamadzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od srungs la sogs bstan pa'i gtad rabs dang / /klu sgrub la sogs rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / /mang pos bkur sogs chos rgyal rgyud pa ste/ /'phags yul bstan 'dzin rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gnya' khri btsan po tho tho ri snyan dang //srong btsan sgam po khri srong lde btsan dang / /bo lha sa twa ka ma la shi la//ku sa ra dang thon mi ska chog zhang / /bstan pa snga dar bstan 'dzin rnams la 'dud/ /bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal sad mi bdun/ /skyed lde nyi ma mgon nas legs rgyud pa'i/ /chos rgyal chen po stod kyi mgon

297gsum ni/ /sa la dbang sgyur rgyal po'i tshul bzung nas/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan dam pa'i khrir bzhugs te/ /sa gsum bde la bkod pa'i mes dbon rgyal/ /gzungs sngags rtog pa bya rgyud spyod rgyud dang //rnal 'byor rgyud dang rnam 'byor bla med kyi/ /dbang lung bshad pa lag len man ngag gi /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams phyag 'tshal 81/ /'aspyo1 la phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bde legs bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /'dzin dang spel dang srung dang rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /skyes bu dgapa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//kye phags/ gling gi mchog gyur lho yi 'dzaskru gling / /ri mtho sa gtsang spu rgyal bod kyi yul/ /dwangs ma bsil ba chu bo bzhi'i mgo /'bru sna lnga 'khrungs spang spos rirnga/ gyis bsgor/ /gser la sogs pa rin chen dgos 'dod tshang / /ri bo du ma 'dus pa'i spyi bo la/ /dag pa shel gyi cod pan 'chang ba 'di/ /nang ltar rtsarlung khams kyi rten 'brel la//gsang ltar rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ris med 'char ('phyar) / /phyi ltar dgra bcom bzhugs gnas ti se'i gangs/ /mtsho mo ma phal(pang )g.yu'i maṇḍal 'gram/ /bod kha gling drug ri mtho sa gtsang la//

298dang po dbang byed rim pa dgu byung ste/ /de nas spu rgyal btsan pos mnga' mdzad skad/ /gnya' khri matsan po man chad mes dpon rnams//nam gyi lha nas mi yi rjer gshegs te/ /de nas khri srong lde btsan yan chad du/ /rje yi bsod nams 'phrul gyi byed rlabs kyis/ /rgyal phran bcu gnyis la sogs thabs kyis 'dul/ /bod 'bangs de nas skyed mgo 'dzom pa lags/ khyad du 'phags pa mar yul gzhung ring 'di//seṅge kha 'bab 'brug pa'i g.yas rol rna/ /chos rgyal pho brang bkrashis tshangs dpal dang / /rgyal sa gastang sgang rab bstan lha rtse dang / khrel mkhar pho brang dbyig gu khri khang sogs/ /de 'dra'i srid la dbang sgyur mi dbang mchog /chos kyi rgyal po bde ldan rnam rgyal 'di/ /mkhyen pa rab rdzogs 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang ma'ajarmephro mkha' mnyam skyong la thugs rje chen po 'dra/ /thub bstan skyong la gsang ba'i bdag po bzhin//lha sras lta bu kun gyi yid du 'ong / /lugs gnyis gnas la mkhyen spyan kun yangs pa/ /rnam thos bu dang mtshungs pa'i 'byor pa can/ /lha sras mi dbang nyi ma rnam rgyal 'di/ /pharol dgra la bskal ba'i me bas —

299'jigs/ /bu bran skyong la drin can pha bas ltag /rgyal khrims pad tshal skyong ba'i mazer can/ /mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar shog/ma ma ho/ rigs mchog kun bzang nyi zla'i 'od dkar can/ /dbyangs can nor rgyun sgrol ma dngos byon pa'i/ /gnam sa'i bdag mo dpal mdzes dbang mo yi/ /chab srid yar po'i zla ltar rgyas par shog /gang de'i chab srid bzang po'i mnga' 'og na/ /yul la g.yang chags sa las 'bur du mtho/ /pho brang khyad 'phags dbyig gu khri khang 'di/ /phu stod gangs ri dar dkar yol ba 'dra/ /mda' na nor 'dzin bu mo g.yu gos gyon/ /bar na 'bru bcud skyed pa'i ngang mo 'khrungs/ /rgyab ri mi 'gyur rdo rje brag gi steng / /de'i nang 'dod dgu thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pe'i ka drug 'dir/ /sdon gyi dus na lha rgyal khu dbon gyis/ /jo bo spyan drangs bstan pa phyi dar mdzad/ /da lta'i dus na grags ldan 'phrul ḍā'in mchog /stag ltar mdzangs la seng ltar dpa' brjid che/ /thog mar che ba mang bkur rgyal po'i gdung //bar du che ba sku rje khug pa'i gdung / /tha mar che ba lha ldong dkar po'i gdung / /mtshan dang don mthun shākya rgya tsho'am/ shākya tshe ring lhag ———wa —

300bsam dag pa yis/ /rigs mchog chos rgyal mdzad pa ji bzhin du//ngo mtshar rmad byung mdzad pa rjes yi rang / /ma gaho/ bkra shis mngon mtho dpal gyis brgyan gyur pa'i/ /blang dor tā( gros gsal ba'i me long bzhin/ /dad brtson snying rje'i me tog pad dkar can/ /'dzaskru'i ze'u 'bru snyan pa'i dri gsung rgod/ /dkon mchog mchod cing 'khor 'bangs brtse bas skyong / /byams sems ldan pa'i shes rab chos 'dzogadang ༈ /steng zhal 'di gnyis dge ba'i bka' bgros nas//rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas phyir dang / /rje yi mnga' thang bde la spyod pa dang / /mtha'(tha )yi dmag dpung thams cad zlog phyir dang / /rang re tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa kun byang nas/ /rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir du/ /sku yi rten du mahā gu ru ni/ /rin chen gser dang gzi khrim las grub par/ /sku gzugs zhal skud sogs la sa snying ni/ /zho grangs so gsum lhag bsam dag pas bsgrubs// gzungs kyi rnam grangs sde sdod gsum dang ni/ /rgyud sde bzhi sogs mkhas grub bla ma'i mtshan/ /rnam par dag pa ngo mtshar rmad byung bzhugs/ ༈ ༈dmigs med mkha' la thugs rje chu 'dzin 'khrigs//

301mkhyen pa'i glog 'phreng bslab gsum chu char g.yo/ /rigs gsum gdul bya'i lo tog smin mdzad pa'i/ /dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas dpal 'brug pa/ /snyingag dbang rnam rgyal dngul gyi dkar blugs kyi//'dra sku skrus gtsang khyud gang rnam dag dang / /skye| ḍi ya na'i dngul sku dkar lugs ni/ /khyud gang pa dang gsang bdag gtum po'i sku//dngul gyi dkar blugs khyud gang rgyab (ga)yol bcas/ /gser gyi zhal thang o ḍi ya na dang / /shā 5ri pa phyag na rdo rje dang / /sna tshogs mthing dang/spangs ma li ṭi (kri )mtshal / /rin chen sa le sbram dang dngul dkar las/ /rdo rje 'chang la bka' brgyud bla ma yi/ /brgyud rigarnam dag zhing khams lnga mchar dang / /sa skya paṇa chen tshe dpag med pa dang / /mi pham dbang po tshe bdag zhal thang sogs/ /lhag bsam dag pas sgo nas legs par bzhengs/ /gsung gi rten du dam chos khyad 'phaḍa ni/ /'gro la skyed pa kun sne ra rgyal ba yi/ /bstan pa'i dpag bsam spel dang kun 'dzin pa/ /'dul ba'i sde stod rtsab gnyis dang ni/ /bstan dang bstan chos dngos der phyag byas te/ /'dul ba'i po ti rnam grangs bcu gnyis la/ /sa yi snying po zho brgya bong gsum dang //

302dngul zho brgya dang lnga bcu nga gcig dang / /gzi khrigazho brgya bzhi bcu zhe gcig dang / /cha drug gzer dang gzer gdan dngul grangs dgu/yongs su bsdoms pa sum brgya go gsum dang / /bong grangs dgu bcas thugs bsam dag pas bsgrubs/ /ram ni sgo re sum brgya nga dgu'o/ /gang la skyabs byed mngon btud de ni mdo/ /srid pa'i du kha kun gyi spang 'gyur (spangs gyur )phyir/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi mchod sdong 'ji 'dra ba/ /bskal bzang 'dir byon sangs rgyas stong gi mtshan/ /mdo sde bskal bzang pu ti gnyis la ni/ /stod kyi rgya skad dngul la ljang bdungs dang / /las lha thub chen byang sems mchog dga' la/ /ljang brdungs dngul grang drug cu tham pa dang / /zhal skud gser dngul chu zangs gsum po la/ /zho yi grangs ni lnga bcu nga bdun dang / /ram grangs spo re lnga bcu nga brgyad dge /chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang rnam rgyal la/ /gus pa'i gsol btab mnyes pa'i yon phul nas/ /mgon po de nyid mnyes pa'i mdo mangs la/ /rab gnas phyag nas 'thor nas ngo mtshar ba'i/ /byin rlabs dpag med dang bcas stsal pa dang / /gang gsung brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi sgo/ /snying por

303bsgril ba'i dam chos gzungs mdo'i tshogs/ /phan dang bde phyir lhag bsam rnam dag pas/ /81na phul mkhan chen sbyin pa rgya mtsho yis /rab gnas me tog 'thor ba'i mdo 'bum dang / /bcom ldan sman bla'i gsung gi bdud rtsi 'di/ /nyi thang zhabs drung ngag dbang gzhon nu de'i//phyag nas byung ba'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi dang / /mgon de'i bka' 'grel cha lag bco brgyad dang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun dngos pad 'byung gi /yid bzhin nor mchog rnam thar sde lnga 'di/ /ches dkon mthong nas 'gro ba du ma la/ /phan ched kho nas dbus phyogs po ta lar/ /legs pa'i yon skur spyan drangs gyur pa dang / /gzhan yang yum chen snelang phrag brgya pa yi/ /glegs bam bcu gnyis (ga)zhig sos yang dag mdzad/ /thugs rje chen po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi ni/ /sra brtan mi 'gyur dbyig gu khri khang 'dir/ /rdo la 'bur bkod maṇi khri tsho gsum/ /sdetshong phrag bzhi rnams legs par grub pa dang / dge bcu 'dzom zhing skyed pa'i sa bu ru/ /rdo na 'bur bkod stong phrag lnga dang ni//brgya phrag gcig rnams lhag bsam ngag pas bzhengs/ /sdetshon byon 'itsho chen rnams kyis legs bsgyur pa'i/ /chos sgo'i dam chos zab btus

304mang bzhengs dang / /gser dngul 'bur dod las lha khyad 'phags sogs/ /bzhengs pa'i 'phrul gyi :rton chen steng zhal rnams/ /nyin mtshan chos la spyod pa'i dge legs stsol/ /sngon gyi yab mes gong ma rim rgyud pas/ /sku gsung thugs rten rin chen gser dngul dang //sna tshogs tshon la bsgrubs pa rnam mang sogs/ /bzhengs pa'i dkar chag rnam dag gong du gsal/ /rang res bzhengs pa'i rten chen 'di rnams la/ /rab tu brtan pa'i bkra shis mnga' gsol ba/ /gsung rab kun gyi dgongs don nam mkha' la/ /thogs pa med pa'i :( gros dkyil 'khor can/ /thub bstan 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i gnyen gcig pu//dpal ldan 'phrin phagabazang po'i chu gter phas/ /kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khesar zhal phye nas/ /bkrashis rab gnas me rtog char bzhin gsol//e ma mi mchog 'di 'dra skal ba bzang / /gang sngon bskal par tshogs gnyis 'bras bzang las/ /tshe 'dir yab yum sku drung 'dzoms pa dang / /sngon gyi smon lam phyogs mthun 'dzomachi pa yis/ /mtshar sdug 'od dkar zla zhal 'dzum mdangs ma/ /sras mo legs so mi pham chos 'dzom 'di/ /mi zad nor bu'i bang mdzod longs spyod cing / /yab

305yum bzhin du dkon mchog mchod par shog /dad gus ldan pas dkar po'i dge la mos/ /byang sems tshula'adzin gces ma tshe ring dang //bzhin mdzes 'dzum ldan ya rabs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /mtshan ldan sras mo tshe ring dpal 'dzoyodang / /mdangs legs bzhin sdug lha yi sras mo 'dra/ /padma'i bzhin mdzes bkra shis dpal 'dzogadang / /mdzangs la 'phrul chags 'khor (gsung )dag byams pas skyong / /yab yum thugs 'dzin bstan 'dzin sgrol yodang / /bsod nams rgya mtshor 'khyel ba'i longs spyod ma/ /mtshar sdug 'od dkar sras mo tshe dbang rnams/ /dpag bsam ljon pa bzhin du thugs bskyed nas/ /sku gsung thugs rten 'di rnams bzheng ba'i skabs/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i zas mchog rnam mang la/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang ro mchog brgyad sbyar nas/ /yab yum dgyes pa'i mthun rkyen yang dag dang / /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin brlabs dpon rnams la/ /stug 'dzugs bar ston skabs chad dpag med bsgrubs/ /zas kyi snying po longs spyod rgyas par shog /gzhon nu rdel gsal mkhyen rab khong nas rgyas/ snyag gros ldan zhing byams pa'i go cha bgos/ /tshabo'i mchog gyuri kun dga' phun tshogs dang / kha

306dog dbyibs legs sos ga'i me tog 'dra/ /sdum skyes sdetshong ldan 'dra ba'i bzhin mdzes po/ /tsha bo legs so tshe ring rab brtan dang //mdzangs drung ldan pa'i bu mo 'byor dang ni/ /dge tshogs dpag med ring nas spyad pa yis/ /dpal 'byor rin chen mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa//mag pa'i mchog gyur no no bsod nams dang / /gzhung lugs smra 'jagabasod nams lhun grub dang / /thabs shes bzung 'dzin ngag dbang dpal 'byor dang / /dpa' mdzangs ldan pa rgya mtsho ma lig dang / kha dog yid 'ong mdzes pa'i ngang tshul ldan/ /tshamo'i mchog gyur chos mdzes bu khrid dang / /chos sgron gdang tshe ring chos 'dzom rnams/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod rgyas par shog /gzhan yang phyogs kyi sbyin gtong dpal mo che/ /rgya mtshe'i nang du chu thigs ji bzhin du/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i dge la zong srong ba/ /rgya mtsho ma zad bar du chu thigs zad mi 'gyur/ /'on kyang sku yi gnyen drung thams cad dang / /phan bde dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas /mkhas grub bsdi gnas he mis dgon pa dang / /bla dwags stod smad bar gsuma'ithams cad gyi//sa yul dpon po so so'i gtso byas pa'i/ /chos sde mi sde drag (grag )

307shos yul mi yis/ /dge si ka ru dbyar tsho bzhin du 'khyil/ /rdzogs ldan bzhin du kun kyang ci dgar spyod/ /e ma bskal pa bas kyang bskal pa bzang / /gang gis rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun bzhin/ /nang gi bang 1sdon :rdo :ri lag byenge 3rdo byurdo wabyung lang ——ma da 'a na pa gnyar na dang / / ma ga brgya la langs spyad gsol dpon dang / bdud /na lnga la longs spyorde changamasogs/ /dri wa wa dnghazhim 'dab brgya'i tshal la mi gnod par/ /bcud chen blangs nas sbrang rtsi'i dpal bskyed ltar/ gtong phod lugs brgyad ldan pa'i sgo 'phar can/ /rten mchog khyad 'phags 'di rnams bzheng ba'i dus/ /ngal dub khyad bsad zhabs rtog ngo mtshar che/ /rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag bden pa dang / /rgyal yu ma zab mo'i chos tshig bden pa dang / /:mi 'gyur chos sku bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /sbyin bdag sku tshe brtan zhing dge gyur cig /yangs pa'i sa chen 'dir yang dus kun tu/ /lo legs char chu dus su 'bab pa dang / /nad dang thab rtsod 'khrug long kun zhi nas/ /'gro kun bde zhing dge la spyod par thog /rgyal ba gong ma'i thugs dgongs rab rdzogs nas/ /rgyal sras bstan rmedzin sku tshe bstan gyur te/ /rgyal khams kun du bde skyede ldan pa dang / /rgyal ba'i — —

308bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur nas/ /rgyal ba'i gdul bya mkha' ༷/( zug 'pha mcho ———tshug 3tho rsātsho zugamanyam 'a rnams byas/ /rgyal ba rda ji 'chang ga sa ba shag /spyan bdag sku tshe sa ltar brtan pa kṣe / /dpal 'byor chu ltar rgyas pa'i ba dan 'phyar/ —/bsod nams me chen rtag tu 'bar ba seng / /snya grags rlung ltar khyab pa'i bkrashis thog/ba sa ma la/(snyan rtsom phun sum tshogs pa'i dkar chag 'di nyid mang spyo a chung dge blong lngom dbyangs mas phyin gyis btsal bsgrugs mdzad pa la brten nas daX/ spyi zla 6 tshes ga nyin blog klad du bcug thub pa yin/ )7 4

4 ri ༷༵ga rme tsha rte ( 9 /sdusabye/(77747674 55(chi tsho/ //tsas ri gar〉 / (4 64 2 7sde khrod nga (6 lo ske / sgo ci 4945 7 phyi 598 ra da gyi tsho 47 sang nu ge tho dzosku ༷ gu/ ( ༄ ri sdu — ———mi — — ri 'i — 444 ༄ri sgo ༷༷ ste sne spyo sar gemo mi ri na la rnyi 33 43 4—— rdzospre ༷ tre/ sgyu ga 'a byu sherakṣe sgo la mgo ༷ge sta te dang nyi rdorsha la choduX rshadza/ bye shelasang —— — tsha na — bhe gyi ge tsho cas po tsha ra bo jo༄ ji dza rme shi/ rdzopo sna tsho 4 ge gyi sde 'u cho sgo nga mes sna kyi97 ji tshor/ 44 5/77 —— /tsho rwadze — 7ci —— ga ( 48 spyod byu 4 4
